title: Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II
description:
Scope of this role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II to join our finance team. The Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II will primarily assist with financial forecasting, budgeting, modeling, and variance analysis to support strategic decision-making across the organization. The ideal candidate should have strong financial modeling skills, data analytics skills, and excellent communication abilities.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the monthly forecasting and annual planning related activities which include the following:

    • Planning & Budgeting; current year and mid/long-term rolling corporate estimates and forecasts including cash forecasting. Serve as a thought leader to drive process improvement and create documentation to set precedence.

    • Performance tracking against operating plans and KPIs; identifying risks and opportunities, driving accountability.

    • Business intelligence, insight identification, and decision analytics for business partners and executive teams.

  • Execute financial close and reporting processes in partnership with controllership, commercial, and accounting teams. Also, look for opportunities related to process improvement and drive change.

  • Analyze financial performance, highlight trends and variances against budget and forecast with qualitative comments. Variance analysis of actuals vs forecast with key highlights/call outs to the management.

  • Foster strong relationships with stakeholders, promoting effective communication and collaboration

  • Lead and partner with cross-functional business teams in delivering analytics, data, and insights to drive key business decisions and support negotiations.

  • Actively partner with global leaders to drive standardization, accuracy, and efficiency.

  • Actively drive automation of reporting at the corporate level; support the FP&A organization through an end-to-end enterprise transformation.

A Little About You

A successful FP&A Analyst should be detail-oriented, and have a strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify and strengthen areas of business risks. They should help develop and maintain the right reporting models (completeness and accuracy) and adapt to business needs/strategic and growth mindset. This requires a lot of diligence and an attitude to take on new tasks while being solution-oriented.

  • Strong work ethic, self-motivated work style, attention to detail, effective communicator

  • Ability to organize multiple responsibilities and deliver results in an accurate and timely manner while adapting to changes in priorities.

  • Ability to influence and strategically partner with individuals of various educational and technical backgrounds, both inside and outside the organization

  • Strong business acumen and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and present data

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines under pressure

  • Self-starter with a strong sense of urgency and follow-up skills.

  • Qualified CA or MBA in finance from Tier 1 or Tier 2 colleges

  • Prior FP&A Experience required (2-5 years minimum) FP&A/ reporting/data analytics experience across revenue, expense, cash or capex.

  • Sound fundamentals on financial knowledge, analytical/data modeling ability, and sound understanding of the media ecosystem including some understanding of Nielsen’s products and services

  • Ability to develop constructive relationships with executives and colleagues across the organization

  • Experience with analytics tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Google Data Studio, and spreadsheet tools (excel, Google Sheets) is required.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @ address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Shipping Supervisor
description:
What sets us apart?

  • Competitive compensation plan, base salary, and annual incentive
  • Health Benefits: medical, dental, vision, short term and long- term disability and wellness programs
  • 401-k plan with company match
  • Comprehensive Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Continuing Education Reimbursement
  • Collaborative and Innovative work environment

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Vantage Apparel is a leading global supplier of custom logo apparel, offering a wide range of high-quality garments and accessories for corporate, promotional, and teamwear needs. As the exclusive provider of Greg Norman®, POLO® Ralph Lauren®, Xtreme Visibility™, Redwood Classics™, and Lane Seven Apparel, Vantage has been the industry’s top-awarded decorator for 30 consecutive years. Since joining forces with Lynka in 2021 to expand our European presence, we have continued to grow our global reach while earning recognition as an ASI Top 40 Supplier and a PPAI Gold Pyramid Top 100 Supplier (#12 in 2025). With more than four decades of experience and multiple “Best Places to Work” honors, Vantage has been the leading B2B innovator in the promotional apparel industry since 1977, delivering exceptional service and innovative solutions to customers worldwide.


ROLE HIGHLIGHTS

The Shipping Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the shipping department to ensure orders are prepared, processed, and shipped accurately and on time. This hands-on role involves working closely with shipping staff and the operations team to improve workflow, maintain high standards of accuracy, and resolve any issues that arise. The Shipping Supervisor manages workloads, supports team productivity, and promotes quality and accountability. Success in this role requires strong knowledge of shipping methods and logistics, attention to detail, effective communication, leadership skills, and a focus on continuous improvement and operational efficiency.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Oversee daily outbound shipping operations to ensure orders are shipped accurately, on time, and in accordance with customer, carrier, and quality requirements.
  • Plan and prioritize daily workflow based on order volume, customer commitments, shipping deadlines, carrier cutoffs, staffing, and operational needs.
  • Lead daily Shipping team operations by assigning work, monitoring productivity and quality, coaching employees, addressing performance and process issues, and supporting development.
  • Maintain a strong floor presence to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks, shipping errors, quality concerns, aging orders, and other issues impacting customer commitments.
  • Ensure compliance with SOPs, customer and carrier requirements, and quality standards by verifying order accuracy, packaging, labeling, routing, carrier selection, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, customers, and carriers to support efficient shipping operations and resolve outbound order issues.
  • Coordinate parcel, LTL, and FTL shipments, including carrier scheduling, pallet counts, documentation, and domestic and international shipping requirements.
  • Resolve shipping exceptions, carrier delays, freight claims, billing discrepancies, and service issues in collaboration with internal teams and carriers.
  • Train and cross-train employees on shipping systems, SOPs, quality, safety, and departmental standards while promoting urgency, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide backup support to the department Manager as needed.

title: CT Technologist
description:
**$2,000 Sign On Bonus Available**

Department:
Diagnostic Imaging

Varies; Full Time

40

General Description:
Under the direct supervision of the Lead CT Technologist or CT Supervisor, performs CT scanning procedures in Diagnostic Imaging. The position shall exemplify the desired Culture of Choice® and philosophies of Parrish Healthcare.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provides all aspects of Diagnostic Radiology and Computerized Tomography care based on established standards. Demonstrates Competency in all procedures within the scope of practice, as appropriate to the ages of the patients served evidenced by: The ability to obtain information and interpret information in terms of the patient’s needs; knowledge of growth and development; and understanding of how to compensate technical factors to provide an optimal clinical image for interpretation.
  • Interviews with patient, family members, nursing staff and physicians to collect pertinent information (patient history) to ensure an appropriate and efficient study. Educates patients as to procedure process and post procedure care.
  • Administers contrast agents when appropriate using department established criteria and guidelines for the correct agent, computer entry for charge capture and recognition of adverse patient reactions. Completes all necessary documentation related to contrast media use.
  • Selects proper technical factors, positioning, and equipment to optimally demonstrate patient anatomy and corresponding pathology. Uses department protocol for positions selected. Demonstrates good judgment of acceptable completed exam quality in the absence of a supervisor.
  • Completes timely and accurate computer entry duties inclusive of exam status changes and billing correct procedure. Completes timely and accurate computer entry duties including exam status change, billing additions or corrections, patient tracking time entries, and appropriate ICD-10 codes. Completes accurate and timely PACS inputs.
  • Maintains cleanliness and general order of procedure room. Cleans equipment and follows infection control guidelines.
  • Ensures patient and personal radiation protection by ascertaining pregnancy status when indicated, using gonadal shielding when appropriate and practicing ALARA principles (time, distance, shielding) of dose reduction.
  • Communicates patient needs and/or pertinent assessment information to the radiologist (or other healthcare providers) as it pertains to the exam. Communicates with other department areas to coordinate patient flow for multiple procedures.
  • Knows fire, disaster and safety procedures and regulations as pertain to the work area.
  • Performs similar or related duties as assigned.

  • Associate's Degree or other Two Year College equivalent required. Military training accepted.

  • Florida State DOH Licensed required.
  • RT(R) registered through ARRT required.
  • BLS through The American Heart Association required.
  • RT(CT) registered through ARRT preferred.

Job Description:

About Innovative Medicine

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):
  • United States - Requisition Number: R-098239

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine R&D is recruiting for a Director, Regulatory Data Office Leader. This position is a hybrid role and can be located in Horsham, PA; Raritan, NJ; or Titusville, NJ.

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) is seeking an experienced leader with deep regulatory domain expertise and a strong track record in data stewardship and governance. The Director, Regulatory Data Office Leader, will lead a global team of data stewards and oversee the Regulatory Data Hub (RDH), ensuring trusted, high-quality regulatory data enables business intelligence, analytics, and informed decision-making as we build a world-class regulatory operations organization.

As the business owner of GRA data governance capabilities, including the Regulatory Data Council, Regulatory Data Hub, data stewardship program, and regulatory data standards, the Director will strengthen the quality, integrity, accessibility, and responsible use of GRA data. This highly collaborative and technically fluent leader will partner across R&D, Johnson & Johnson Technology (IT), Data, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DDSAI), and the enterprise to establish governance policies and standards and to embed trusted data into major transformation efforts. This will include end-to-end Regulatory Information Management (RIM) through the Unified Regulatory Platform (URP), R&D Digital Solutions Initiative (i.e. MDM), eLabeling and submission-excellence AI tooling. Regulatory Knowledge and Process Excellence (RKPE) operates through three integrated pillars - the Data Office, the Process Office, and Decision Enablement. As leader of the Data Office, the Director will be accountable not only for the performance of their own pillar but for actively creating synergy across all three, ensuring that trusted data, well-designed process, and decision enablement operates as one connected capability rather than three separate functions.

Principal Responsibilities:

Data Governance and Stewardship
  • Serve as the advocate for regulatory data integrity, ensuring business relevance, quality, trustworthiness, and responsible stewardship of GRA data.
  • Promote shared responsibility and clear accountability for regulatory data ownership, stewardship, quality, access, and decision rights, enabling enterprise-wide insights, analytics, and decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain data governance policy, standards, definitions, and business rules for regulatory data across systems, in close alignment with R&D, Pharma, and cross-sector initiatives.
  • Oversee regulatory data ownership and stewardship, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with global health authority requirements (e.g., IDMP, xEVMPD, SPOR).
  • Enable Data Stewards and Domain Owners to establish and monitor regulatory data quality metrics, lead root-cause analysis, prioritize remediation, and measure sustained improvement across regulatory data domains.

Data Council and Framework Leadership
  • Operate and chair the cross-functional Regulatory Data Council, governing access to and ingestion of regulatory data and harmonizing with enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • Reconcile central, regional, and local GRA business needs while ensuring overall efficiency and quality.

Regulatory Data Hub - Business Ownership
  • Provide day-to-day business functional ownership of the Regulatory Data Hub (RDH), turning fragmented regulatory data into trusted, curated regulatory data for decision making.
  • Provide governance and stewardship through the Regulatory Data Council to align GRA data domains with data products. Collaborate with JJT (IT) and DDSAI to enable consistent management and effective use of regulatory data across a range of business use cases.
  • Provide strategic input to current and future tools and processes used to collect, share, submit, and track regulatory data, ensuring related business support and services are provided to the GRA community.
  • Anticipate business needs and evolve data and technology capabilities ahead of industry trends.

Transformation Enablement
  • Provide strategic leadership to engage and support end-to-end RIM transformation through the Unified Regulatory Platform (URP), ensuring data governance, quality, and stewardship requirements are embedded from design through adoption.
  • Partner on submission-excellence and next-generation submission efforts, supporting the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and simulation capabilities with trusted, well-governed data as the foundation.
  • GRA leader and enabler of success across programs representing a broader transformation landscape that will require thoughtful strategy, silo elimination, and alignment across R&D and the enterprise (e.g. eLabeling, MDM/DSI).
  • Stay attuned to the impact of global initiatives and direct regulatory contributions to the implementation strategy for globally developed regulatory authority programs.

Leadership and People Management
  • Lead and develop a global team of data stewards and experts through direct and indirect reporting relationships. establish clear data domain accountabilities and priorities, create individual and team capability development plans, and set measurable performance expectations aligned with business needs.
  • Provide customer-focused leadership that empowers, promotes, and motivates high-performing teams, drives innovation, and fosters collaboration and diversity to deliver results.
  • Contribute expertise to internal and external initiatives that influence evolving policy and requirements impacting regulatory data capabilities.
  • Partner deliberately with the Process Office and Decision Enablement leads to connect data standards to process design and to translate governed data into decision-ready insight, jointly setting shared priorities, resolving interdependencies, and presenting an integrated RKPE agenda to stakeholders.


Qualifications:

Education:
  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Science, Business, Computer Science/Technology, Regulatory Affairs, or equivalent is required. Advanced degree Master's, Ph.D., PharmD) preferred.


Required:
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in a medium-to-large-scale Pharmaceutical, Medtech or related healthcare environment.
  • Experience with a foundation of Regulatory Affairs knowledge.
  • A minimum of 2 years of people management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a data steward, lead data steward, data-domain governance lead, or equivalent business owner accountable for data standards, quality, metadata, ownership, and issue resolution in a regulated environment.
  • Strong data analysis skills with the ability to translate data into information, and strategies into actionable plans.
  • Strong understanding of the business aspects of data standards, data architecture/tools, and related governance.
  • Knowledge of quality management and/or compliance principles within the drug development process.
  • Experience leading projects and project teams.
  • The ability to influence without authority and drive alignment in a global, matrix environment.
  • The ability to build trust with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong networking, relationship-building, conflict-resolution, and negotiation skills.


Preferred:

title: Automation Tech Lead
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.


What You Can Expect

We are seeking a seasoned and technically authoritative Automation Tech Lead to anchor our Intelligent Automation Center of Excellence (CoE) within the Zimmer Biomet GCC. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical owner of our RPA and Intelligent Automation delivery pipeline — responsible not only for hands-on development, but also for leading the development team, setting engineering standards, and driving the evolution of our automation practice as per Zimmer Biomet’s Automation Architectural standards.
You will work in close partnership with Zimmer Biomet's AI/Automation Architect and global stakeholders to translate business automation goals into scalable, enterprise-grade solutions. This role carries both a strong technical leadership mandate and direct accountability for the quality, governance, and outcomes of all automation deliverables within the GCC.


Work Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)
Shift Timing - 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM

How You'll Create Impact

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture
• Serve as the technical authority for all RPA and Intelligent Automation initiatives within the GCC, owning end-to-end solution design decisions
• Lead the design and review of automation architectures using Blue Prism (v6.x / v7.x), UiPath, and Power Automate Desktop / Cloud, ensuring scalability, reusability, and maintainability
• Define and enforce REFramework, queue management, exception handling, and coding standards across the team
• Evaluate new tools, platforms, and AI-augmented automation capabilities (OCR, Microsoft Copilot, Gen AI / LLM) and recommend adoption roadmaps
• Provide final technical sign-off on Solution Design Documents (SDDs) before development commences
Development & Delivery
• Develop and oversee the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade RPA solutions integrating with SAP ECC / S4HANA, web applications, Outlook, Excel, and third-party systems via Blue Prism API and Web Services
• Ensure robust database interactions using SQL Server and Oracle, and guide the team on scripting in C#.NET, VBA, Python, and SQL
• Implement and promote best practices for OCR, Microsoft Copilot automation, and emerging Generative AI / LLM use cases within automation workflows
• Oversee bot deployment, Control Room monitoring, SLA adherence, and production support protocols across all live automations
CoE Governance & Standards
• Own and continuously evolve the CoE's automation governance framework — including standards for PDD, SDD, Bot Charter, As-Is / To-Be documentation, and User Manuals
• Lead process feasibility assessments, pipeline prioritization, and ROI estimation in collaboration with the AI/Automation Architect and business stakeholders
• Build and maintain a library of reusable components, design templates, and accelerators for use across the development team
• Champion compliance with IT, infrastructure, and security requirements across all automation solutions
Team Leadership & Mentoring
• Lead, guide, and mentor a team of Senior and Junior RPA Developers, providing actionable feedback
• Drive team capability building — identifying skill gaps, supporting certifications, and creating learning pathways aligned to the evolving automation landscape
• Set clear delivery expectations, track progress, and proactively manage technical risks and blockers within the team
• Foster a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement within the automation team

Stakeholder Engagement & Agile Delivery
• Act as the primary technical point of contact for Zimmer Biomet’s Solution Architect/Manager, business stakeholders, process owners, and cross-functional IT teams during automation engagements
• Lead requirements validation sessions, design walkthroughs, and UAT planning in collaboration with business analysts
• Drive Agile delivery ceremonies and manage tasks, defects, and change requests through JIRA and ServiceNow
• Present automation outcomes, pipeline status, and CoE metrics to senior leadership as required

What Makes You Stand Out

Required Qualifications & Skills

Must-Have
• 10–14 years of overall IT experience with a minimum of 10+ years in RPA development and delivery
• Proven experience independently designing, developing, and deploying 25+ RPA bots/processes across end-to-end automation lifecycles from PDD and SDD through build, testing, deployment, and production validation
• Proven track record in leading RPA teams (6+ associates), including technical direction, workload allocation, mentoring, code reviews, and performance oversight
• Deep, hands-on expertise in Blue Prism (v6.x and v7.x) mandatory; Blue Prism Developer certification strongly preferred
• Strong working knowledge of UiPath and/or Power Automate Desktop / Cloud
• Proven track record in SAP automation (ECC / S4HANA) and complex Web-based automation at enterprise scale
• Expertise in queue-based processing, enterprise exception handling patterns, and Control Room operations
• Strong proficiency in SQL (SQL Server / Oracle) and scripting in C#.NET, VBA, or Python
• Solid command of the full RPA lifecycle — from process discovery and PDD through SDD, build, UAT, and hyper care
• Strong documentation and governance skills — PDD, SDD, Bot Charter, As-Is / To-Be
• Hands-on experience with JIRA and ServiceNow for delivery management and incident tracking
• Strong experience in production support and monitoring — including server patch validation, post-patch verification, issue resolution, and ensuring system stability for live bots
• Hands-on working knowledge of Power Automate Desktop as a complementary automation platform
• Proficient in Power BI for automation metrics, operational dashboards, and data-driven decision support
• Strong command of Agile methodologies — sprint planning, task management, dependency tracking, and cross-team coordination
• Demonstrated expertise in process reengineering — evaluating existing processes, identifying automation opportunities, and building business cases for efficiency improvements
• Domain experience in at least one of: Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, or equivalent regulated industry

Good to Have
• Experience with OCR and intelligent document processing platforms
• Exposure to Microsoft Copilot automation and Generative AI / LLM concepts applied within automation contexts
• Knowledge of HTML5 for advanced web automation scenarios
• Advanced MS Excel skills including macros and VBA
• Knowledge of Automation Anywhere (fundamentals or beyond)
• Prior experience in a GCC, Shared Services, or CoE environment
• UiPath or Power Automate certification in addition to Blue Prism

Compliance & Quality

title: Senior Program Manager – ADCs
description:
The Oparc Mission:

Oparc believes that all individuals deserve the human right to be valued members of society regardless of their intelligence or physical capabilities. Oparc exists to make training, employment, and social opportunities available and to be the champion for thousands of people with disabilities in Southern California.

Title: Senior Program Manager – ADCs

General Statement of Function: The Senior Program Manager – ADCs provides supervisory leadership, case management oversight, and quality assurance for licensed programs, directly supervising four (4) Program Managers. This role combines day-to-day program leadership with case management continuity, regulatory compliance, and continuous quality improvement (CQI), ensuring uninterrupted, high-quality, person-centered services across assigned sites including routine and unannounced site observations, incident trend analysis, and corrective action follow-through for licensed programs. The Senior Program Manager – ADCs works in close partnership with the Senior Program Manager- Summit Services division to provide monthly quality and compliance summaries to the Director of Licensed Programs.

Essential Functions:

Program Supervision & Leadership

  • Directly supervise four (4) Program Managers across licensed programs, providing coaching, performance management, and day-to-day leadership.
  • Serves as the point of escalation for Program Managers on program operations, staffing, and participant service issues.
  • Support Program Managers in aligning day-to-day operations with Oparc's mission, goals, and person-centered practices.
  • Monitor program areas for safety, organization, and compliance with health and environmental standards.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of each supervised program's needs and support implementation of individualized, person-centered programming.
  • Provide timely response to urgent participant needs, service changes, or compliance-related deadlines.

Case Management Support & Consistency

  • Provide guidance, coaching, and technical support to Case Managers, including serving as a licensed program primary resource for the case management system, and providing oversight of system-related functions such as user support, troubleshooting, data integrity, and documentation standards.
  • Support the alignment of person-centered service plans with participant goals, needs, and requirements.
  • Using a tracker, provide oversight of the delivery of onboarding and ongoing training to new and existing staff, ensuring consistent training in documentation practices.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Perform quarterly reviews and Program Manager audits of case files for participants with annuals due, ensuring documentation is complete, current, and compliant with program and regulatory standards.
  • Quarterly oversight of internal monthly audits of, medication logs, cash accounts, Safety binders, Emergency binders, Evacuation documents, License 500 forms, and compliance logs for assigned sites to ensure compliance with Title 17, Title 22, CCL, HCBS, DDS, OSHA, and other regulatory or accreditation agencies.
  • Conduct routine and unannounced site visits and quality assurance walk-throughs, including community-based activities and outings, using standardized tools and submit deficiency reports and trends to the Director of Licensed Programs and Chief Program Officer.
  • Evaluate staff-participant interactions to ensure dignity, respect, and appropriate support are consistently demonstrated.
  • Monitor adherence to person-centered planning principles and ensure participant goals remain individualized, relevant, and actively supported.
  • Identify documentation, service delivery, or compliance gaps and provide guidance and follow-up to ensure corrective action is taken.
  • As assigned by the Director of Licensed Programs, conduct fact-finding investigations into complex compliance, service delivery, participant-care, or staff conduct concerns- coordinating with Human Resources when staff conduct is involved- and submit written findings and recommendations to the Director.
  • Support preparation for site inspections, audits, surveys, and accreditation reviews; participate in pre-licensing reviews and post-inspection debriefs.
  • Prepare and provide monthly caseload, compliance, and quality status reports to the Director of Licensed Programs and Chief Program Officer, including coverage needs, documentation status, and emerging concerns.

Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI)

  • Oversee incident management, trend analysis, and systemic risk assessments for assigned programs.
  • Lead and support the development and implementation of corrective and preventive action plans in collaboration with Program Managers.
  • Monitor and evaluate trend changes over time to assess the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions, ensuring sustained improvement and accountability.
  • Establish and maintain feedback loops connecting data analysis, action planning, and outcome evaluation.
  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous refinement of quality improvement initiatives for assigned sites, and elevate significant trends, gaps, or risk issues to the Director of Licensed Programs and Chief Program Officer.

Referral Tracker Dashboard

  • Monitor the Referral Tracker Dashboard for licensed programs, that new referrals are processed and enrolled efficiently.

Org-Wide Policy Consistency

  • Meet monthly with the Director of Licensed Programs and the Senior Program Manager for ADC programs to ensure licensed program policies, documentation standards, and practices remain consistent across both divisions.
  • Bimonthly, collaborate with all program management with supervisory responsibilities to discuss, coordinate, and make recommendations to Directors and CPO to drive organizational-wide consistency of policies and procedures.

Staff Development & Administrative Support

  • Track and monitor staff training compliance documentation, including onboarding, certifications, and ongoing professional development for assigned sites.
  • Maintain and update the training tracker and distribute training evaluations.
  • Conduct morning check-ins with Program Support Assistants to assess staffing needs and maintain accurate ratio and substitution records.
  • Maintain accurate program management meeting and training minutes and distribute timely updates to teams.
  • Coordinate the appropriate daily ratio relative to available staffing with the Senior Program Manager- Summit Services

Risk Management & Safety Oversight

  • Audit OSHA 300A, WVPP, and other safety documentation to ensure completion, posting, and submission.
  • Conduct safety reviews and emergency preparedness audits; track incident reports, safety incidents, emergency drills, and corrective actions.
  • Provide training and technical assistance to Program Managers regarding safety and regulatory compliance issues.

Communication, Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in participant meetings (e.g., IDTs, ISPs) as needed to support service continuity and represent Licensed Programs.
  • Represent Oparc at community events, resource fairs, and provider meetings on a rotating basis with the Senior Program Manager for ADC programs.
  • In the absence of the Director of Licensed Programs, escalate matters requiring executive-level decisions to the Chief Program Officer.

Other Duties and Responsibilities

  • Adhere to proper care and responsible use of Oparc-issued property, tools, and equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support program operations and service quality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Services, or a related field required (Master's preferred); or minimum of 3 years of experience in developmental disability services, including case management, with at least 3 years in a leadership, supervisory, or compliance role.
  • Prior experience directly supervising exempt-level staff strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable regulations including Title 17, Title 22, HCBS Final Rule, DDS, CCL, Regional Center, FLSA, and OSHA requirements.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of person-centered planning and service delivery.
  • Strong skills in staff supervision, coaching, performance management, data analysis, and quality assurance.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills, with the capacity to navigate challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities across programs.
  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint), Teams, Canva, and case management/documentation systems.
  • Familiarity with accreditation and regulatory standards (CCL, DDS, CARF) preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and sound judgment, with the ability to conduct field-based observations and evaluations independently.
  • Ability to pass a Department of Justice (DOJ) background check and fingerprint clearance, complete TB test, pre-employment physical, and provide proof of required immunizations (as applicable).
  • Valid CA driver's license, proof of current vehicle insurance, clear driving record, and two (2) years of driving experience.
  • Reliable transportation to travel and attend off-site meetings.
  • CPR, First Aid, and Crisis Intervention (e.g., CPI) certifications — or ability to obtain upon hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual (Spanish, ASL, or other languages) is a plus.

Work Environment Requirements

  • Able to work in both indoor and community-based environments, including outdoor settings that may involve allergens, excessive heat, cold, humidity, dampness, noise, and/or slippery or uneven walking surfaces, as well as indoor warehouse-type settings that may lack heating or air conditioning and have concrete flooring.
  • Frequent travel between program sites and community locations for scheduled and unannounced observations.
  • Flexibility required to accommodate program observations across varying schedules, including early mornings and evenings.
  • Willing to support individuals during community outings, job coaching, and/or volunteer activities as needed.
  • Able to lift up to 25 pounds by self and up to 150 pounds with one other person; able to assist with physical transfers if necessary.
  • Able to push a wheelchair with a seated participant up to one (1) mile.
  • Standing, walking, sitting, pushing, bending, and pulling required; squatting and repetitive motion may be necessary.
  • Use chemicals in accordance with manufacturer's labeled instructions.
  • Adhere to the proper care and responsible use of Oparc-issued property, tools, and equipment.


Location: Oparc – determination based on assigned Licensed Programs worksites.

Reports To: Director of Licensed Programs (escalates to Chief Program Officer in the Director's absence; provides monthly quality assurance and compliance summaries directly to the Chief Program Officer)

Schedule: Monday through Friday. This is an exempt position; flexible and/or additional hours/days will be required.

title: Lead, Product - Impact
description:
Position title: Lead, Product Impact

Location: Mohali

Position Type: Regular, Full-Time

Who we are

Roundglass is a wholistic wellbeing company working to empower healthier lives, stronger communities, and a more sustainable world. That w in wholistic is intentional: We believe true wellbeing spans the whole human experience, from how we care for ourselves to our connections with others and the planet.

Roundglass creates real-world impact through diverse, interconnected initiatives. Roundglass Foundation drives our development work in communities and ecosystems across India, while the Roundglass Living app delivers personalized, science-backed wellbeing guidance to individuals around the world.

We're driven by a mission to make wellbeing accessible and actionable for everyone, everywhere. That mission shapes how we work and show up for each other. If you're committed to creating meaningful impact and want to help build a culture that reflects it, we'd love to meet you.


About Roundglass Foundation

From empowering rural villages to nurturing world-class athletes and documenting biodiversity, Roundglass Foundation has been transforming communities and ecosystems across India since 2018. Through Roundglass Punjab, Roundglass Sports, and Roundglass Sustain, we drive long-term, systemic change in close collaboration with local communities and administrations, reaching to date. Everything we do reflects a single belief: Meaningful progress happens when leadership, opportunity, and community wellbeing grow together.


About the role

The Roundglass Foundation is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Product Manager to lead the Impact Analysis project. This role involves working closely with program leads and stakeholders to design and implement analytics-driven solutions that showcase the effectiveness of the Foundation's programs. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with BI tools, and the ability to create intuitive scorecards, define KPIs, and dashboards that represent the Foundation's impact.


What you’ll do

· Developing Impact Measurement Frameworks: Design and implement robust frameworks to track and quantify the impact of foundation programs, including key performance indicators (KPIs) aligned with the organization's mission and goals.

· Data Collection and Analysis: Manage the collection and analysis of data from surveys, MIS Data from change makers, volunteers, coordinators, beneficiaries, and other relevant data sources to understand the effectiveness of programs and identify areas for improvement.

· Impact Reporting: Prepare comprehensive reports for the foundation's executives, stakeholders, donors and the public detailing the impact of foundation activities, including qualitative and quantitative data

· Scorecard Development: Devise and implement scorecards and dashboards to visually represent program outcomes and the Foundation's overall work.

· KPI Definition: Help define and measure KPIs and indicators to track program effectiveness.

· Business Process Modeling: Analyze and document business processes to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.

· UI/UX Design for dashboards: Design and enhance the user experience of dashboards & reports, ensuring intuitive navigation and clear data representation. Help in visualization, prototyping to provide the rich user experience.

· Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with program leads, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to capture requirements, prepare release roadmaps and define solutions.

· Presentations and Reporting: Prepare and deliver compelling presentations and reports for stakeholders and leadership.

· Hands-on BI Tools: Leverage BI tools to create actionable insights and data visualizations.

· Release Management: Collaborate with technical team to manage the releases through JIRA, prepare the requirement documentation, do the change management and deliver the high-quality work.





Requirements


Skills & Qualifications

· Proven 5 to 8 years’ experience as a Product Manager in business analytics, impact evaluation, or a related domain.

· Strong understanding of UI/UX principles for BI tools.

· Hands-on experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar).

· Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.

· Expertise in business process modelling and stakeholder engagement.

· Ability to define and measure KPIs and program indicators.

· Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

· Experience in non-profit or social impact domains is a plus.

​

Benefits

Why Roundglass

Roundglass was built on the vision that wellbeing should be at the very center of our life journeys. We're reimagining how the world experiences wellbeing and how companies, including our own, support the wellbeing of their people.

We're a group of mission-driven innovators who put our values into practice every day, using technology, science, and traditional wisdom to help people live better lives. We've built a team we're proud of, and we're always looking for people who will add to it.


Roundglass does not discriminate against race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment.

title: Qualitative Research Insight Executive
description:
At Curion, We Connect Brands to People. Our expertise and passionate pursuit of insights enable our clients to make informed decisions that drive meaningful impact. Our vision? Advancing the way brands connect to people to build a better future. Our core values: Integrity, Resiliency, Accountability, Curiosity, and Collaboration.


Schedule: 40 hours per week (Monday – Friday)


Ability to commute/relocate: Leeds, LS15 8GB – reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required).


The Qualitative Insight Executive assists the main project manager on projects, with responsibility for design of simple project documentation, product preparation and packing, basic fieldwork, and supporting analysis and reporting. For simple projects, they may support the project lead directly; taking increased responsibility for the day to day running of a project.


Day to day / Administration:

  • Ensuring all project administration is up to date and in line with the Blue Print e.g. setting projects up on Asana, setting up project folders, setting up meetings with the project team (e.g. Kick-off/briefing, Hearts & Ladders), confirming timings & incentives with Field Ops, ensuring MIS is up to date
  • Ensure the smooth running of all projects involved in, e.g. keeping departments up to date on timings, changes etc.
  • Write initial drafts of project documents (or check those prepared by others) e.g. SoW (supplier and client), consent forms, screeners, simple discussion guides / protocols, product reconciliation forms
  • Support with designing more complex documents such as discussion guides and other research inputs, with input from seniors as needed
  • Oversee completion of video briefing form and initial draft of video edits sheet, working with trainee execs, video and translation agencies (for subtitles etc.) to complete the edit

Fieldwork

  • Support with recruitment & QCing of participants when needed
  • Ensure online scripts for screeners, questionnaires and online tasks are accurate through detailed testing and checks
  • Lead set up of Recollective boards for pre-work, ethnography and in-home testing
  • Lead operational aspects of fieldwork, including product delivery, stimulus/product/room preparation, packing, delivery and organisation - ensuring all fieldwork protocols are followed
  • Undertake key aspects of fieldwork and hosting in person (e.g. at Thorpe Park/Killingbeck)
  • Take a role in online and/or face to face qualitative moderation e.g. simple IDIs, online boards, focus groups, writing summaries and completing content analysis sheets as needed
  • Monitor quotas, completion rates etc., liaise with internal teams to ensure fieldwork is completed accurately, on time, and on spec
  • Assist with technical and administrative aspects of fieldwork e.g. creating and sending out participant Zoom links, asking participants to complete tasks, ensuring participants can access online fieldwork etc.
  • Accurately complete coding of open questions

Client management

  • Be the day to day client contact on simple projects
  • Demonstrate through behaviours key principles from the client charter, and support senior team members with client requests and client management, ensuring our high standards of responsiveness and flexibility
  • Join senior team members in client meetings (online or face to face), including at debriefs
  • Proactively help the team learn about the client’s business

Client/project deliverables

  • Conduct data checks to ensure accurate data in tables and reports (qual or quant), including proof reading
  • Take an active role in analysis by contributing to analysis plans and meetings
  • Write initial draft of simple reports, or support with report sections on more complex reports, working with seniors

Commercials, proposals & financials

  • Ensure accurate project information is up to date including POs, billing plans and total project value. Liaise with Finance to ensure invoices and POs are raised as per the process

Working as one team

  • Delegate to and coach junior members of the team (apprentices & trainees) to help their development
  • Be a good team player: proactively volunteer time when available to help others, within and across teams
  • Demonstrate flexibility to get involved in, and learn about, different project types
  • Build strong working relationships with other teams, and role model this to less experienced team members
  • Use initiative to make suggestions and demonstrate solution-focused approach when challenges are faced


This job description is not intended to be all inclusive, flexibility is assumed based on business needs


Requirements

  • A degree in a relevant field (e.g. social sciences, marketing, business) can be helpful, but is not essential, we’re open to candidates with diverse backgrounds and relevant skills
  • 1+ years relevant qualitative market research experience
  • Ability to commute/relocate to Leeds, LS15 8GB – reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)
  • Must have the right to work in the UK and will need to bring proof to the interview e.g. a passport or work permit.

About you


You’re fascinated by people and why they behave and think the way they do. You’re curious, creative, keen to learn, and passionate about developing new ideas and running with them. You love a challenge and thrive on working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.


You will bring 1+ years’ experience in qualitative market research and be ready to keep building your skills across a range of projects. You may have supported interviews, groups or online communities, helped develop research materials, contributed to analysis and supported the creation of clear, useful outputs for clients. You may have a degree in social sciences, marketing or business, though this is not essential. What matters most is that you are curious, organised, proactive and personable, with good attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and the confidence to work well with clients and colleagues.


What we offer


We offer a competitive salary, a bonus holiday for your birthday, regular socials, a bonus day for charity work, DE&I and wellbeing initiatives and lots of structured training throughout the year. We have a flexible working environment and if there’s something that’s important to you – be it a day you need to pick the kids up, or a specific charity you want to support – let’s talk!


Authenticity is one of our core values, and at Curion we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team with equal opportunities. We want to attract, develop, and promote the very best people from all walks of life, so we actively encourage applications from a range of socioeconomic and ethnic backgrounds, as well as others who are underrepresented in our sector, such as disabled or neurodiverse applicants.


Should you be successful in the recruitment process, and if you require any reasonable adjustments to be made to accommodate your interview, let us know in confidence.


For the Qualitative Research Insight Executive, we offer a competitive starting salary of 26,850 based on the qualifications and experience of each individual. Curion offers a benefits package for this position which includes:

  • Flexible working location and hybrid working. In addition to our flexible working policy, you will be required to work at least 2-3 days in the office, during your first 3-6 months, until you are ready to work independently.
  • Support with work from home needs you may have
  • 24 days holiday (plus bank holidays) + one per year up to 27 days
  • Company pension scheme
  • Extra day off on your birthday
  • Volunteering day every year
  • Fully renovated flexible / hybrid office in 2024
  • Bi-annual promotion and salary review windows
  • 2 major company parties a year + monthly socials organised by our own social and charity team

A bit about Curion (Formerly Blue Yonder Research)


We specialise in delivering impactful insights to the world’s top CPG companies, helping them develop winning, repeatedly purchased products. Our deep data-driven product insights, sensory expertise, and state-of-the-art consumer centres enable them to uncover responses to critical client objectives. With over five decades of experience in the product testing industry, we are dedicated to guiding clients in every stage of their product development, connecting brands to consumers at every step.


An innovator in the industry, we recently developed a groundbreaking benchmarking product testing method, the Curion Score™, which has become a trusted and sought after tool within the industry. As one of the largest product and consumer insights companies in the U.S. and U.K., we have built a reputation for excellence and trust among the world’s leading consumer brands. Our commitment to innovation and expertise, coupled with a passion for delivering actionable insights, makes us a valuable partner for companies looking to develop and launch successful products.

title: Railway Signaling Engineer
description:
IKOS is the European leading consulting firm specialized in railway engineering.

Context :


We are looking for a motivated Junior Signaling Engineer to join our amazing team in Lisbon and contribute to the design, testing, and maintenance of railway interlocking systems. Your role will be crucial.

Interlocking in railway signaling is a safety system that prevents trains from being given conflicting routes.


Responsabilities:

  • Support the development and configuration of railway signalling systems (interlockings, trackside equipment, onboard systems);
  • Perform system parametrization and data preparation according to project requirements;
  • Contribute to the preparation of signalling principles, control tables, and configuration data;
  • Assist in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues during project execution;
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including RAMS, system engineering, and installation teams;
  • Ensure compliance with applicable railway standards and project specifications.


We'd love you to apply if:


  • You hold a Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related tech field (mandatory!)
  • You are curious and passioned about railway
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Positive attitude
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities
  • Portuguese and English speaking are both mandatory.


Our values:


IKOS is human centered and built on strong values


  • Passion: Our enthusiasm for new technology and continuous research and innovation drives the day-to-day work of our engineers
  • Respect: Trust and mutual esteem, linked with equality and diversity, allow us to construct our future together
  • Team Spirit: This value is fundamental in our approach to our profession. It allows us to implement both large-scale and high-tech projects with our unique team
  • Excellence: Resolving the societal challenges relating to transport requires and deserves the best of ourselves. Fortified by our convictions, excellence remains at the heart of our work.


✅ Why Join Us?


  • Career Growth & Development: We offer tailored career plans, ongoing professional development, and clear progression pathways thanks to our IKOS Accademy.
  • High-Impact Projects: Work on pioneering railway and/or energy projects alongside industry leaders worldwide.
  • International Experience: Here it is possible! Work with top global clients and (if interested) gain hands-on international exposure through exciting projects and assignments abroad.
  • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a friendly/professional and collaborative Team that values passion, respect, and peer support.
  • Competitive Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, happiness, and career journey with us (Home office, participation public transport ticket, performance bonus, ticket restaurants and more).


Get on the right Track! 🚆


Join us and start to play an active role in sustainability by developing modes of transport for a greener future!

title: Sr Software Engineer

Georgia-Pacific's Software Engineering & Integration (SE&I) team is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer to help solve environmental and sustainability challenges through modern software engineering, AI, and data-driven decision making.

You will partner with Environmental business leaders, engineers, and compliance teams to take ideas that prove their value and make them systems Georgia-Pacific can operate at scale. You will work alongside environmental subject matter experts on problems such as permit intelligence, compliance workflows, data quality, environmental reporting, and AI-powered agents - and help take those capabilities from a first working version to enterprise scale.

This role is based at our HQ in Atlanta, GA with an expectation of three (3) days in the office per week.

Our Team

We are software engineers, data practitioners, and business technologists focused on how Environmental capabilities are delivered across Georgia-Pacific.

Through our cobuilder operating model, environmental business partners help create solutions, while engineers provide architecture, governance, and the path to scale. We use AI, cloud, data platforms, and reusable enterprise assets to move faster without giving up cybersecurity, compliance, or architectural integrity. title: Interdisciplinary Research Program Manager
description:
NOTE: This position is a Term appointment for up to two years depending on funding.

Reporting to the Director of the Center for Green Buildings and Cities, who serves as the project's Principal Investigator, the Interdisciplinary Research Program Manager supports the coordination and success of this interdisciplinary research initiative, working closely with the project's co-PIs. The Program Manager organizes weekly meetings to ensure regular progress updates, cross-team alignment, and timely course corrections, and serves as a central point of communication across the project's three integrated research thrusts: advanced thermal materials, intelligent building-scale systems, and cooperative urban-scale energy management.

The Program Manager tracks project metrics and sponsor reporting deadlines, and is responsible for the project's major written outputs, including the annual report to sponsors. In addition to supporting integration across disciplines, the Program Manager supports the PI and co-PIs in developing and maintaining relationships with industry partners, ensuring that practical insights from the field inform the design and scalable deployment of project innovations. The role also coordinates the preparation and submission of proposals for extramural funding, helping to sustain and expand the project's research and implementation efforts.

This role is essential to advancing the project's mission of scaling HouseZero®-inspired innovations into interconnected, energy-efficient communities and delivering impactful, real-world solutions to climate challenges.

TYPICAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Cross-Team Coordination (35%): Organize and lead weekly meetings across the project's three research thrusts, and coordinate meetings with the PI and co-PIs three to four times per year; collect progress updates from team members, track deliverables against project timelines, and escalate issues requiring PI and co-PI decisions.

Stakeholder and Industry Engagement (20%): Support the PI and co-PIs in developing and maintaining relationships with industry partners and external stakeholders; manage ongoing communications and follow-up, coordinate partner meetings and site visits, and channel practical field insights into research and deployment planning.

Metrics and Progress Tracking (20%): Develop and maintain metrics for project success; monitor performance against milestones and communicate progress to the PI, co-PIs, and other stakeholders; manage sponsor reporting deadlines and compliance requirements.

Annual Report and White Paper (15%): Write the annual report to project sponsors, collecting contributions from across the research teams and integrating them into a unified document with an overall synthesis of the year's findings; coordinate the project's overall white paper by collecting input from research teams and managing contributors through drafting and review.

Proposal Development (10%): Coordinate preparation and timely submission of proposals for extramural funding, including managing internal deadlines, assembling contributor materials, and liaising with the Office for Sponsored Programs.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • There are no supervisory responsibilities associated with this position

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Applicants must be able to perform typical office tasks, including sitting for extended periods, using standard office equipment, and occasionally lifting up to 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This is an in-person role based in Cambridge, MA. The work is mainly performed in an office setting.
  • Candidates must have employment authorization to work in the US, and we regret that we cannot sponsor a VISA.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

The health of our workforce is a priority for Harvard University. With that in mind, we strongly encourage all employees to be up-to-date on CDC-recommended vaccines.

Please note that to be considered for this position, a cover letter and resume are required with the submission of your application.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Doctorate degree in engineering, architecture, urban planning, environmental science, energy systems, or a closely related interdisciplinary field.
  • Experience leading or coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder research initiatives, particularly those involving sustainability, climate resilience, or urban systems.
  • Proven ability to synthesize interdisciplinary research and produce accessible technical and non-technical reports.
  • Strong leadership, facilitation, and organizational skills; experience managing collaborative teams and meetings.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including grant writing and report preparation.
  • Familiarity with extramural funding processes and experience coordinating successful proposals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across disciplinary boundaries and with external industry partners.

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

  • Subject matter knowledge in one or more of the initiative’s core focus areas: advanced thermal materials, intelligent building-scale systems, or urban-scale energy management.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary or systems-level research at the nexus of building design, sustainable technologies, and urban development.
  • Familiarity with real-world implementation of research-based innovations in the built environment.
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 17.5 hours per week

title: Data Scientist II
description:
JOB SUMMARY

PODS operations already run on data, and the planners and field leaders making the calls on positioning, routing, and capacity are good at it. Operations Data Science & AI is a new team built to turn that expertise into automated, optimized decision systems that run continuously, in every market.

As a Data Scientist on the team, you will report to the Director, Operations Data Science & AI and partner with engineers and operational stakeholders to develop optimization models, predictive models, and automated workflows. Your work will help PODS make better decisions across capacity planning, routing, scheduling, resource allocation, and other field operations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop optimization solutions:
    • Build and support optimization models for capacity planning, routing, scheduling, and resource allocation.
    • Formulate business problems using decision variables, objectives, and operational constraints.
    • Assist in root-cause analysis to surface optimization and automation opportunities across field operations.
  • Develop predictive models:
    • Build, test, and maintain forecasting, regression, classification, and anomaly-detection models for operational problems.
    • Prepare and validate data, engineer features, and evaluate model results.
  • Build and automate workflows:
    • Build reproducible data pipelines and automate recurring analyses, model runs, and reporting, replacing manual processes.
    • Contribute to shared tooling, frameworks, and standards so that solutions are repeatable.
  • Develop analytical assets and data models:
    • Maintain data models in Snowflake that other analysts and downstream tools rely on.
    • Create dashboards and decision-support tools that make results actionable.
  • Document and communicate clearly:
    • Document logic, methodology, and assumptions alongside every model, tool, or pipeline you build.
    • Present findings and their limitations in plain language to the team and operational stakeholders.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS: Essential Skills, Abilities and Example Behavior(s)

  • Mathematical optimization: Hands-on experience formulating and solving mixed-integer linear programming models, including defining decision variables, objectives, and constraints.
  • Optimization tools: Previous experience with Gurobi, Pyomo, OR-Tools, PuLP, CPLEX, or a similar optimization library or solver is required.
  • SQL and Python fluency: Strong SQL on a modern cloud data warehouse, preferably Snowflake, and Python for analysis and model development.
  • Applied machine learning: Experience building, testing, and validating forecasting, regression, classification, or other predictive models, with judgment about which method fits the problem.
  • Workflow automation: Experience building reproducible data pipelines and automating recurring analyses and model workflows.
  • Data visualization: Ability to communicate analytical and model outputs through clear visualizations and practical decision-support tools.
  • Communication and documentation: Ability to explain methods and results clearly and document work so that it is reproducible and reviewable.
  • Structure amid ambiguity: Ability to turn loosely defined operational problems into clear analytical questions and practical solutions.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS: Education & Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related field required; master’s degree preferred
  • 3+ years of applied data science, machine learning, or quantitative analytics experience. Relevant internship, co-op, or graduate research may count toward experience.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL on a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred) and with Python for analysis.
  • Experience or coursework in machine learning and mathematical optimization, with exposure to cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake or AWS.
  • Experience supporting an Operations, Supply Chain, logistics, or other capacity-constrained business is a plus.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to sit at a desk and use a computer for up to 8 hours a day; Ability to use hands and fingers to type on a keyboard and use a mouse to navigate; Vision sufficient to view small details on a computer monitor
  • Ability to stand and walk up to 8 hours a day; ability to stoop, bend and lift boxes weighing up to 50 lbs.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Travel requirements: Negligible
  • Climate-controlled office environment during normal business hours.
  • Regular attendance and punctuality required
  • May be subject to pre-employment criminal background check and/or drug screening as well as random drug screenings in accordance with company policy

This will include involvement in a full project cycle including creation of the project, managing progress and risks, overseeing expense claim submission and ensuring reporting requirements are met.

The successful candidate will work alongside other members of the AGE-WELL and envisAGE teams to meet the diverse project management and implementation needs of our project collaborators and other network members. title: Research and Instruction Librarian
description:
Working as part of the Research & Instruction team, the Research & Instruction Librarian assists and instructs users in the effective use of biomedical information resources and databases.

The primary functions are to

  1. Support the educational missions of the Harvard Medical School, the Harvard School of Dental Medicine, and the Chan Harvard School of Public Health by providing curricular and extracurricular instruction and training, and
  2. to support the research missions of these same institutions by providing research and reference services over a broad range of subject domains.

The responsibilities of the Research and Instruction Librarian include:

Education

  • Develops and implements educational programs in support of graduate programs at the Harvard Medical School, Harvard School of Dental Medicine, and Chan School of Public Health.
  • Subject matter experience in evidence-based medicine, public health, dentistry, and/or healthcare delivery.
  • Instructs students and clinical faculty on using point of care resources.
  • Keeps abreast of current developments in clinical research methods, evidence-based clinical practice and medical education.
  • Provides instruction to Harvard-affiliated researches in the use of biological, genetic, and genomics databases.
  • Provides instruction in literature-based research methods and databases searching.
  • Provides training support to the larger academic community for information discovery and retrieval, systematic literature reviews, and in the use of specialized writing and bibliographic tools such as EndNote, Covidence, and Zotero.
  • Designs and creates online educational materials to support both curricular and extracurricular training in the use of information sources.
  • Contribute to the creation of online learning tools for resource discovery, literature searching, citation management, and the Countway FAQ. Provide recorded orientation and training sessions.
  • Provides instruction about generative AI tool usage including use cases, ethical considerations, and limitations.

Research Support

  • Provide support to Harvard faculty in producing high-quality systematic literature searches to support the creation of comprehensive and evidence synthesis reviews.
  • Consult in the development of research questions, creating appropriate research designs, and designing carrying out literature searches in a variety of electronic databases.
  • Provide reference assistance to Harvard-affiliated investigators as needed in the areas of biological sciences, clinical medicine, public health, and health and public health data resources.

Collection Development

  • Investigates, evaluates, and implements new information technology resources and tools.
  • Participates in the selection of resources to support the educational and research missions of the institutions the Countway serves.

Administrative Service

  • Participates in needs assessment, strategic planning, and program development.
  • Represents the Countway Library on appropriate Harvard Library committees, task forces, and project teams to support the larger mission of the Harvard Library.

As part of your application, we recommend including a cover letter that will help us better understand your qualifications and background. This can provide valuable insight into your experience and interest in the role.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in library/information science from an ALA-accredited institution or advanced degree in the health sciences or a health-related field.
  • 3 or more years’ experience in an academic health sciences or biomedical library.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Active involvement/interest in professional associations and scholarship.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and instructional skills.
  • Able to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • High degree of organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated initiative, the ability to manage multiple projects and a commitment to professional development.
  • Knowledge of principles and practices of Evidence-Based Medicine and the Systematic Review process.
  • Knowledge of structure and usage of biomedical databases including but not limited to PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, Web of Science, PsycINFO, CINAHL, and point-of-care tools such as DynaMedex/DynaAI.
  • Service-centered orientation and the ability to build and sustain relationships.
  • Possess excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience working with diverse groups to reach common goals.
  • Flexibility and adaptability for work in an evolving, fast-paced environment.
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week

title: Business / Industry Co-Founder (f/m/d) role at startup GUARDSPHERE
description:
GUARDSPHERE
Saarbrücken, Germany | On-site | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / OT & Industrial Cybersecurity

About GuardSphere
GuardSphere protects factories, energy plants and critical infrastructure from cyberattacks without ever stopping production. Its product, NeuroX Shield, passively watches a plant's industrial network, learns normal behavior, and lets operators respond to threats safely and gradually — built for mid-sized German manufacturers and utilities who can't afford downtime and have no in-house security specialist.

**The opportunity
**Founded around Farah Elshenawy (7 years in penetration testing, OSCP, MSc Entrepreneurial Cybersecurity at Saarland University/CISPA) and machine-learning lead Nazligul Kese, GuardSphere has validated its prototype with 47+ industry professionals across 6 industrial events and secured €800k in StartupSecure funding. What's missing is the commercial engine to turn validated R&D into revenue. We are looking for a Business / Industry co-founder specialized in OT security go-to-market, GuardSphere is separately also open to a CTO / software co-founder with OT/ICS development experience.

Tasks

What you will own

**Go-to-market & sales
**- Build GuardSphere's route into German manufacturing and utilities, converting strong customer interest (47+ contacts across 6 events) into pilots and paying customers.
- Bridge NeuroX Shield's technical capabilities with the budget and risk-appetite decision cycle of Plant Managers and CISOs.
Commercial strategy
- Understand and navigate industrial procurement processes, budgets and buying decisions in OT/manufacturing.
- Own pricing, packaging and commercial positioning as the prototype becomes a repeatable product.
Company build-up
- Lead incorporation (planned mid-2027) and support fundraising alongside Farah Elshenawy (Project Lead / CEO track).

Requirements

What you bring

**Core experience
**- Business development or sales experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, industrial automation, or a closely related B2B industrial technology field.
- Understanding of German manufacturing and utilities procurement, budgets and decision cycles.
Especially valuable
- Existing network among Plant Managers, CISOs or OT security buyers.
- Familiarity with IEC 62443 and industrial compliance standards.
- GuardSphere is separately seeking a CTO/Developer co-founder, hands-on OT/ICS software development experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join GuardSphere
- A prototype already validated through 47+ customer conversations and 6 industrial events, real market pull, not just a hypothesis.
- €800k in non-dilutive StartupSecure funding already secured.
- Ground-floor equity in a company addressing a growing, regulation-driven market (IEC 62443, rising OT/ICS attack surface).

GuardSphere welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

description:

What Makes You Stand Out

• Understanding of data engineering concepts, including pipelines, data models, testing, monitoring, and data quality.

• Strong ability to design, build, test, and maintain robust ETL pipelines, data transformation workflows, and feature datasets.
