title: Staff Cloud Architect L4
description:
Staff Cloud Architect

APPLICATIONS FROM OUTSIDE CANADA & THE US WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE

6 month contract

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Staff Cloud Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-domain systems spanning cloud, data, and AI. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who can define technical strategy, own end-to-end architecture for major engagements, and provide technical leadership across teams.

In this role, you will work as a delivery-embedded technical leader on cross-functional teams, defining architecture across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads. You’ll act as a technical escalation point on complex challenges, mentor mid-level engineers, partner with leadership on technical direction, and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and built to last.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Define technical strategy and lead architectural design across cloud, data, and AI/ML systems for end-to-end engagements
  • Architect scalable cloud-native solutions, including multi-cloud and hybrid strategies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes)
  • Design data architectures including warehouses, data lakes, and pipelines for batch and streaming workloads (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka)
  • Design AI/ML systems including model serving, MLOps pipelines, feature stores, and LLM-based applications (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face)
  • Define infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and DevOps standards across engagements (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions)
  • Drive performance, scalability, cost, and reliability optimization across deployed systems
  • Ensure architecture meets security, governance, and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Lead cloud migrations and platform modernization initiatives
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with leadership and clients on technical direction, translating business goals into architectural decisions
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders alike
  • Engage closely with engineering, data, AI, and product teams to align architecture with broader business priorities
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, standards, and guidelines

Leadership & Influence

  • Establish architectural standards and best practices that lift quality and consistency across the team
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, helping them grow their architectural thinking and craft
  • Act as a technical escalation point on complex architectural and integration challenges
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend tools, frameworks, and patterns that improve architecture over time

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in architecture or technical leadership roles
  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms and cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Strong background in microservices, serverless, containers, and event-driven systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, Lambda, EventBridge)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code and CI/CD (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, GitHub Actions)
  • Strong data architecture expertise across relational, NoSQL, and big data systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka)
  • Hands-on experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, dbt)
  • Strong experience designing AI/ML systems for production, including LLMs, MLOps, and model serving (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Solid understanding of networking, security, identity, and access management in cloud environments
  • Experience with governance, compliance, and observability frameworks
  • Strong software engineering skills (Python, APIs, containerization)
  • Demonstrated leadership and technical mentoring experience
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate technical depth across audiences
  • Demonstrable usage of AI-forward tools such as Claude and Cursor
  • Multi-cloud architecture experience, AI ethics or responsible AI experience, or enterprise architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP) is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $53. - $74 per hour. CAD. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

title: Data Engineer (Porto ou Lisboa, 6y-9y)
description:
🚀 About the Role

We are looking for a Senior GCP Data Engineer to support a strategic data transformation and cloud migration initiative.

In this role, you will help migrate databases, ETL processes, and analytical workloads from SQL Server to Google Cloud Platform, designing a modern, scalable, and cost-efficient data ecosystem powered by BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Python.

You will work closely with Database Administrators, Data Engineers, Analysts, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to understand the existing environment, rebuild critical data flows, and ensure a smooth transition to the new cloud platform.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong data engineering expertise with hands-on cloud migration experience and enjoys solving complex data, performance, and integration challenges.

Your Mission

As a Senior GCP Data Engineer, you will:

  • Contribute to the migration of data and ETL processes from SQL Server to GCP.
  • Design and build scalable data pipelines using modern cloud technologies.
  • Develop optimized data models and queries for BigQuery.
  • Automate migration, transformation, validation, and integration activities using Python.
  • Guarantee data quality, integrity, performance, and operational reliability throughout the migration.
  • Help establish engineering standards and best practices for the new GCP data platform.
  • Support teams and end users during the transition to the cloud environment.

Key Responsibilities

Data & Database Migration

  • Contribute to the design and execution of the migration strategy from SQL Server to Google Cloud Platform.
  • Analyze existing databases, ETL workflows, stored procedures, dependencies, and data structures.
  • Develop migration scripts and pipelines to transfer and transform data into BigQuery.
  • Rebuild or adapt existing SQL Server processes for a cloud-native data architecture.
  • Support migration planning, technical assessments, testing, reconciliation, and production deployment.
  • Ensure data consistency and integrity before, during, and after migration.
  • Identify migration risks, technical dependencies, and potential performance issues.

GCP Data Pipeline Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust ETL and ELT pipelines on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Replace or modernize existing data flows using scalable cloud services.
  • Build reusable components and standardized pipeline patterns.
  • Ensure pipelines are reliable, maintainable, observable, and performance-oriented.
  • Implement appropriate retry, recovery, logging, and error-handling mechanisms.
  • Support both batch processing and data integration use cases.

Workflow Orchestration

  • Create, schedule, monitor, and maintain workflows using Google Cloud Composer.
  • Design and manage DAGs for migration, transformation, and integration processes.
  • Define dependencies, execution schedules, retries, alerts, and failure-handling processes.
  • Troubleshoot orchestration issues and optimize workflow execution.
  • Ensure reliable operationalization of pipelines across development, testing, and production environments.

BigQuery Engineering & Optimization

  • Design and implement scalable data structures in BigQuery.
  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries for analytical and transformation workloads.
  • Adapt T-SQL logic and existing SQL Server processes to BigQuery SQL.
  • Apply BigQuery optimization techniques, including:Partitioning
  • Clustering
  • Query optimization
  • Storage optimization
  • Cost-efficient processing
  • Monitor query performance and resource consumption.
  • Contribute to the design of cloud data models aligned with business and analytical requirements.

Python Development & Automation

  • Develop Python scripts for:Data migration
  • Data transformation
  • Data reconciliation
  • Test data preparation
  • Process automation
  • Integration with GCP services and APIs
  • Build reusable and maintainable Python components.
  • Automate repetitive migration and operational activities.
  • Support the development of validation and monitoring utilities.
  • Apply software engineering best practices, including code reviews, version control, testing, and documentation.

Data Quality & Validation

  • Implement data quality controls throughout the migration lifecycle.
  • Develop automated reconciliation processes between source and target systems.
  • Validate data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  • Define tests for migrated tables, transformations, pipelines, and business rules.
  • Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate their resolution.
  • Ensure that the new platform produces reliable and trusted data for its users.

Monitoring, Support & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor data pipelines, scheduled workflows, and production processes.
  • Investigate and resolve pipeline failures, data issues, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Support debugging and incident resolution during the migration and after production deployment.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective measures.
  • Improve platform observability, alerts, operational procedures, and support documentation.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Support

  • Work closely with SQL Server administrators and existing technical teams to understand the current ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and business teams to gather data requirements.
  • Ensure that the new GCP platform meets functional, analytical, and operational expectations.
  • Participate in technical design sessions, code reviews, and testing activities.
  • Communicate migration progress, risks, dependencies, and technical decisions clearly.
  • Support knowledge transfer and the adoption of the new cloud data platform.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay informed about GCP data engineering capabilities and cloud migration practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Propose new tools, patterns, and automation opportunities for the data platform.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and reusable development practices.
  • Help establish a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.

✅ What We’re Looking For

Mandatory Requirements

  • Strong professional experience in Data Engineering.
  • Advanced knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, particularly its data services.
  • Significant hands-on experience with BigQuery, including:Data modeling
  • Schema design
  • Complex SQL development
  • Partitioning and clustering
  • Query performance optimization
  • Cost management
  • Strong experience with Google Cloud Composer.
  • Hands-on experience creating, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging DAGs.
  • Excellent SQL skills and the ability to adapt existing SQL workloads to BigQuery.
  • Advanced Python skills for data engineering, automation, and GCP integration.
  • Experience designing and building ETL or ELT pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of database and data migration methodologies.
  • Ability to analyze legacy or on-premises environments and redesign them for the cloud.

Performance & Cost Optimization

Quality & Delivery

title: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Business Analyst
description:
Nemours Children's Health is seeking an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Business Analyst to join our team in either Jacksonville, Florida, Orlando, Florida, Pensacola, Florida or Wilmington Delaware.

This is a hybrid position

The Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Business Analyst will support the implementation, optimization, and ongoing administration of enterprise financial and operational systems, including Oracle Fusion Cloud and Strata. This position serves as a key liaison between Information Systems and business stakeholders, translating business requirements into scalable technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and organizational decision-making. The position described in the job description supports Oracle Cloud Healthcare Suite and Strata Suite modules and is responsible for workflow analysis, reporting, testing, documentation, issue resolution, and system improvement initiatives.

The ERP Business Analyst will play a critical role in supporting financial system optimization initiatives, enterprise reporting, research grants reporting, supplier management processes, and strategic implementation efforts. This role combines business analysis, functional system expertise, reporting and analytics, testing, and customer support to deliver high-quality solutions that meet organizational needs.

Essential Functions:

ERP Functional Support and Optimization
  • Serve as a functional analyst and subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion Cloud and Strata applications.
  • Analyze business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, and data quality.
  • Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Research, Human Resources, and operational departments to gather and document requirements.
  • Recommend and support configuration changes, enhancements, and new functionality.
  • Participate in system upgrades, patch testing, regression testing, and production deployments.
  • Support enterprise initiatives including Chart of Accounts optimization and financial system enhancements.

Reporting and Analytics
  • Design, develop, validate, and maintain enterprise reports, dashboards, and analytics using Oracle Fusion and StrataJazz reporting tools.
  • Support operational, financial, and research grant reporting requirements across the organization.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to define reporting needs and deliver meaningful analytics that support decision-making.
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues and ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency and promote self-service reporting capabilities.

Project and Implementation Support
  • Support implementation and optimization projects related to Oracle Fusion, Strata, supplier management solutions, and related enterprise applications.
  • Lead or participate in requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, testing, training, and go-live support activities.
  • Assist with change management, communication planning, and user adoption efforts.
  • Develop and maintain project documentation, process flows, and training materials.

Customer Support and Relationship Management
  • Provide functional support and troubleshooting assistance for end users.
  • Research and resolve application issues while coordinating with technical teams and vendors when appropriate.
  • Build strong partnerships with stakeholders and serve as a trusted advisor for system capabilities and best practices.
  • Participate in change control processes and governance activities.

Job Requirements
  • Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 5 years experience OR Associate's Degree with a minimum of 10-15 years related work experience required.
  • Strong business operations experience with emphasis on the selected/assigned module required.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional and technical specifications.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, analytics, or business intelligence solutions.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software implementations or major enhancement initiatives.
  • Oracle Fusion Certifications preferred.
  • Business Analysis certifications such as CBAP or PMI-PBA preferred.

Preferred Experience
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud applications.
  • Experience with Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI), BI Publisher, Oracle Analytics, or similar reporting platforms.
  • Experience with Strata or healthcare financial planning and reporting solutions.
  • Experience supporting research grants, project accounting, healthcare finance, or supply chain operations.
  • Experience with chart of accounts design, financial reporting structures, or enterprise data governance initiatives.

#LI-EP1

About Us

Nemours Children's Health is an internationally recognized pediatric health system serving more than 1.7 million patient encounters each year. We deliver care across six states through two freestanding children's hospitals - Nemours Children's Hospital, Delaware and Nemours Children's Hospital, Florida - along with a network of more than 80 primary, urgent, and specialty care practices and more than 40 hospital partnerships.

Backed by the Nemours Foundation and Alfred I. duPont Trust, our $1.7B nonprofit system is dedicated to improving children's health through clinical care, research, education, advocacy, and prevention. Our Whole Child Health approach focuses equally on prevention and treatment, partnering with communities to help every child thrive.

Inclusion and belonging guide our strategy and growth. We are committed to culturally relevant care, reducing health disparities, and fostering an environment where every associate, patient, and family feels supported and valued.

Learn more at Nemours.org .

title: CCMC Activities Coordinator
description:
POSITION PURPOSE: Activities are an essential aspect of dementia care. The primary purpose of the Activities Coordinator is to plan, develop, organize, implement, evaluate, and direct individual and group ACTIVITY PROGRAMS and to provide training and resources to facilitate the involvement of all staff in the provision of appropriate planned and spontaneous activities. The Activities Coordinator is responsible to ensure the activity programs are in accordance with current existing Federal, State and Local standards, as well as established policies and procedures. Activities shall be planned and facilitated that take into consideration individual abilities and disabilities and assure that the spiritual, diversional, emotional, recreational and social needs and preferences of each resident is met and/or maintained.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following:


  • Demonstrates good faith effort to support, maintain, and improve the overall well-being of
  • residents and a positive work environment for employees.


  • Demonstrates knowledge, interest, and skills in the provision of care for persons with dementia.


  • Assesses each resident’s abilities and disabilities, likes and dislikes, preferences, past habits and
  • experiences to evaluate appropriate activities for the resident.


Communicates individual resident activity interests, preferences, potential and activity possibilities to all staff and volunteers.

Works with family/interested others to develop a visual and written life-story for each resident within seven days of admission.

  • Maintains a working knowledge of activities appropriate for individuals with dementia.


  • Participates in resident service planning.


  • Acquire and maintains a selection of supplies to promote a variety of activities.


  • Operates from the premise that everything is and can be an activity.


  • Provides on-going training for staff on ways to engage residents in appropriate, useful and

meaningful activities.

Ensures a program of both individual and group activities based on the needs, interests and abilities of the resident(s) are available. A balance of recreational activities including physical, social, religious, and arts and crafts, diversional and intellectual is preferred.


Communicates and promotes staff communications of activity offerings to residents through monthly calendar, daily postings, announcements, etc.


Works effectively with other staff and secures their support for activities.


Provides for seasonal art/decorations/etc. to support recognition of environment and holidays.


Recruits, orientates, and supervises the volunteer program. Ensures volunteers are used effectively to supplement the activities program.


Identifies and purchases items needed for activities.


Works with Administrator to provide support for family members and responsible parties through group interaction and educational opportunities.


Assist in the development of the department budget and monitor expenditures to control expenses.


Recruit and coordinate community groups in an organized, safe, and reciprocally beneficial experience for visiting groups and residents.


  • Effectively utilizes activity space – outdoor space, theme rooms, etc. – to promote resident involvement.


  • When receptionist is absent, performs receptionist duties including welcoming tasks, greeting and directing public and providing tours.


NON ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS include the following:


  • All duties are essential.

Exposure to Blood/Body fluids is possible.

title: Environmental Testing Engineer
description:

  • Prepare internal and customer validation reports, test documentation, and technical presentations.

  • Prepare and document test software and support the use of laboratory testing systems.
  • Plan and coordinate the procurement of test adapters, jigs, fixtures, and cables.

  • Support Production and Quality teams in investigating and resolving test-related issues and customer claims.
  • Open and follow up Jira tickets related to test non-conformities and coordinate actions with the Development team.
  • Participate in customer meetings and project team meetings to align test plans and communicate test progress.
  • Ensure proper documentation and archiving of test and validation results.
  • Collaborate with other KOSTAL laboratories and internal departments to support testing activities.
  • Comply with company requirements related to quality, health, safety, and environmental protection.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in testing, validation, laboratory activities, engineering, quality, or the automotive industry is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of environmental, validation, endurance, and life testing is desirable.
  • Basic knowledge of quality tools and methodologies.
  • Basic understanding of automotive testing standards and customer requirements.
  • Basic knowledge of bus communication systems is an advantage.
  • Basic programming skills and ability to work with test software.
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar project/issue management tools is an advantage.
  • Experience with laboratory equipment and test systems is a plus.
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the Role The Azure Data & Integration Architect will lead enterprise-wide data and integration initiatives, leveraging Microsoft Azure and Databricks to drive digital transformation, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. This role focuses on architecting scalable data pipelines, designing a unified lakehouse platform, enabling advanced analytics, and integrating enterprise systems across SAP and non-SAP landscapes. Key Responsibilities Data Architecture & Analytics Implement Unity Catalog for governance, data lineage, and access control. Design and deploy enterprise data models and analytical layers using Azure. Enable enterprise reporting and self-service analytics through Power BI integration. Manage both structured and unstructured data using Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2. Collaborate with data scientists and business teams to enable machine learning and predictive analytics use cases. Define and enforce data architecture standards, naming conventions, and performance best practices. Integration & Enterprise Connectivity Design and implement integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP CPI, Azure API Management, and REST/SOAP APIs. Ensure secure and scalable data flow across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Implement API authentication and security protocols (OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML). Integrate enterprise applications with Azure Entra ID for identity and access management. Establish reusable integration patterns and frameworks for enterprise-wide adoption. Governance, Security & Compliance Ensure data quality, lineage, and governance across the analytics ecosystem. Implement security and compliance controls aligned with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and corporate IT policies. Monitor cost and performance optimization across Azure services. Oversee DevOps and CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and testing using Azure DevOps. Leadership & Collaboration Collaborate closely with cross-functional IT, data, and business teams. Conduct technical design reviews, mentor developers, and ensure adherence to architectural standards. Support vendor evaluations, solution assessments, and proof-of-concept initiatives. Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to senior management and business stakeholders. Education & Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. MBA is a plus. Mandatory Requirements Minimum 6+ years of experience in data analytics, engineering, and enterprise integration. Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale data platforms on Azure. Strong hands-on expertise in Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog). Proficiency in Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, Blob Storage, and Data Lake Gen2. Experience integrating SAP systems (S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, MES, LIMS, CRM) with Azure and other platforms. Proficient in integration technologies (SAP CPI, Azure API Management, middleware platforms). Deep understanding of data security and identity protocols (OAuth, JWT, SAML) and Azure Entra ID. Familiarity with GxP-compliant data handling and governance practices. Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL, hands on experience in writing clean, efficient and scalable code Desirable Requirements Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory environments. Exposure to Azure DevOps, Terraform, or ARM templates for infrastructure automation. Knowledge of modern data architecture principles (Lakehouse, Data Mesh, ELT). Experience with Agentic AI, preferably using Microsoft AI technologies Preferred Certifications Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert Microsoft Certified: Data Engineer Associate Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate Preferred Industry Experience Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Regulated Environments (GxP, FDA, ISO)

title: Biomedical Scientist
description:
NHS Band 5 Salary: £32,073 - £39,043 per annum

Hours Per Week: 37.5 full time

Contract Type: 3 X Permanent

We are seeking an enthusiastic and reliable Specialist Biomedical Scientist to join our histology team who will carry out laboratory investigations on samples of tissue to aid in the diagnosis and treatment of our patients

The Histopathology department at Portsmouth Hospitals University NHS Trust processes around 43,000 cases, generating ~350,000 slides per year. We are UKAS accredited against ISO 15189 standards and we hold training laboratory status from the IBMS and support training where appropriate.

In addition to routine histology processing, the department undertakes immunohistochemistry, manual and automated special staining, frozen section and immunofluorescence, renal, liver and lung biopsy work and digital pathology.

Key Responsibilities

The post holder will be expected to participate in the following activities:

  • Specimen reception and specimen requesting
  • Decalcification, X-ray, and Bandsaw use
  • Cut up assist and BMS transfers
  • Processing specimens
  • Embedding
  • Microtomy
  • H&E Staining
  • Internal Quality Control
  • Special staining
  • Immunohistochemistry
  • Molecular referrals
  • Digital Pathology (Sectra PACS, using 3DHISTECH P1000 and P250 scanners)
  • Laboratory Information Management System (Clinisys WPE)

For full job details and person specification please refer to enclosed job description.

Essential

  • An accredited BSc Biomedical Science or equivalent.
  • Current Registration as a Biomedical Scientist with the Health and Care Professions Council.

Desirable

  • Member of the IBMS

Experience

  • Previous experience of working in a histopathology laboratory.
  • Be computer literate especially with the handling of data.
  • Experience in specimen dissection and renal/liver/lung biopsy preparation.
  • Experience with quality management and audit.
  • Knowledge of DATIX and iPassport.
  • Experience with digital pathology.
  • Experience in service improvement.
  • Evidence of CPD

Skills & Knowledge

  • The ability to work using own initiative and without supervision.
  • The ability to deal with colleagues bringing in samples for processing and to field enquiries.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Evidence of good manual dexterity and hand eye coordination.
  • Demonstration of good organisational skills
  • Demonstration of good interpersonal skills.
  • Conscientious, methodical approach to duties
  • The ability to interact directly with colleagues bringing in samples in a sensitive and respectful manner.
  • An understanding of the political sensitivities of the Trust
  • Ability to demonstrate confidentiality and trustworthiness.
  • A willingness to be flexible and part of a team.
  • Ability to demonstrate a high degree of concentration and attention to detail.
  • Deal calmly and politely with members of hospital staff who are working in areas of extreme pressure.
  • Ability to juggle many priorities at one time, whilst remaining calm
  • Prepared to handle clinical samples.

The health and wellbeing of our staff is at the forefront of everything we do. We are proud to be able to offer our staff some fantastic benefits including our on-site Nursery, access to our free Beach Hut for those long summer days, our on-site Wellness Centre including a gym and a swimming pool, access to our fantastic staff networks including LGBTQ, Race Equality and DisAbility, and awards ceremonies to recognise your achievements. We believe we can offer support to all of our staff when they need it the most.

title: Engineering Excellence Sr Lead Software Engineer
description:

description:

Premiere Healthcare Staffing is here to help you on your career journey! We place talented candidates with our partner healthcare facilities with the shared goal of providing exceptional, compassionate care.

  • Award-winning hospital partners across the nation

Responsibilities

Under the direction and authorization of the medical director and cardiopulmonary director, the RRT is responsible for performing respiratory therapeutic and pulmonary diagnostic procedures as ordered by the physician. Emphasis will be toward the assessment, planning, implementation and documentation of care, with consideration of age and population specific needs and requirements of the patient. 3. Basic Life Support (BLS) certified from the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross (ARC) upon hire and maintain current.

title: Director of Special Projects - Finance
description:
About the role

This role sits in the Office of the CFO, and it is not a conventional finance role. Finance holds much of what IFS knows about itself: cost structure, unit economics, how the plan was built and where it has drifted. Most of the decisions that evidence should shape sit somewhere else, in Sales, Services, R&D and Operations. Connecting the two is the job.

You will lead a small number of substantial cross-functional projects each year and advise on several more. The work moves between transformation and analysis: redesigning how we plan and allocate, building the models and reporting leadership needs to see the business clearly, designing operating models and governance that hold up in practice, and working out where AI genuinely changes how finance and its partner functions work.

The portfolio changes with what the company needs. What stays constant is the shape of the problem. It crosses functions, nobody owns it yet, and the people involved do not start out

agreeing. A meaningful part of the work runs through external consulting partners, so you will be directing teams you do not employ about as often as teams you do.

Why this role?

Many roles at this level are either functional ownership or advice. This is neither. You take a problem from framing through analysis, decision and implementation, and you stay with it long enough to find out whether it worked.

You get direct access to the CFO and the executive team, a small team on your projects, and responsibility for outcomes rather than documents. IFS has grown quickly, organically and through acquisition, so there is real work to do on how the company plans, allocates and decides. This is not a tidy system to maintain.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead initiatives end to end. Frame the problem, build the workplan, run the analysis, drive to a decision with senior stakeholders and stay through implementation. You will not hand over a deck and move on.

• Diagnose how the business actually runs. Through interviews, workshops and time in the data, establish how a process really works rather than how it is documented, where cost and effort sit, and which decisions are being made on weak evidence or not being made at all.

• Design the future state. Process, structure, roles, governance and a transition plan someone can follow, built with the teams who have to live with it rather than presented to them.

• Connect finance, data and operations. Translate across financial logic, the data that describes the business and operational reality: cost structure to process design, forecast variance to capacity decisions, margin pressure to where the work actually happens. Work with Data and Technology teams so the numbers behind those links can be trusted.

• Improve the evidence behind decisions. Define the metrics, models and reporting leadership needs, retire what it does not, and make sure assumptions can be inspected and argued with.

• Scope and manage external consulting partners. Write the brief and scope of work, evaluate proposals, direct day-to-day delivery, hold external teams to a standard, integrate their output with internal work, control spend against the value delivered, and bring the knowledge back in house when the engagement ends.

• Lead blended teams. Run internal, cross-functional and third-party teams without formal authority over most of them. The role may carry direct reports over time.

• Shape where AI belongs in this work. Finance and its partner functions have no shortage of candidate use cases across planning, forecasting, close, procurement and workforce processes. The useful contribution is judgment: what is worth building, in what order, who owns it afterward, and where a human check has to stay. IFS holds its internal AI adoption to the same standard as the software it sells.

In your first six months: take one significant cross-functional problem from framing to a decision the executive team has signed off, with an implementation plan and a named owner. Alongside it, produce a clear read on how one core planning or allocation process works today and what should change.

What you'll bring

You are comfortable being handed a broad question and a group of stakeholders who do not agree, and turning that into a recommendation people act on. You care as much about whether the change held as about whether the analysis was right.

We are not looking for a controller, an FP&A manager or an accountant. You do need to be fluent enough in financial logic to hold your own in the CFO organization.

• Six or more years in management consulting, corporate strategy, finance transformation or business operations, with substantial cross-functional exposure. A consulting background fits well, and so does someone who has already left consulting for industry and wants a broader remit than a single function.

• Ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder work from diagnosis through implementation. Not analysis on its own, and not project administration.

• Strong quantitative skills and financial literacy. You can build a model or take one apart, work with messy enterprise data, connect operational drivers to financial results, and say plainly what the numbers do and do not support.

• Experience designing operating models, processes or organizational structures, and seeing them through to implementation.

• Experience working with or inside professional services. You know how an engagement is scoped, priced and staffed, what good delivery looks like, how to get value out of a partner firm and when bringing one in is the wrong answer.

• Executive communication. You can write a one-page recommendation and defend it in front of people who disagree with each other, and run a workshop that ends in a decision rather than another meeting.

Nice to have

• An MBA or comparable advanced degree, or an equivalent record of progression.

• Experience with planning, forecasting or resource allocation processes: how they work, where they break and what it takes to redesign one. Deep FP&A ownership is welcome but not expected.

• Hands-on work on AI strategy or delivery, such as use case prioritization, build, buy or partner decisions, or getting an AI-enabled product into real use. Technical depth is welcome; judgment about what is realistic matters more.

• Working knowledge of SQL, Python or R, and of modern business intelligence and planning tools. You do not need to build the pipeline, but pulling your own data and pressure-testing someone else's analysis will make you faster.

• Enterprise software, or another business with recurring revenue and a substantial services component. Post-acquisition integration or carve-out experience.

• Shared services or center of excellence design, or work in regulated and high-consequence environments where a decision also has to be defensible.

If you have led cross-functional work that ended in a decision someone had to make, and you want a broader problem set than any one function can offer, we would like to hear from you.

What We’re Offering

  • Salary Range: $175,000 - $190,000 plus bonus
  • Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday
  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance
  • 401K with Company contribution
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Life insurance and disability benefits
  • Tuition assistance
  • Community involvement and volunteering events

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

title: Quality Inspector
description:
The Quality Assurance Inspector will be responsible for using proven quality techniques to track, analyze and report on materials, processes and products to assure that they meet the company's quality standards.

Shift: 3rd Shift Monday - Thursday 8:30pm - 7:00am
Pay: Weekly

Responsibilities include:

  • Inspect parts, products and/ or processes to ensure conformance with customer requirements and/or company standards.
  • Verify conformance of materials/ products using appropriate measuring/ inspection instruments including fixed and variable gauges and coordinate measurement systems.
  • Verify job set-up accuracy prior to production operations to ensure product conformity.
  • Use applicable work orders, drawings and similar acceptance criteria to determine final product conformance with applicable requirements and company workmanship standards.
  • Perform dock audits of finished goods as directed to determine outgoing quality level of products with required dimensional, cosmetic, packaging and labeling criteria.
  • Perform first article inspection of products and support company PPAP activities.
  • Perform calibration of basic measuring tools and maintain calibration database.
  • Inspect customer returned material to verify/confirm product non-conformance.
  • Provide technical support to operations and assist in company lean manufacturing/continual improvement initiatives.
  • Perform ISO9001 support activities.

To qualify for consideration an applicant must possess the following skills. Possession of these skills is a prerequisite for employment.

  • Must have 2 years of experience in general warehouse operations
  • Must have current experience performing dimensional inspection of products in a manufacturing environment using basic measuring equipment and coordinate measurement systems.
  • Prior experience working in a quality control or assurance role is preferred.
  • Prepares rejection notices and verifies defects on return material.
  • Must have basic computer skills.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Education: Associates degree in quality engineering, industrial engineering or related field of study preferred. Non-degree candidates with equivalent experience in the following areas may be considered: inspection, machine operation, programming, warehouse supervision, and/or training.

Desirable skills: the following skills are considered important but may be learned on the job.

  • AWS D1.1 welding specification knowledge.
  • Prior experience working in an ISO9001 quality management system.
  • Familiarity working with ASTM, AISI or similar customer specifications.
  • Prior PPAP, FMEA, SPC, and MSA experience.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description


Job Description

We leverage cutting edge Data & Analytics technologies to develop solutions for automated data pipelines.   • Architecture & Design: Design and architect enterprise-grade data analytics solutions, with a strong focus on building scalable cloud infrastructure using AWS. Ensure that the solutions align with industry best practices and organizational goals.
  • Data Pipelines & Validation: Develop and implement effective data pipelines, processes, and validation mechanisms that support enterprise-level data analytics. Ensure these pipelines are resilient, scalable, and optimized for performance.
  • Project Leadership: Lead project teams in setting technical direction for large-scale data initiatives. Demonstrate the ability to guide cross-functional teams in a complex matrix organization to ensure the successful delivery of data and analytics projects.
  • Collaboration & Liaison Role: Serve as the key liaison to overseas HIH resources working across various data and analytics projects. Collaborate with stakeholders across different functions to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Best Practices & Governance: Advocate for and enforce best practices, including data governance, security standards, and guidelines within all projects. Drive adherence to architectural principles while promoting a focus on quality, security, and performance.
  • Attention to Detail: Exhibit a high level of attention to detail when designing systems, ensuring that every component adheres to organizational standards and operates seamlessly.
  • Proactive Mindset & Problem-Solving: Possess a proactive approach, identifying potential challenges and opportunities for optimization. Demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and creatively to develop data and analytic solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, including technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. Communicate clearly and effectively to ensure alignment across all levels of the organization.


Qualifications

Required Skills:

  • Data Architecture & Cloud Infrastructure: Extensive experience in building large-scale cloud infrastructure, particularly in AWS, with deep knowledge of key services such as S3, EC2, Lambda, Redshift, and others.
  • Pipeline & Process Design: Strong background in designing robust data pipelines, validation mechanisms, and workflows that support enterprise-scale data processing and analytics.
  • Software Engineering Principles: Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles. Ability to apply these principles effectively in designing scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Leadership Experience: At least 3 years of experience in a leadership role setting technical direction and guiding project teams through complex projects.
  • Matrix Organization Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience working in complex matrix organizations, coordinating cross-functional or cross-business projects, and driving successful outcomes.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Proven ability to think critically, solve complex problems, and implement data and analytic solutions with a focus on innovation and efficiency.
  • Proactive & Independent Work Style: Demonstrates a proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently or collaboratively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Communication Skills: Strong communication skills, both verbal and non-verbal, with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail in system design, ensuring that solutions are reliable, optimized, and in line with business and technical requirements.


Required Experience & Education:

  • Experience with Databricks platform, Snowflake platform, Teradata platform and data engineering concepts.
  • Familiarity with data governance and security practices in cloud environments.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or Scala for data processing and analytics.
  • Proficiency in designing architecture, building API Integrations, configuring and deploying cloud services, setting up authentication, monitoring and logging.


Desired Experience:

  • AWS certification preferred

title: Administrative Coordinator

Provides, organizes, manages, and implements administrative and logistics support to HALC; works in collaboration with other administrative and departmental staff to ensure timeliness and responsiveness of all office support services.

Provides a wide range of complex administrative support duties including full day-to-day calendar management, meeting scheduling, filing, organizing, assisting with presentation materials, drafting communication, and printing. Prepare detailed and accurate meeting materials, including advance briefing materials. Regularly handles sensitive and confidential information. Assists with documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) that need to be created, reviewed, proofread, and/or designed for distribution internally and/or externally. Manages reimbursement processing, including collecting receipts and knowing/applying relevant policies and guidance.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

The Administrative Coordinator will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following activities:

  • Provides general administrative support to HALC

  • Assist in day-to-day HUIT services for the HALC team; computers, phones (desktop & mobile), printers, AV, and peripheral tech, etc.

  • Assists in the coordination of HALC staff meetings, department-wide events, internal office relocations, catering, and media needs as necessary.

  • Schedule meetings and coordinate meeting logistics, prepare agendas, as well as draft and edit emails, meeting notes, announcements, memoranda, and other general correspondence.

  • Arrange travel for staff and invited guests using Harvard preferred travel agencies.

  • Responsible for stocking the office supplies and kitchenettes for HALC location, submits service requests and manages vendor response.

  • May assist with website updates and changes.

  • Manages the HALC SharePoint portal.

  • Develop and maintain effective electronic filing and systems/workflows for scheduling, task management, and other administrative needs.

  • Services as departmental coordinator a resource for key business systems: Buy2Pay, Concur, etc.

  • Other administrative and programmatic duties as assigned.

Specific responsibilities include:

Scheduling: Schedule meetings for director-level staff as required. Schedule conference rooms or other locations, working closely with hosting facilities. · Develop and execute quality assurance protocols for NGS data pipelines and result reproducibility.

· Collaborate with bioinformatics, lab scientists, and software engineers to integrate multi-omic datasets and refine analytical workflows.

· Support study design, statistical analysis plans, and interpretation of findings for both internal R&D and regulatory submissions.

· Write comprehensive documentation, including analysis reports, methods validation, and pipeline specifications.

· Contribute to publications and presentations of research findings in scientific and clinical settings.

DocDefender is an AI-powered automated document redaction solution from primarily designed for police forces and public safety organisations. It helps teams quickly identify and remove sensitive information from documents before they are shared externally and internally.

The role is home based, but will be expected to travel to NEC offices (Chippenham, London, Hemel Hempstead will be the main locations) and customer sites when required.

The Product Manager will be responsible for defining, developing, and delivering high-quality software products that meet customer needs and drive business value. The role combines customer insight, commercial awareness, and technical understanding to shape product strategy, manage roadmaps, and deliver unique, compelling and differentiated enhancements.

Working cross-functionally with engineering, sales, customer success, and stakeholders, the Product Manager ensures products remain competitive, compliant, and aligned to organisational priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Define and maintain product strategy aligned to pillar and organisational objectives

Develop, own, and communicate the product roadmap and other standard collateral to ensure all customer facing teams deliver consistent and accurate messaging, effectively communicating our value propositions in language that resonates with customers.

Ensure alignment between customer needs, market trends, and technical capabilities

Contribute to wider portfolio strategy and planning

2. Product Delivery & Execution

Translate strategy into well-defined and commercially sound product backlogs and requirements

Developing marketing strategies in collaboration with the Public Safety marketing team

Work closely with engineering teams to deliver high-quality software solutions

Prioritise features and enhancements based on value, risk, and opportunity

Track delivery progress and ensure alignment to agreed milestones

Support successful product launches and releases

Proactively manage the Product Lifecycle, communicating it regularly to the company and customers

• Understand technology and keep abreast with the latest technology

• Research competitors, relevant products, market trends and regularly update the product strategy to meet the best commercial outcome

3. Customer Insight & Engagement

Lead all pre-sales activities for your product/s, engaging regularly with customers to understand needs, challenges, and behaviours and to support new sales opportunities.

Gather and analyse feedback, usage data, and market trends

Translate insights into product improvements and innovation opportunities

Support and participate in:

User groups

Customer workshops / masterclasses

Early engagement with sales opportunities

4. Product Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Research competitors, relevant products, market trends and regularly update the product strategy to meet the best commercial outcome

Identify and develop product enhancement opportunities to grow your product revenues

Explore and incorporate emerging technologies (including AI where relevant)

Develop business cases using structured approaches (e.g., Lean Canvas)

Present proposals to governance forums (e.g., Product Boards)

5. Stakeholder Management

  • Build relationships with NECSWS colleagues to ensure that, where appropriate, our products are capable of being joined up at both business process and technological levels
  • Collaborate with internal teams including:
  • Engineering / Development
  • Sales & Pre-Sales
  • Customer Success
  • Marketing
  • Communicate product updates, priorities, and performance
  • Support sales with product expertise and value propositions

6. Product Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor product performance using defined KPIs
  • Contribute to monthly reporting on:
  • Roadmap progress
  • Customer engagement
  • Product health and risks
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date product documentation and collateral

Skills and experiences

  • Degree or equivalent in a business or technical discipline
  • Proven track record in Product Management in technology industries.
  • Desirable for a track record of working in the Public Safety sector with proven ability to deliver technical solutions.
  • Ability to hold an audience with customers, technical people, partners and colleagues fully engaged and excited in furthering the product strategy and delivery.
  • World class product insight. Ideas that inform direction and prioritisation.
  • Commercially savvy. Able to conduct accurate return on investment calculations to steer the products and that deliver desired commercial outcomes which result in both increased market share and profitable growth.
  • Excellent research skills. Research competitors, markets, customers, requirements and use it to inform the very best product strategies that lead to market leadership and commercial growth.
  • Decision maker. Able to make tough decisions in the best interests of the product, market, customer and company. .

title: Data Scientist, Senior Associate
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Data Science Senior Associate focused on building and operating resilient datasets, pipelines, and reusable metrics that support hypothesis-driven analyses and experiments across the product development lifecycle (PDLC)

In this role, you will be hands-on in designing, developing, and maintaining data products that are reliable, observable, and well-documented-enabling partners across product, engineering, and analytics to measure what's driving value, where friction exists, and how operating-model changes impact outcomes as teams adopt more agentic ways of working. You'll contribute to engineering standards and help raise the quality bar through strong delivery and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities
  • Build and operate scalable batch/streaming pipelines with SLAs, monitoring, and incident response participation (as needed).
  • Create and maintain trusted data products (dimensions, event models, marts) with clear ownership and documentation.
  • Deliver metrics and feature-ready datasets for AI adoption/productivity measurement; manage definition changes over time.
  • Implement data quality and governance controls (validation, reconciliation, lineage, access, retention, auditability).
  • Orchestrate workflows in Airflow (or equivalent), including backfills and retries.
  • Model/transform data using SQL and dbt (or equivalent) for trusted reporting and repeatable measurement.
  • Write production-grade Python/PySpark with testing, performance tuning, and maintainable design.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements, success criteria, and metric interpretation across finance, PDLC/SDLC, and AI tool logs.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices (version control, code review, CI/CD, runbooks) and improve observability and cost/performance.
  • Mentor peers through reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing (no formal people management).

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years building production data solutions; strong ownership and delivery.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals (OOP, testing, development lifecycle).
  • Strong data modeling skills (dimensional, normalized, event-based).
  • Experience with Databricks and/or Spark/PySpark.
  • Strong SQL; experience with dbt (or equivalent) and building testable data codebases.
  • Experience operating orchestration pipelines (Airflow or equivalent).
  • Proven ability to build and maintain reliable metrics as sources/definitions evolve.
  • Effective delivery in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with modern lakehouse/warehouse patterns and broader cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Experience with BI/semantic layers and metrics management practices.
  • Exposure to experimentation or hypothesis-driven analytics approaches (e.g., measurement design to support tests, rollouts, and pre/post evaluation); deep causal specialization not required.
  • Experience improving observability (data freshness/SLA monitoring, lineage, alerting) and contributing to operational maturity (runbooks, incident follow-ups).

title: International Project Administrator
description:
Position Overview

Reporting to the Director of International HR and Administration, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Director of International Consulting and Operations, this position works as part of a team with all Global Support Services (GSS) members and in particular supports our separate but affiliated non-profit corporation, Harvard Global Research and Support Services, Inc. (Harvard Global). The individual is responsible for annual planning, coordination, and completion of a portfolio of operational, compliance, and HR activities that support Harvard Global’s international entities and projects. The role owns those key workstreams and related tracking systems (e.g., for board governance, entity compliance, HR events, insurance, audits, and banking arrangements) to ensure that required steps, reviews, and approvals are completed accurately and on time.

Through this work, the position helps identify risks inherent in Harvard Global’s international operations and HR activities, coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to address and mitigate those risks, and serves as a central organizing point for activities with compliance and governance implications across all Harvard Global entities and projects.

The role requires excellent intercultural communication and organizational skills; the ability to build, influence, and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders; strong project and analytical skills; and the judgment to distill and reframe complex international laws and policies into practical, actionable workflows. The individual leads by modeling and reinforcing excellent customer service standards across Harvard Global’s international operations and projects in the US and globally.

Duties & Responsibilities

Operational & Compliance Activity Management

  • Plan, coordinate, and track Harvard Global’s key operational and compliance activities, using systems that track compliances and related actions (e.g., Smartsheet and Salesforce), and maintain comprehensive, organized records of activities for all entities.
  • In collaboration with senior staff and legal advisors, translate compliance requirements into concrete workflows, checklists, and timelines, and contribute to the development, review, and updating of policies and procedures to ensure organizational practices meet in‑country legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor activity and risk across entities and projects, identifying and escalating issues; help leadership prioritize work by summarizing patterns and upcoming deadlines and communicating expectations organization‑wide.
  • Stay abreast of current laws, regulations, and best practices affecting Harvard Global entities and, with guidance from legal and subject-matter experts, update processes and activity plans accordingly.
  • Coordinate with team members and leadership on the review of potential compliance issues, track investigations and remediation steps, and document and follow up on recommended corrective actions.

Board Governance and Administration

  • Project manage the workflow for the Harvard Global US Board of Directors and for shareholders and Boards of Directors across all international entities, including planning calendars, producing Board materials, scheduling, preparing, and distributing formal minutes, and coordinating follow‑up actions.
  • Track and coordinate responses to Board inquiries and complete the required filings of meeting materials and minutes in relevant local and international jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate appointments, resignations, and elections for Harvard Global US and international Boards; maintain accurate records and timelines.
  • Facilitate and track Board resolutions in support of entity operations, banking, and other business actions, ensuring that necessary steps and documentation are completed.

Human Resources

  • Provide HR support for international hiring processes, including onboarding and offboarding, by coordinating these activities in partnership with the Director of International HR and local partners.
  • Draft employment-related documents, including employment agreements, employment extension letters, settlements, and related correspondence, ensuring alignment with organizational policies and local legal requirements, and track document execution and storage.
  • Maintain accurate personnel records in compliance with Harvard Global HR policies and local legal requirements; support systematic tracking and reporting of employment actions.
  • Set up employes' profiles and track employment actions and HR transactions in systems such as PeopleSoft, CWS Time Management, Smartsheet, and Salesforce helping to ensure data consistency across systems and activity trackers.
  • Act as payroll processing back-up as necessary, supporting monthly payroll operations and vendor coordination, and helping to manage related task lists and timelines.
  • Support and prepare employment-related reporting and audits by assembling data and documents, coordinating responses, and tracking completion of action items.
  • Research employment trends, laws and regulations, and best practices related to global HR; recommend and help implement improvements to HR processes, documentation, standard operating procedures, and guidelines, with a focus on creating clear, repeatable workflows.

Audits, Vendors, Banking, Insurance, and Systems

  • Support and/or lead the planning and coordination of internal and external audits, including timelines, information requests, and deliverables, to ensure adherence to applicable standards and requirements; provide compliance and contract information as needed.
  • Collaborate with legal and relevant regulatory agencies, coordinating responses to regulatory inquiries and statutory reporting obligations and ensuring associated tasks are logged and completed.
  • Lead and support Requests for Proposals (RFPs) for new vendor relationships; coordinate the RFP process, maintain documentation, and manage vendor relationships to support operational and compliance needs.
  • Coordinate the preparation, signing, and closeout of engagement letters and annual financial audits, ensuring that required documents, approvals, and follow‑up items are completed.
  • Liaise with finance and external parties to ensure timely submission of required documentation for audits, regulatory filings, and banking; track and complete outstanding items.
  • Coordinate banking access applications and bank account set‑ups and changes as required to support entity and project operations, maintaining associated records and timelines.
  • Monitor and help improve the systems and workflows used to manage activities across Harvard Global entities (e.g., Smartsheet trackers), focusing on visibility, accuracy, and timely completion.
  • Support the review of safety and security procedures across all entities in partnership with GSS' International Safety & Security team by coordinating related action items and documenting outcomes.
  • Oversee and track the annual renewal and administration of Harvard Global insurance policies; coordinate required information and respond to questions regarding coverage.
  • Support the maintenance of annual updates to the Harvard Global website, ensuring that information remains current, compliant with entity requirements, and consistent with operational practices.

Consulting Support

  • Support the implementation and ongoing operations of new and existing Harvard Global entities by coordinating the operational steps and activities required for successful launch and maintenance.
  • Develop research strategies to address unique or first-time inquiries from Harvard Schools and departments about international regulations, operational pathways, and country‑specific requirements; identify and evaluate relevant resources and translate findings into practical action plans.
  • Solicit input from internal stakeholders such as the Office of the General Counsel, Office of the Controller, Office for Sponsored Programs, Harvard Human Resources, Risk Management and Audit Services, and others, as well as external advisors, to inform recommendations and to define the sequence of actions and responsibilities.
  • Develop and maintain international guidelines related to global operations, compliance, and HR, ensuring they are incorporated into standard operating procedures and checklists.
  • Conduct due diligence and country-specific risk assessments for international operations to help inform client decisions regarding the administration of projects abroad, and capture resulting tasks and mitigations in tracking tools.
  • Respond to questions and provide ongoing coordination and support to Harvard Schools and departments; engage in recurring check-ins with key stakeholders, and ensure next steps are documented and completed.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Familiarity with international operational challenges and solutions.
  • 2+ years’ work experience.

Additional Qualifications

  • Demonstrated written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to establish and meet project and activity goals with limited direction and to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and flexibly with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must handle confidential and personal information with discretion.
  • Experience in international project administration, particularly in international regulatory compliance, audits, and risk management.
  • Experience in higher education or an international non-governmental organization and global human resources is preferred.
  • Experience managing or coordinating complex operational and compliance workflows, interacting with legal counsel or regulators, and preparing materials for Boards or senior leadership strongly preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
  • Familiarity with systems such as Smartsheet, PeopleSoft, CWS, Salesforce, and similar tools is preferred; experience using such tools for activity tracking and reporting is a plus.
  • Foreign language proficiency is a plus.

Work Conditions

  • This is a hybrid position based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a weekly in-office cadence. Remote work must be performed within one of the Harvard Registered Payroll States.

Standard Hours/Schedule:

  • 40 hours per week
  • 9:00 am - 5:00 pm
  • Monday - Friday
  • Days Off: Saturday and Sunday

Visa Sponsorship Information:

  • Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position

Pre-Employment Screening:

  • Identity, Education, References

Other Information:

About Harvard GSS and Harvard Global

Harvard GSS offers international travel, research, and program support in areas that span safety and security, health, culture, outbound immigration, employment, financial and legal matters, and research center operations. We serve students, faculty, staff, and academics across all Harvard Schools, departments, and centers. Since 2011, GSS has helped the Harvard community minimize risk, manage complexity, and feel confident about their international activities and travel. Join our dedicated, experienced team and help Harvard affiliates pursue extraordinary opportunities and achieve their international research, teaching, and learning goals. Learn more about GSS.

This position supports Harvard Global Research and Support Services, Inc. (Harvard Global), our separate but affiliated legal entity. Harvard Global is the mechanism through which GSS offers international employment and payroll services, research center operations, tax-efficient giving, and grant management in support of Harvard University's international activities. Established in 2012, Harvard Global is a nonprofit, fee-for-service organization. Learn more about Harvard Global.

#LI-RC1

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 056. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.
