title: Data Architect / Engineer
description:
About us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

Technology is foundational to all of Appnovation’s offerings, from consulting to digital innovation, to digital product and service creation. The technology department is focused on delivering software solutions that enable rich consumer experiences, from mobile and web applications to advanced analytics and machine learning, to content and engagement management service enablement platforms.

Inherent throughout our tech capabilities is deep expertise in the Software Development Life Cycle, a drive for creativity, a passion for the craft, and collaboration with other disciplines - all foundational ingredients in successful digital experiences and client partnerships.

As a Data Architect / Engineer, you will join a highly motivated and experienced team and own both the data structures behind our graph-RAG platform and the pipelines that get content into it — modeling the knowledge and pumping it in at scale. You will define the schema, taxonomy and graph model for our knowledge domains, build resilient ingestion pipelines from enterprise content sources such as SharePoint and the wider Microsoft stack, and keep the knowledge graph accurate as source documents evolve. We are looking for people who can bring a strong, solution-focused mindset and contribute to architectural decisions, best practices and get things done.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define the schema, taxonomy, and graph modeling for the knowledge domains.
  • Design how documents, versions, and their machine-readable representations are structured, and how facts evolve over time (including temporal replay).
  • Build ingestion/ETL pipelines from enterprise content sources (e.g., SharePoint and the wider Microsoft stack), handling multimodal content (presentations, documents, transcripts).
  • Keep the knowledge graph in sync as source documents change frequently.
  • Advise on whether the current backend approach (Supabase/Postgres) is the right long-term architecture, and validate ingested content quality with QA.
  • Establish data quality, lineage, and governance standards across pipelines.
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and error-handling for ingestion jobs.
  • Document data models, schemas, and pipeline architecture.
  • Optimize pipeline cost, throughput, and reliability over time.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering / architecture roles.
  • Deep data modeling across relational and graph paradigms; graph databases (Neo4j) and Postgres/Supabase at scale.
  • Strong ETL / data pipeline engineering in Python, including large-scale, incremental, and change-data ingestion.
  • Experience with enterprise content ecosystems: SharePoint, ideally Power Platform / Power Automate.
  • Knowledge representation, taxonomies/ontologies, and versioned/temporal data.
  • Understanding of how data structures feed RAG and LLM retrieval quality.
  • SQL proficiency; experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and cloud data services.
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and privacy practices.
  • Strong documentation and cross-team communication skills.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You think about how to scale, automate and operate, not just how to build a solution to an immediate problem
  • You understand lean thinking
  • You set high standards for code quality, performance/scalability and security and seek continuous improvement
  • You have solid analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills
  • You have customer first mindset and a devotion to customer service
  • You engage and build positive internal and external client relationships, while managing multiple initiatives, often with competing priorities
  • You have strong self-initiative, passion, interpersonal, oral and written communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work, influence and make an impact in a cross-functional environment with all levels of the organization
  • You are responsive and thrive in a fast-paced diverse high-performance environment with rapidly changing business needs
  • You actively seek out things outside your comfort zone with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies
  • You have prior experience in consulting
  • Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred

title: Coder II
description:
Overview

The HIM Coding Specialist II is required to have a full understanding and active participation in fulfilling the mission, vision and values of San Gabriel Valley Medical Center. The employee shall support San Gabriel Valley Medical Center’s strategic plan and the goals and direction of the department Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).

The HIM Coding Specialist II is required to ensure that all patient records are coded within the bill-hold limits (4 days). HIM Coding Specialist II is further responsible to ensure that all charts pass the SMART cycle and are adjusted as needed. The HIM Coding Specialist II must have a comprehensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10 PCS, CPT conventions in accordance with Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting. The HIM Coding Specialist II is responsible for abstracting data into Evident/Thrive system using 3M encoder. Furthermore, the HIM Coding Specialist II will work internally and externally with coding staff, HIM director and outside auditors and consultants to ensure the efficiency and quality of coding. The HIM Coding Specialist II must at all times safeguard and protect the patient’s right to privacy by ensuring that only authorized individuals have access to the patient’s medical information and that all releases of information are in compliance with the request, authorization, company policy and HIPAA regulations.

Responsibilities

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Accurately reviews all records that are flagged by SMART and other reviews as required.
  • Ensures that all charts are coded within their bill hold limits.
  • Works with outside auditors and consultants ensuring the quality of coding within the department.
  • Reviews all charts that may be in questions in regards to billing and coding.
  • Replies to external auditor regarding coding issues within 7-14 days.
  • Compiles and maintains productivity reports on all coders.
  • Educates and trains coding staff on an as needed basis.
  • Accurately reviews all charts for diseases and procedures performed and assign appropriate ICD-9-CM and CPT codes according to guidelines.
  • Accurately enters appropriate diagnoses and operative codes into the MIRA coding system computer.
  • Code four (4) inpatient or eight (8) outpatient charts within one (1) hour.
  • Works with endcoder optimizer feature to produce principal diagnosis scenarios for attending physician review according to department practice.
  • Accurately codes and abstracts short stay surgeries and ER charts onto the outpatient abstract.
  • Accurately codes outpatient referred cases and clinic visits onto the diagnosis verification screen.
  • Works with case managers to obtain concurrent information when deemed necessary.
  • Performs concurrent coding on inpatient records selected by the business office.
  • Serve as an accurate resource to physicians and hospital personnel regarding assignment of principal diagnosis, sequencing of diagnoses and DRG assignment.
  • Reviews OSHPD reports weekly and makes appropriate corrections.
  • Works with HIM Director to complete evaluations for other coders within the department.

The above statements reflect the essential functions considered necessary to describe the principle content of the job. They are not intended to be a complete statement of all work requirements or duties that may be inherent in the job.

The following job accountabilities are non-essential and may be reassigned:

  • Runs inpatient abstracts through the 3M encoder for DRG assignment.
  • Prepares coding summary sheet for the chart.
  • Does data searches for retrieval of information from the indices.
  • Bar code all charts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING:

Experience: A minimum of four years coding experience in a hospital Health Information Management Department.

Education: High School Diploma or equivalent

Specialized Training: Must have good communication skills, must be able to read and write English, must be computer literate, ability to use tact and diplomacy when interacting with the staff and customers.

Licenses/Certifications

  • Certified Coding Assistant or Certified Coding Specialist credentials from AHIMA
  • A minimum score on the AHMC Coding Examination of 95%
  • RHIT, RHIA, or CCS.

title: Product Manager, Market Intelligence
description:
Role: Manager, MPI Product Strategy and Market Intelligence

Location: Atlanta, GA (Hybrid - 3 days a week onsite)

Payments data is powerful, but only when it helps people make better decisions. CMSPI is looking for a commercially minded payments manager with strong product instincts to help make the Merchant Payments Index (MPI) one of our most important intelligence products.

In this role, you’ll help turn proprietary payments data into better benchmarks, stronger client insight, and practical ways for account teams to advise merchants. You’ll move between payments detail, product thinking, data, and client-facing storytelling: translating real merchant and account-team questions into useful MPI features, insight outputs, and enablement.

About CMSPI

CMSPI is a global payments consultancy that works with leading merchants to improve payment performance, reduce cost, and make better decisions in a complex payments market. Our work combines deep consulting expertise with proprietary data, analytics, and technology - giving clients the insight and support they need to move from knowing there is a problem to knowing what to do about it.

What you'll do

  • Help manage the MPI product agenda, including roadmap priorities, use cases, adoption plans, success measures, and product requirements
  • Work with Data, Technical Product, Data Science, and Engineering to improve MPI functionality, methodology, usability, reporting, roadmap execution, and Digital Twin use cases
  • Help account teams use MPI in client reviews, renewals, growth conversations, and strategic recommendations
  • Turn trends, benchmarks, risks, opportunities, and market signals into repeatable briefings, insight packs, client education, thought leadership, and practical recommendations
  • Identify useful external datasets, partnership inputs, and selected client-facing opportunities that make MPI more differentiated and commercially relevant

Why CMSPI

CMSPI exists to help make the payments ecosystem more innovative, competitive, and transparent. We’ve built a unique position as one of the premier trusted advisors to many of the world’s largest organizations, giving our teams the opportunity to work on questions that shape how major merchants understand and improve payments.

You’ll have a distinctive data foundation to build from. MPI is supported by CMSPI’s broader platform, helping turn payments complexity into practical intelligence for clients and account teams, including:

  • Over 87 billion transactions (and growing), amounting to trillions of USD in consumer spend
  • Telemetry on 1 in 6 U.S. card transactions and payments performance data from over 50% of Fortune 500 merchants
  • Over 60,000 BINs, more than 7,000 unique issuers, and 15+ unique card networks spanning over 40 markets globally
  • Normalized, consistent data drawn from over 400 unique schemas
  • A Databricks-backed platform supporting scalable insight development and more advanced intelligence products

If you enjoy working at the intersection of payments, product, data, and client impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience in payments, fintech, merchant acquiring, payment networks, issuing, payment operations, payments consulting, data products, product management, market intelligence, or strategy
  • Practical understanding of how merchants use payments data to make decisions on cost, authorization performance, payment methods, routing, fraud, customer experience, supplier management, or market change
  • Experience translating business needs into product requirements, analytical questions, data priorities, or technical workstreams
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with consulting, product, data science, engineering, partnerships, sales, and marketing teams
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex data and market signals into clear, repeatable, client-ready materials
  • Curiosity, product discipline, analytical confidence, and the ambition to help build one of the market’s most differentiated payments intelligence products

Benefits

    • Comprehensive, payments industry training by in-house and industry expert
    • Personal and professional learning opportunities and growth experiences aligned with your career aspirations.
    • 100% healthcare coverage for employees and low-cost dental and vision options
    • Health Savings Account, Flexible Savings Account, and Commuter Benefit options
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match up to 5% after 90 days of employment
    • Annual company bonus plan based on company & individual performance
    • Quarterly values award for all employees - with a financial prize
    • Regular companywide socials and team building events
    • 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, 8 paid company holidays, and discretionary office closure during the holiday season

title: Technical Program Manager, Hardware (PEL)
description:
Arista is seeking a Hardware Technical Program Manager. This is a critical role, ensuring that Arista customer driven programs complete milestone deliverables to meet the customer’s needs and prevent delays to their internal development and deployment programs.

Who You’ll Work With

As a Hardware TPM you will work directly with experienced internal cross-disciplinary engineering team leaders, customers, and strategic partners to drive hardware product development from concept through release to volume production. You will lead the cross-functional engineering team through the NPI process from concept through release to mass production. Strong leadership, communications, problem solving, and communication skills are essential.

The total estimated annual compensation range for this position, inclusive of base salary, bonus, and equity, is $250,000 to $500,000. This range is a good faith estimate only. Bonus and equity are discretionary, subject to plan terms, and are not guaranteed components of total compensation. Actual total annual compensation may vary based on employee performance, company or equity performance, company policy, board approval, or similar factors. Please see additional base salary information below.

What You’ll Do

  • Creating statement of work (SoW) and product requirement documents (PRD) for complex technical programs
  • Owns and facilitates weekly cross-functional engineering team meetings.
  • Interface with key customers and strategic partners to develop program plans including negotiating schedules, milestone deliverables, prototype allocations, and feature set.
  • Lead a cross-functional team from HW, SW, Central, and Diagnostic engineering, manufacturing engineering, product management, ODM/JDM partners, and customer support to deliver outstanding products to the market.
  • You will be responsible for tracking and reporting on the cross-functional design engineering validation, and qualification status of your programs, as well as identifying and solving any concerns prior to them causing impact.
  • Create a master schedule that captures and inter-connects the key cross-functional deliverables as defined by the product development lifecycle and ensure the team stays on track to meet program milestones.
  • Lead program design review and bug scrub meetings
  • Drive, coordinate, and monitor engineering programs including scheduling, planning, product and project cost analysis, and milestone checkpoint reviews.
  • Drive cross-functional issue resolution ensuring issues are identified, assigned owners, and tracked to closure. Ensure issues are escalated to the appropriate functional leaders.
  • Facilitate engineering portion of phase gate review meetings
  • 10+ years of NPI hardware engineering and leadership experience
  • Design engineering, New Product Introduction, and manufacturing experience with rack-mounted data center or enterprise equipment
  • Experience working with multiple engineering disciplines including electrical, mechanical, software, diagnostics, test, and manufacturing engineering team members
  • Exceptional project management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and organizational skills.
  • Significant working knowledge of hardware development.
  • Proven track record of managing hardware projects and delivering on time.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, define, document, implement new processes.
  • Experience interfacing with product management, internal cross-functional engineering teams, and sub-tier suppliers
  • Ability to listen and simplify complex topics for non-technical audiences, and prepare summaries for executives and stakeholders.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, industrial engineering or equivalent experience. MS/MBA and PMP desirable.

Compensation Information

The new hire base pay for this role has a salary range of $145,000 to $200,000.

Arista offers different pay ranges based on work location, so that we can offer consistent and competitive pay appropriate to the market. The actual base pay offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and work location.

The pay range provided reflects base pay only and in addition certain roles may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses and equity. Employees in Sales roles are eligible to participate in Arista’s Sales Incentive Plan, which pays commissions calculated as a percentage of eligible sales. US-based employees are also entitled to benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, tax savings and income protection. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location.

Along the way, you'll develop skills, confidence, and connections that can help shape your future career.

  • Work with data and business insights to support decision-making and recommendations.

  • Data visualization
  • Financial modeling
  • Strategic problem-solving
  • Project management
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Professional presentation skills

You'll also strengthen your ability to analyze information, identify opportunities, and communicate recommendations that help drive business results.
The Experience
This is more than a summer internship. Throughout the program, you'll gain hands-on experience, work alongside experienced professionals, and build meaningful relationships across the organization. You'll also have access to mentors, leadership development opportunities, and social events that connect you with fellow Altria interns. You'll gain exposure to real business challenges while contributing to projects that support Supply Chain and Customer Operations.
What You'll Gain Along the Way
We believe internships should give you more than experience. They should help you build confidence, connections, and skills you can carry into your future career. As a Supply Chain Intern, you'll gain:
  • Hands-on experience within a Fortune 500 Supply Chain organization.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager II
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-stakes, cross-functional engineering initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy, system architecture, and operational execution. You will drive the technical delivery strategy for complex software integrations, scale distributed systems, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture leaders to turn ambitious roadmaps into reliable software.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Delivery Strategy: Architect end-to-end program delivery plans for multi-team initiatives, translating high-level product requirements into detailed engineering milestones.
  • Architecture & Dependency Management: Identify, track, and resolve complex cross-functional dependencies across API contracts, core platform services, and external integrations.
  • Technical Problem Solving: Drive alignment on system trade-offs (e.g., latency, scalability, technical debt) and participate in architectural reviews to keep execution aligned with long-term platform health.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical, security, and operational risks weeks before they impact launch schedules, building actionable contingency plans.
  • Operational Excellence: Establish a lightweight, high-impact execution cadence (e.g., agile delivery processes, integration testing syncs, execution metrics, post-mortems) across distributed engineering teams.
  • Executive Communication: Synthesize technical status, risks, and execution health into clear, data-driven updates for senior leadership.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience as a TPM, Engineering Manager, or Systems Architect managing complex software development cycles.
  • Technical Depth: Deep understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented/microservices architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Ability to hold technical discussions with Principal Engineers and Architects.
  • Execution Track Record: Proven history of delivering large-scale, multi-team software initiatives from inception to rollout on time and at scale.
  • Leadership & Influence: Outstanding stakeholder management skills; ability to align disparate engineering, product, and business teams without direct authority.

title: Delivery Consultant - Data Engineering, AWS Professional Services

description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  • Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Advise customer's technologists and business leads help them to explore the art of the possible with machine learning, and to develop scalable Data Analytics and ML solutions on AWS to deliver business value in the most effective way
  • Discuss complex industry-specific business concepts with customer technologists and business leads especially in public sector
  • Drive large, complex customer engagements across pre-sales and delivery from ideation, through architecture design and scoping, all the way to closure and into delivery
  • Conduct workshop sessions to identify opportunities with our customers to scope how they could deliver business value through the use of Data Analytics and machine learning
  • Provide technical leadership and excellence on customer engagements to ensure alignment on scope, deliverables, timeline and customer expected outcomes

About the team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing

Basic qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
  • 5+ years of database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis) experience
  • 3+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
  • 7+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience, especially in public sector cloud environments
  • Ability to obtain Singapore government security clearance.

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
  • AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation).
  • AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred.
  • Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
  • Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR)
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Travel Consultants
description:
Travel Consultants

Salary: £26,227 (£13.45 per Hour) + Benefits + Profit Share Bonus Scheme

Full Time and Part-time hours available

Start Date: 23rd November 2026

Closing date: 2nd October 2026

Office-based at the HX Campus in Newingreen, Kent

At Holiday Extras, we sell everything but the holiday. Using innovative technology, we provide great value travel extras and UK Breaks, with an unrivalled experience to over 8 million travellers a year.

With over 40 years' experience, there's nothing our team of travel experts don’t know about taking the hassle out of organising a holiday at home or abroad. Our Contact Centre is key to delivering the fastest, smartest and most personal service in travel.

We’re looking for customer-focused people to join either our Insurance or Airport team and become experts at helping our customers find the best products and services that make travelling easy, simple and fun. We’re searching for diverse perspectives and big ideas from people who are curious and keen to learn!

The Role

What you’ll do:

  • Handle inbound customer calls in a busy, voice-based Contact Centre.
  • Use your excellent rapport-building and listening skills to quickly connect customers with products and services that enhance their holiday experience.
  • Be the voice of Holiday Extras, talking to our customers over the phone. Strong, adaptable and empathetic communication skills therefore are a must.
  • Become a product expert and brand ambassador, developing in-depth knowledge of our range of products and services so you can help customers who may have been unable to resolve their query through our website or app.
  • Take ownership of queries and work towards the best possible outcome for each customer.

What you’ll get:

  • Full training and support from our dedicated Contact Centre Trainers. Starting with a 3-week induction programme, designed to give you the knowledge and confidence you need to be successful in the role.
  • Weekly 1-to-1 coaching and mentoring to support your continual development.
  • Learn and use cutting-edge tech, including ChatGPT Enterprise and your own Apple MacBook from day 1, as well as access to the Google Workspace suite and other apps. If you’ve never used these before - we’ll show you how.
  • Be part of a supportive, thriving, ‘be one team’ environment where our values are embedded - we celebrate success together with our Group Profit Share Bonus Scheme, as well as enjoying our famous culture with seasonal events such as parties and BBQs. Learn more about our unique culture here.
  • Enjoy a world of benefits including 25 days holiday, your birthday off, enhanced parental leave, pension, life assurance, discounts for cinema tickets and high street retailers, cycle to work scheme.
  • Access to our wellbeing benefits - we offer a free employee assistance programme - enhanced after 4 years to private medical insurance and health screening, discounted gym membership, holiday buy scheme. And our in-house network of trained mental health first aiders who are on hand should you need support

Prior contact centre experience is not necessary although we’re ideally looking for people who:

  • Have previously worked in a customer-facing role
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Have great attention to detail
  • Care about providing an exceptional experience to our customers
  • Want to grow their career or take on a new challenge
  • Are passionate about learning, growing and becoming the best version of themselves

FYI: there are service targets associated with the role but you will be given all the training and support you need to help you achieve these.

Success in the role is measured through things such as customer feedback and NPS, call quality and handling calls efficiently while giving customers the time and attention they need. These measures help us maintain excellent service and identify where coaching or additional support may be helpful.

This is the perfect chance to start your career with us, learn new skills and enhance your existing ones. No matter where you are in your career, you’ll be joining an awesome team of experts - all here to support you and help each other deliver a world-class service to our customers.

Hours

Our aim is to be as inclusive as possible, we welcome full-time and part-time candidates who can work shifts to meet the needs of our customers. This will include weekends and evenings.

On a full-time basis, you would work 37.5 hours per week, being scheduled for shifts across our opening hours (Monday - Friday 8am-8pm & Saturday and Sunday 9am-5:00pm)

If you’re looking for part-time hours you’ll need to be available to work your contracted hours across 4 days of the week, specifically 3 weekdays and 1 weekend day.

You will need to be able to attend a 3-week full-time induction regardless of your contracted hours. Don’t worry, you’ll be fully paid for this. It is super important as it has been purpose-built and designed to give you the knowledge and confidence you need to be successful in the role.

Rotas are given out 4 weeks in advance so you have plenty of time to plan ahead and enjoy your free time.

How we hire for this role

If we believe you might be a match for a job you’ve applied for, you’ll enter our hiring process as follows:

  • Initial telephone call with a member of our recruitment team so we can get to know you a little better.
  • Visit our Kent campus for a few hours to see what the job entails. This will be an amazing opportunity for you to see what the role is like and to make sure Holiday Extras is a good fit for you.
  • You will also have an interview during your visit which will be with two of our Contact Centre Team Managers. This normally takes around an hour and will be held in person. It’s a great opportunity to find out even more about the role and for us to learn more about your skills and experience and what you can expect working with us.

Cultivating a diverse and inclusive culture is paramount for us.

As part of this, we have designed our hiring process so you can be comfortable to confidently convey your strengths and who you are.

Recognising we are all different, if for whatever reason you need us to adapt the process, please get in touch via recruitment@holidayextras.com.

Please note: this role is not eligible for UK skilled worker visa sponsorship, so we can only consider applicants who already have the right to work in the UK.

Benefits

Why choose Holiday Extras?

We believe that holidays are the most precious time of all, so we create products, tech and services that make travel and holidays memorable and fun. We’re on a mission to be the only place to go for your holiday extras, offering unparalleled choice, value and service, turning our customers’ ordinary trips into extraordinarily good times.

At Holiday Extras, we’re creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, build their careers and reach their limitless potential. As a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025, we’re proud to offer a world of benefits designed to enhance your lifestyle and well-being. By joining our team, you’ll feel supported and rewarded every day. Learn more about our culture and benefits.

  • 25 days annual leave (+ Bank Holidays), extra days through Holiday Buy, Birthday Day Off, and Sabbaticals at each 5 year milestone.
  • Enhanced parental leave - Up to 1 year off, including 13 weeks at 100% pay, 13 weeks at 50% pay
  • Access to Gym Discounts, Private Dental Insurance and Private Medical Insurance (after 4 years)
  • Profit Share Bonus and Aviva pension scheme.
  • Join our Social Club for 25% off any ticket or event in the UK
  • Discounts on the latest tech
  • Give back to your community with our Volunteering Scheme.
  • Income protection, Critical illness cover and Life assurance

title: Senior Program Manager – Summit Services
description:
The Oparc Mission

Oparc believes that all individuals deserve the human right to be valued members of society regardless of their intelligence or physical capabilities. Oparc exists to make training, employment, and social opportunities available and to be the champion for thousands of people with disabilities in Southern California.

Title: Senior Program Manager – Summit Services

General Statement of Function: The Senior Program Manager – Summit Services provides supervisory leadership, case management oversight, and quality assurance for Summit Services programs, directly supervising three (3) Program Managers. This role combines day-to-day program leadership with case management continuity, regulatory compliance, and continuous quality improvement (CQI), ensuring uninterrupted, high-quality, person-centered services across assigned sites, including routine and unannounced site observations, incident trend analysis, and corrective action follow-through for Summit Services programs. The Senior Program Manager – Summit Services works in close partnership with the Senior Program Manager for ADC Programs division to provide monthly quality and compliance summaries to the Director of Licensed Programs

Essential Functions:

Program Supervision & Leadership

  • Directly supervise three (3) Program Managers across Summit Services programs, providing coaching, performance management, and day-to-day leadership.
  • Serves as the point of escalation for Program Managers on program operations, staffing, and participant service issues.
  • Support Program Managers in aligning day-to-day operations with Oparc's mission, goals, and person-centered practices.
  • Monitor program areas for safety, organization, and compliance with health and environmental standards.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of each supervised program's needs and support implementation of individualized, person-centered programming.
  • Provide timely response to urgent participant needs, service changes, or compliance-related deadlines.

Case Management Support & Consistency

  • Provide guidance, coaching, and technical support to Case Managers, including serving as a licensed program primary resource for the case management system, and providing oversight of system-related functions such as user support, troubleshooting, data integrity, and documentation standards.
  • Support the alignment of person-centered service plans with participant goals, needs, and requirements.
  • Using a tracker, provide oversight of the delivery of onboarding and ongoing training to new and existing staff, ensuring consistent training in documentation practices.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Perform quarterly reviews and Program Manager audits of case files for participants with annuals due, ensuring documentation is complete, current, and compliant with program and regulatory standards.
  • Quarterly oversight of internal monthly audits of, medication logs, cash accounts, Safety binders, Emergency binders, Evacuation documents, License 500 forms, and compliance logs for assigned sites to ensure compliance with Title 17, Title 22, CCL, HCBS, DDS, OSHA, and other regulatory or accreditation agencies.
  • Conduct routine and unannounced site visits and quality assurance walk-throughs, including community-based activities and outings, using standardized tools and submit deficiency reports and trends to the Director of Licensed Programs and Chief Program Officer.
  • Evaluate staff-participant interactions to ensure dignity, respect, and appropriate support are consistently demonstrated.
  • Monitor adherence to person-centered planning principles and ensure participant goals remain individualized, relevant, and actively supported.
  • Identify documentation, service delivery, or compliance gaps and provide guidance and follow-up to ensure corrective action is taken.
  • As assigned by the Director of Licensed Programs, conduct fact-finding investigations into complex compliance, service delivery, participant-care, or staff conduct concerns- coordinating with Human Resources when staff conduct is involved- and submit written findings and recommendations to the Director.
  • Support preparation for site inspections, audits, surveys, and accreditation reviews; participate in pre-licensing reviews and post-inspection debriefs.
  • Prepare and provide monthly caseload, compliance, and quality status reports to the Director of Licensed Programs and Chief Program Officer, including coverage needs, documentation status, and emerging concerns.

Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI)

  • Oversee incident management, trend analysis, and systemic risk assessments for assigned programs.
  • Lead and support the development and implementation of corrective and preventive action plans in collaboration with Program Managers.
  • Monitor and evaluate trend changes over time to assess the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions, ensuring sustained improvement and accountability.
  • Establish and maintain feedback loops connecting data analysis, action planning, and outcome evaluation.
  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous refinement of quality improvement initiatives for assigned sites, and elevate significant trends, gaps, or risk issues to the Director of Licensed Programs and Chief Program Officer.

Referral Tracker Dashboard

  • Monitor the Referral Tracker Dashboard for Summit Services programs, that new referrals are processed and enrolled efficiently.

Org-Wide Policy Consistency

  • Meet monthly with the Director of Licensed Programs and the Senior Program Manager for ADC Programs to ensure licensed programs policies, documentation standards, and practices remain consistent across both divisions.
  • Bimonthly, collaborate with all program management with supervisory responsibilities to discuss, coordinate, and make recommendations to Directors and CPO to drive organizational-wide consistency of policies and procedures.

Staff Development & Administrative Support

  • Track and monitor staff training compliance documentation, including onboarding, certifications, and ongoing professional development for assigned sites.
  • Maintain and update the training tracker and distribute training evaluations.
  • Conduct morning check-ins with Program Support Assistants to assess staffing needs and maintain accurate ratio and substitution records.
  • Maintain accurate program management meeting and training minutes and distribute timely updates to teams.
  • Coordinate the appropriate daily ratio relative to available staffing with the Senior Program Manager of ADCs

Risk Management & Safety Oversight

  • Audit OSHA 300A, WVPP, and other safety documentation to ensure completion, posting, and submission.
  • Conduct safety reviews and emergency preparedness audits; track incident reports, safety incidents, emergency drills, and corrective actions.
  • Provide training and technical assistance to Program Managers regarding safety and regulatory compliance issues.

Communication, Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in participant meetings (e.g., IDTs, ISPs) as needed to support service continuity and represent Licensed Programs.
  • Represent Oparc at community events, resource fairs, and provider meetings on a rotating basis with the Senior Program Manager for ADC programs.
  • In the absence of the Director of Licensed Programs, escalate matters requiring executive-level decisions to the Chief Program Officer.

Other Duties and Responsibilities

  • Adhere to proper care and responsible use of Oparc-issued property, tools, and equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support program operations and service quality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Services, or a related field required (Master's preferred); or minimum of 3 years of experience in developmental disability services, including case management, with at least 3 years in a leadership, supervisory, or compliance role.
  • Prior experience directly supervising exempt-level staff strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable regulations including Title 17, Title 22, HCBS Final Rule, DDS, CCL, Regional Center, FLSA, and OSHA requirements.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of person-centered planning and service delivery.
  • Strong skills in staff supervision, coaching, performance management, data analysis, and quality assurance.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills, with the capacity to navigate challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities across programs.
  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint), Teams, Canva, and case management/documentation systems.
  • Familiarity with accreditation and regulatory standards (CCL, DDS, CARF) preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and sound judgment, with the ability to conduct field-based observations and evaluations independently.
  • Ability to pass a Department of Justice (DOJ) background check and fingerprint clearance, complete TB test, pre-employment physical, and provide proof of required immunizations (as applicable).
  • Valid CA driver's license, proof of current vehicle insurance, clear driving record, and two (2) years of driving experience.
  • Reliable transportation to travel and attend off-site meetings.
  • CPR, First Aid, and Crisis Intervention (e.g., CPI) certifications — or ability to obtain upon hire.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

As Staff Machine Learning Engineer in Search and Discovery, you will leverage the most advanced algorithms to improve Coupang’s product search and discovery quality. You will spearhead the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI to revolutionize our core search pipeline—including query understanding, product understanding, semantic retrieval, and final-stage ranking. You are expected to be a leading expert in one or multiple areas including information retrieval, recommendation systems, machine learning, deep learning, or natural language processing. The ideal candidates are pragmatic, resourceful, embrace seemingly impossible challenges, and have a proven track record of deploying high-scale, low-latency AI solutions in production.

What You Will Do

  • System Diagnostics: Root cause the bottlenecks of the current search and recommendation systems and quantify the defects across the entire search funnel (query rewriting\retrieval\ranking).

    State-of-the-Art Solutions: Propose and architect end-to-end solutions that leverage advanced ML, DL, and Generative AI/LLMs to upgrade traditional search components into AI-native architectures.

    Core Funnel Optimization with LLMs:

    Query Understanding: Build next-generation query understanding services (intent detection, query rewrite, semantic expansion, entity extraction) utilizing fine-tuned LLMs.

    Candidate Retrieval: Design and scale semantic/dense retrieval systems, combining traditional vector search (ANN) with generative retrieval techniques.

    Ranking & Reranking: Develop and optimize LLM-based listwise/pairwise reranking models, and tackle performance trade-offs (latency, cost, throughput) for real-time serving.

    Production & Evaluation: Implement solutions, optimize offline/online inference performance (using model distillation, quantization, vLLM/TensorRT), and conduct rigorous A/B tests.

    Technical Leadership: Be a thought leader, mentor senior engineers, and gain consensus across cross-functional organizations (Infrastructure, Platform, Product) to drive the search AI roadmap.

    Example Projects Include

    LLM-Powered Query Understanding: We train and fine-tune in-house LLMs to perform multi-task query tagging, real-time query rewriting/expansion, and precise intent categorization.

    Generative & Semantic Retrieval: We use deep representation learning, two-tower models, and LLM-generated semantic embeddings combined with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Vespa) for hyper-accurate candidate retrieval.

    LLM Reranking & Distillation: We explore listwise and pairwise LLM reranking models to evaluate query-item relevance, while distilling their reasoning capabilities into smaller, sub-millisecond models for real-time serving.

    Deep Conversion & Personalization: We build Deep Learning-based conversion prediction models ($CVR$) incorporating real-time user state, query intent, and multi-modal product representations.

    Graph-based Relationships: We leverage graph neural networks (GNNs) and knowledge graphs to ground our LLMs, exploring latent relationships between query sessions and catalog documents.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in related fields including Search, Information Retrieval, RecSys, ML, DL, or NLP.

    Solid software engineering foundation with proficient coding skills in Python, C++, or Java.

    Distributed Systems Experience: Proven experience handling large data volumes, training large-scale models, and serving high-QPS pipelines in distributed environments (e.g., Spark, Ray, Kubernetes).

    Pragmatic Problem Solver: Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business problems, formulate them mathematically, and deliver production-grade ML solutions.

    Education: Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related engineering fields.

Preferred Qualifications

  • LLM & GenAI Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in fine-tuning (SFT, LoRA), aligning (RLHF/DPO), or distilling LLMs specifically for search, recommendation, or NLP tasks (e.g., query expansion, dense retrieval, reranking).

title: Speech LLM Research Scientist Internship
description:
팀 소개

Language Lab은 자연어 처리(NLP) 분야의 기술적 난제를 해결하는 선행기술을 연구하는 조직입니다. 'Learning-by-Reading AI'를 바탕으로 챗봇을 비롯한 Language 분야 서비스 혁신을 목표로 하고 있으며, 최근에는 텍스트를 읽고 이해하는 AI를 넘어 음성을 듣고 말하는 AI로 연구 범위를 넓혀가고 있습니다.

이러한 음성 연구의 일환으로 SpeechLLM 연구가 있습니다. 음성 인식(STT)과 음성 합성(TTS)을 대규모 언어모델(LLM)과 결합해, 사람의 말을 직접 듣고 이해하며 응답하는 음성 대화 모델을 연구합니다. 이러한 기술은 AI Contact Center(AICC)뿐 아니라 음성 비서, 차량·가전 인터페이스, 회의 지원, 어학 교육 등 다양한 음성 기반 서비스로 확장될 수 있습니다.

이번 인턴 프로그램에서는 팀의 연구원들과 함께 SpeechLLM 연구를 수행하며, 아이디어를 직접 모델로 구현하고 검증하는 과정을 경험하게 됩니다. 음성과 언어가 만나는 문제에 관심 있는 분들의 지원을 기다립니다.


수행 업무

  • [ Pipeline 방식 (Cascaded STT→LLM→TTS) 기반 SpeechLLM 연구 ]
    - STT → LLM → TTS로 이어지는 Cascaded 파이프라인의 스트리밍화 및 Sub-Second 저지연 최적화 연구
    - VAD 기반 Half-Duplex 턴 분할의 한계를 개선하는 VAD-Free / Chunk 단위 Micro-Turn 처리 기법 연구
    - 모듈 간 오류 전파를 줄이고 Paralinguistic(감정·운율) 정보 손실을 완화하는 컨텍스트 전달·정렬 기법 연구
  • [ End-to-End Full-Duplex 기반 SpeechLLM 연구 ]
    - Full-Duplex SpeechLLM 모델 아키텍처 연구
    - 자연스러운 Turn-Taking, Barge-in, Backchannel, 발화 겹침 처리 및 Stream Synchronization 모델링
    - Audio Encoder–LLM 간 Modality Alignment 및 Speech Tokenizer / Neural Codec 연구


지원자격

  • 석사 학위 이상 (6개월 이상 근무 가능자)
  • Cascaded(STT→LLM→TTS) SpeechLLM 연구/개발 경험
  • Full-Duplex SpeechLLM 연구/개발 경험
  • Turn-Taking, Barge-in, Backchannel 등 대화 상호작용 모델링 연구 경험
  • Speech Tokenizer 및 Neural Codec 기반 음성 표현 활용 경험
  • AI 관련 Top-Tier 학회(ICASSP, Interspeech, ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICLR 등) 논문 발표 또는 연구 참여 경험자 우대


전공

  • 컴퓨터공학, 전산학, 전자공학, 산업공학


전형절차

  • 서류심사 → 코딩테스트 → 1차 직무 인터뷰(온라인)

* 전형 절차는 변경될 수 있습니다. 서류 합격 시 전형 절차에 대해 별도로 안내 해 드립니다.

title: Project Manager - VAPR
description:
JOB TITLE: Site Leader
COMPANY: The PAC Group (PAC)
PROJECT: Vehicle Upfit & Retrofit Services
LOCATION: Florida

POSITION SUMMARY

The Site Leader is responsible for overseeing daily installation operations related to VAPR system deployment on commercial fleet vehicles. This role ensures adherence to safety, quality, and productivity requirements while coordinating technicians, materials, and workflow across all installation activities.

The Site Leader serves as the primary on-site operational point of contact, responsible for execution, coordination with customer representatives, and overall site performance.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Site Leader is expected to maintain operational knowledge of the installation process and support field activities as needed to ensure continuous workflow.

This position reports to the Deployment / Program Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate daily activities of installation teams.

  • Ensure adherence to standardized installation procedures (SOPs).

  • Assign technicians based on workload, skill level, and production targets.

  • Conduct daily briefings to align teams on safety, production goals, and priorities.

  • Maintain consistent workflow across all installation steps.

Production and Execution Management

  • Track daily installation output against established production plans.

  • Monitor cycle times and identify operational bottlenecks.

  • Implement corrective actions to maintain production throughput.

  • Ensure efficient vehicle flow through staging, installation, and completion.

  • Coordinate readiness of tools, materials, and installation kits to avoid delays.

Vehicle Flow and Site Coordination

  • Coordinate vehicle availability and staging within the site or yard.

  • Ensure proper sequencing of vehicles in alignment with the installation plan.

  • Support vehicle movement coordination as needed to maintain workflow.

  • Prevent congestion, idle time, and process interruptions.

Quality Oversight

  • Ensure all installations follow approved procedures and quality standards.

  • Support inspection activities and coordinate rework when required.

  • Monitor First Pass Yield (FPY) performance and defect trends.

  • Escalate recurring quality issues to program and engineering teams.

Safety and Compliance

  • Enforce PPE requirements and safe work practices.

  • Ensure compliance with Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) requirements and established safety procedures.

  • Maintain clean, organized, and hazard-free work areas.

  • Report and escalate safety risks, incidents, and near misses.

Client Coordination

  • Serve as the primary on-site point of contact for the customer.

  • Coordinate daily execution with customer site representatives.

  • Provide updates regarding production status, risks, and operational constraints.

  • Escalate issues related to site access, logistics, or operations.

Hands-On Support

  • Maintain working knowledge of all installation steps and processes.

  • Provide hands-on support during periods of peak demand or operational gaps.

  • Support onboarding and on-the-job training of technicians.

Reporting and Communication

  • Provide daily reporting on production, quality, and safety metrics.

  • Track issues, delays, and risks impacting project execution.

  • Ensure proper documentation and traceability, including VIN-level tracking.

  • Coordinate with PAC leadership and cross-functional teams.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and workflow.

  • Support implementation of updated procedures and best practices.

  • Provide feedback to program leadership regarding operational performance.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in automotive installation, fleet upfit, vehicle modification, or similar field operations.

  • Experience leading field teams of 8–16 technicians.

  • Ability to read, understand, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Strong organizational and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in high-volume, fast-paced environments.

  • Valid driver's license.

  • Ability to perform hands-on technical tasks within the installation process when required.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with fleet installation or vehicle modification programs.

  • Experience working in structured production environments, including takt-based or high-volume operations.

  • Multi-site deployment experience.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers.

English Communication

Work Authorization

  • Must have valid legal authorization to work in the United States.

  • Must follow all applicable safety regulations and procedures at all times.

title: Expediter (Full-Time w/ Benefits)
description:
About the Club

Founded in 1916, Palma Ceia Golf & Country Club is Tampa’s premier private club, known for its rich traditions, elegant surroundings, and commitment to exceptional service. We take pride in creating a welcoming environment for our Members, guests, and employees while fostering teamwork, professionalism, and genuine hospitality.

Position Summary

Palma Ceia Golf & Country Club is seeking a dependable and energetic Expediter to join our Kitchen team. This position will begin on a part-time basis, with the potential to transition into a full-time position based on performance, availability, and the operational needs of the Club.

The Expediter plays a key role in the Kitchen by coordinating the final stages of food preparation and ensuring that orders leave the kitchen accurately, efficiently, and according to the Club’s presentation standards. Serving as an important link between the culinary team and front-of-house staff, the Expediter monitors food tickets, organizes completed dishes, verifies order accuracy, and helps maintain an efficient flow of service.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the flow of completed food orders from the Kitchen to the front-of-house service team.
  • Monitor food tickets and communicate with culinary team members to ensure orders are prepared accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Verify that each order is complete and meets the Club’s standards for quality and presentation before leaving the Kitchen.
  • Confirm garnishes, accompaniments, modifications, allergy notifications, and special requests.
  • Organize completed dishes by table and seat position to support accurate and efficient service.
  • Communicate clearly with chefs, cooks, servers, food runners, and management regarding order status and timing.
  • Assist with running food to Members and guests when needed.
  • Help coordinate the timing of multiple courses and tables to maintain a smooth flow of service.
  • Quickly identify and communicate missing, incorrect, or delayed items to the appropriate culinary team member.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary expediting station.
  • Assist with stocking and replenishing plates, garnishes, service items, and other supplies needed at the expo station.
  • Follow all Club standards and applicable requirements related to food handling, sanitation, safety, and cleanliness.
  • Maintain a professional appearance and positive, team-oriented attitude.
  • Assist the culinary team with additional duties as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Executive Chef or Kitchen management.

Qualifications

Previous experience in a restaurant kitchen, culinary operation, private club, or similar hospitality environment is preferred but not required.

The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to remain composed and organized during high-volume meal periods. Candidates must be dependable, team-oriented, and comfortable communicating between both Kitchen and front-of-house teams.

Availability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and Club events, is required.

Schedule & Full-Time Potential

This position will initially be part-time, with scheduled hours based on the needs of the Kitchen and Club operations.

There is potential for this position to transition into a full-time opportunity. A transition to full-time employment is not guaranteed and will depend on factors including job performance, reliability, availability, scheduling needs, and the Club’s staffing requirements.

Physical Requirements

This position requires the ability to stand and walk for extended periods; bend, reach, lift, and carry food-service items; safely handle plates and trays; and work in a fast-paced Kitchen environment with exposure to heat, steam, noise, and varying temperatures.

Compensation:

  • Full-time position.
  • Competitive wages starting at $18.00 per hour.
  • Complimentary chef-prepared employee meals.
  • Employer-provided uniforms.
  • Paid time off (vacation, sick, personal, and holidays).
  • Comprehensive group medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Life and disability insurance coverage.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.

Join Our Team:
If you take pride in providing top-tier service and enjoy working in a refined, member-focused environment, we invite you to apply to join the Palma Ceia Golf & Country Club team.

title: SCIENTIST OR ENGINEER - WIND ENGINEERING
company: Insurance Institute for Business & Home Safety
description:
About IBHS

The Insurance Institute for Business & Home Safety (IBHS) is an independent, nonprofit scientific research and communications organization supported by property insurers and reinsurers. Severe weather disrupts lives, displaces families, and drives financial loss. At IBHS, we conduct world-class research and translate our findings into practical solutions that help strengthen homes and businesses, reduce avoidable damage, and support more resilient communities.

About the Role

IBHS is seeking a Scientist or Engineer to support wind engineering research focused on improving the resilience of homes and commercial buildings. Based in Richburg, South Carolina, this role will help plan and conduct laboratory and field studies, analyze building performance under wind-related hazards, and translate research findings into practical recommendations.

The successful candidate will collaborate with researchers, engineers, technicians, contractors, and external partners throughout the research lifecycle, from experimental design and specimen preparation through testing, analysis, and communication of results.

Why This Role Matters

Wind research at IBHS helps improve understanding of how buildings and construction materials perform during severe weather. This position will contribute technical evidence that may inform stronger construction practices, test methods, building codes, standards, and risk-reduction strategies.

What You'll Do

• Plan and execute wind engineering research projects in collaboration with research and technical teams.

• Develop research plans, test procedures, schedules, instrumentation requirements, data-collection methods, and analysis approaches.

• Design or support the design of laboratory test specimens, experimental setups, and measurement systems.

• Coordinate specimen construction, instrumentation, test preparation, and testing activities with technicians, contractors, and other project partners.

• Operate or support the operation of wind-testing equipment and data-acquisition systems.

• Analyze experimental and field data using appropriate engineering, statistical, or computational methods.

• Evaluate the performance of buildings, components, materials, and construction practices under wind and wind-driven rain conditions.

• Document research methods, findings, limitations, and recommendations in technical reports, presentations, and other publications.

• Translate complex scientific findings into clear, practical information for technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Contribute technical findings that may support improvements to construction practices, test standards, building codes, and risk models.

• Participate in field investigations following significant wind events when needed.

• Maintain accurate project documentation and follow applicable laboratory and workplace safety procedures.

• Build collaborative relationships with universities, industry professionals, standards organizations, and other research partners as appropriate.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

• Master's degree in civil engineering, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, wind engineering, atmospheric science, or a closely related field.

• Experience conducting engineering or scientific research through laboratory testing, field studies, numerical analysis, or a related setting.

• Ability to develop test plans, analyze technical data, and draw evidence-based conclusions.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage assigned work across multiple phases of a research project.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences.

• Ability to work effectively with researchers, engineers, technicians, contractors, and external partners.

• Willingness and ability to work onsite for experiments, equipment setup, and other activities that cannot be performed remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

• Doctorate in wind engineering, civil or structural engineering, atmospheric science, or a related discipline.

• Experience with wind effects on buildings, building aerodynamics, wind-driven rain, structural loading, or building-envelope performance.

• Experience designing and conducting large-scale or boundary-layer wind experiments using instrumentation, sensors, and data-acquisition systems.

• Experience with statistical analysis, scientific programming, computational modeling, or visualization tools.

• Knowledge of building codes, construction or test standards, technical publishing, or Professional Engineer licensure relevant to the selected discipline.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development

title: Development Engineer I
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.


What You Can Expect

You have a key support role with responsibility for new product design, development, and commercialization; and/ or to maintain in the market innovative medica device products in order to further Zimmer Biomet's mission and grow Zimmer Biomet's market leadership position.

How You'll Create Impact

With oversight from supervisor and mentorship by senior peers:

  • Stays current with and understands relevant arthroplasty product intended use, clinical procedures, and related regulations and standards.
  • Identifies user needs through engagement with product users (often Orthopedic Surgeons) and observation of similar device usage.
  • Translates targeted user needs into design requirements/ inputs which satisfy unmet market needs to achieve business goals while also complying with global regulatory requirements and recognized external industry standards.
  • Creates product designs which fully address targeted user needs/ requirements, and authors design rationale to document basis of all design features.
  • Prepares and reviews information for invention disclosures and patents.
  • Initiates, provides instruction for an coordinates with support from Zimmer Biomet cross-functional team members in the production and inspection of product prototypes for preliminary evaluation; and final design verification, design validation and process validation.
  • Creates product production specifications which appropriately account for design for manufacturability (process capability) and inspection.
  • Identifies and documents critical to quality product features based on product intended use, design requirements, associated user risks and the design itself to ensure appropriate quality control inspection plans are generated.
  • Evaluates, verifies and validates product designs relative to design requirements and to reduce user risk in compliance with Zimmer Biomet procedures and global regulatory requirements.
  • Supports Zimmer Biomet Quality, Sourcing and Manufacturing teams with new product design transfer tasks for production of market release quantities.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the ADA.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Demonstrated good written and verbal communication skills including presentation skills required.
  • Experience with product design and development desired.
  • Knowledge of ASME GD&T standards with application to product design desired.
  • Knowledge of various maufacturing processes (including subtractive machining, anodization, additive manufacturing, forging, casting, plastic molding) and material science for application in new product development desired.
  • FDA QSR and EU MDR medical device regulatory requirements, and industry/ regulatory body recognized technical product standards knowledge desired.
  • Statistics knowledge with application to sample size determination and null hypothesis testing desired.
  • Design for Six Sigma experience desired.
  • Parametric CAD modeling experience preferred; NX Unigraphics Software Proficiency desired
  • Finite element analysis predictive modeling experience desired.
  • Microsoft Office Suite software proficiency required.

Your Background

  • Minimum B.S. degree from an ABET accredited school (or global equivalent) in one of the following engineering disciplines: Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering Technology, Bioengineering Technology, Aerospace Engineering or Aeronautical Engineering.

Travel Expectations

$65,000 - $80,000

title: Food Scientist I
description:
SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Food Scientist supports R&D initiatives ranging from new product development and innovation to product quality improvement, sensory analysis, shelf-life evaluation, and regulatory compliance. This role requires applying strong technical and scientific principles to drive innovation, ensure product excellence, and manage assigned projects from concept through commercialization with guidance from management. This role is based on the production facility and requires regular work in the plant environment to support production trials, scale-ups, and product launches. The position demands comfort with ambiguity, initiative in problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex challenges into actionable solutions.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Apply food science and engineering principles to deliver technical and innovative solutions for pistachio, almond, and nut-based products.
  • Manage assigned technical projects with increasing independence, taking initiative to identify challenges, link cross-functional insights, and drive progress amid ambiguity.
  • Apply ingredient functionality knowledge to improve existing product quality and develop innovative new products.
  • Plan and execute bench, pilot, and plant trials, and support commercial scale-ups to resolve processing challenges.
  • Support evaluation of new technologies for roasting, seasoning, and nut-based product applications, driving innovation, solving technical challenges, and keeping pace with industry trends.
  • Support regulatory compliance regulatory compliance activities by maintaining accurate nutrition, ingredient, and labeling information for all products and supporting alignment with domestic and international requirements.
  • Apply sensory science methodologies to assess product quality, conduct discrimination testing, support descriptive analysis, and generate actionable recommendations.
  • Conduct data-driven shelf-life studies; evaluate correlations between organoleptic changes, lipid oxidation, and packaging film properties. Recommend shelf-life extension strategies.
  • Maintain detailed project documentation, specifications, reports, and data archives.
  • Support and promote a safe, healthy, and compliant work environment.
  • Build effective cross-functional relationships and collaborate with marketing, sales, and operations to ensure successful commercialization and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Language skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are necessary.
  • Ability to communicate and interact with all levels of the organization, including senior management, customers, consumers, suppliers, and co-manufacturers.

QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • B.S. in Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related food discipline (e.g., Chemical or Agricultural Engineering with food industry coursework or experience). Or M.S. in Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related food discipline with no industry experience will also be considered; relevant thesis research, pilot plant, or internship work is valued.
  • Minimum 1- 2 years of relevant food industry experience (internships and co-ops count).
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and navigate.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Hands-on, self-driven, and results-oriented with a collaborative and innovative mindset.
  • Willing and able to work in a production environment with heat, noise, and dust, and to support plant trials outside standard hours when needed.
  • Preferred: working knowledge of GMP and food safety systems; proficiency in Excel and basic statistical analysis.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • None required; HACCP or PCQI certification is a plus.

Pay Range: $73,000 - $80,000
