title: Senior Director Release Management
description:
We are looking for a strategic and transformation-focused Head of Release Management to modernize the release ecosystem across Product and Technology. This role will lead the shift from manual, process-heavy release governance to a modern, data-driven and platform-enabled model where release safety, compliance and operational readiness are embedded directly into engineering workflows, deployment pipelines and platform capabilities.

The successful candidate will define the long-term release strategy across multiple release types, including planned product releases, service updates, emergency and security releases, platform releases, customer onboarding releases and future AI/model releases. They will establish risk-based guardrails, policy-as-code, automated compliance checks, release risk scoring, automated evidence collection and progressive deployment controls to reduce reliance on manual approvals and governance forums.

This role will also shape environment strategy, release intelligence and engineering enablement across Product and Technology. Working closely with Platform Engineering, DevOps, Security, Product, Quality, Cloud Operations and engineering leadership, the Head of Release Management will drive the adoption of automated readiness checks, environment observability, telemetry-led insights, predictive risk management and modern deployment practices.

A key part of the role is building a release management capability that acts as an enablement and transformation function rather than a coordination gate. The role will lead, coach and develop the team, create investment cases and transformation roadmaps, and promote a culture of evidence-based decision making, shared ownership, progressive delivery and continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Define and execute the release ecosystem strategy across Product and Technology.
  • Embed release controls into developer workflows, deployment pipelines and platform capabilities.
  • Establish automated, auditable and risk-based controls, including policy-as-code, automated compliance checks and release risk scoring.
  • Define differentiated release models for product, service, emergency, security, platform, customer onboarding and AI/model releases.
  • Lead release-led customer onboarding governance, including readiness, environment validation, support readiness and post-onboarding assurance.
  • Shape AI-native release management practices for AI-generated code, agentic workflows, prompts, models and knowledge assets.
  • Own or co-own environment strategy, shared environment governance, readiness, utilization and observability.
  • Build release intelligence capabilities using telemetry, operational data and AI to predict deployment risks and readiness gaps.
  • Drive engineering enablement by helping teams deploy and onboard customers safely, reliably and independently.
  • Lead and develop a release management function focused on transformation, automation and continuous improvement.
  • Build investment cases and transformation roadmaps to secure the tooling, automation, telemetry and platform capabilities required to modernize release management.
  • 10+ years of experience in software delivery, release management, DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud operations, engineering program management or engineering leadership.
  • Proven track record modernizing release, deployment or operational governance models across complex product, platform or service environments.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD, progressive delivery, feature flags, deployment automation, policy-as-code, automated compliance, observability, SRE principles and modern engineering practices.
  • Experience defining release approaches for planned, emergency, security, platform, service and out-of-band releases.
  • Experience with environment strategy, shared environment governance, test environment utilization, customer onboarding readiness, environment observability and ephemeral or on-demand environments.
  • Experience improving customer onboarding, production readiness, service transition or customer activation processes in a cloud, SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Ability to use data, telemetry, dashboards, predictive insights or AI to improve release risk management, deployment reliability and engineering productivity.
  • Experience building investment cases and transformation proposals to secure funding for tooling, automation, platform capability, environment improvements or operating model change.
  • Strong stakeholder leadership skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, Platform, Security, Operations, Support and executive stakeholders.
  • Proven change management capability, with experience moving teams from traditional governance models to modern, platform-enabled and evidence-based release practices.
  • Strategic transformation leader who is a systems thinker, data-driven decision maker, AI-aware, security-conscious, and passionate about engineering enablement.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

title: Career Counselor II
description:
Living Resources is a non-profit agency dedicated to empowering individuals with disabilities or other life-altering conditions to live with dignity, independence, and purpose. We work with, and for, families by providing peace of mind. All employees are to be respectful and supportive of families. We are working with them as partners, providing support and services.


To work for Living Resources is to make a difference in the lives of others. Living Resources employees provide individuals with disabilities and other life-altering conditions the support they need to thrive and lead active, full lives. Providing your standard resume will help demonstrate your familiarity with resume formats that candidates may need guidance developing.


The Career Counselor II supports individuals with disabilities—primarily those receiving services through OPWDD (Office for People with Developmental Disabilities) and/or ACCES-VR (Adult Career and Continuing Education Services – Vocational Rehabilitation)—in identifying, preparing for, and maintaining meaningful employment. The Career Counselor II provides vocational counseling, job coaching, and individualized support to help individuals identify and achieve their career goals. The Career Counselor II will evaluate employability and identify suitable employment goals through structured assessment activities, including community-based work assessments and work-readiness training. This position involves collaboration with employers, families, and other agencies, which requires local travel in the Capital Region. Candidates must be organized, adaptable, and able to manage a dynamic schedule based on client needs. The Career Counselor II is responsible for aligning and demonstrating agency values in carrying out the duties of this position.

• Manage a caseload of individuals receiving OPWDD and/or ACCES-VR services

• Assess individuals’ interests, strengths, and employment goals using person-centered planning

• Conduct Community-Based Work Assessments

• Provide Pre-Employment Transition Services and/or support clients participating in OPWDD’s Employment Training Program

• Assist individuals in developing job-readiness skills and preparing for interviews and job searches

title: Draftsperson
description:
Reporting to the Drawing Systems Controller, the Engineering Draftsperson will provide multi-disciplinary drafting support across the Geelong Refinery.

The role will primarily focus on reducing the backlog of operational drawing revisions, including updating drawings from approved redline mark-ups, field-verified information and engineering inputs.

The role may also support project drawing updates as required.

This is a contract position based predominantly on site at the Geelong Refinery. Regular site attendance is required to undertake field verification, clarify drawing mark-ups and work directly with refinery personnel. Some remote work may be accommodated where appropriate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver drafting services across process, safety, mechanical, piping, instrumentation, electrical, civil and site layout drawings.
  • Produce, revise and maintain high-quality 2D engineering drawings using AutoCAD and raster editing tools.
  • Update controlled drawings from approved redline mark-ups, field information and engineering inputs.
  • Review mark-ups and clarify incomplete or conflicting information with engineers, technicians and drawing originators.
  • Conduct site inspections and field verification to confirm existing plant conditions.
  • Support the as-building of operational changes, MOCs and project work.
  • Ensure drawings comply with company procedures, engineering standards and drawing conventions.
  • Progress drawings through the required checking, approval, revision control and release processes.
  • Support document control activities and maintain accurate drawing records within Lunr.
  • Provide progress updates and raise issues that may affect priorities or completion.

About You

You will be an experienced Draftsperson who is comfortable working across multiple engineering disciplines in a complex brownfield industrial environment.

You will have strong technical drafting skills, sound attention to detail and the confidence to identify and clarify incomplete or inconsistent information. You will also be comfortable working on site and engaging directly with engineers, technicians, Operations, Maintenance and project personnel.

You Will Bring

  • At least five years of multi-disciplinary engineering drafting experience ideally in refining, petrochemical, oil and gas or another heavy industrial environment.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and AutoCAD Raster Design, or equivalent raster editing software.
  • Experience updating drawings from redline mark-ups and verified field information.
  • Experience with electrical and instrumentation drawings, with P&ID experience highly regarded.
  • Experience working in brownfield and hazardous-area facilities.
  • Knowledge of engineering drawing standards, revision control and as-building processes.
  • Experience using an Electronic Document Management System such as Lunr.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to drawing accuracy and quality.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines.
  • Ability and willingness to work predominantly on site at the Geelong Refinery.

About Viva Energy

Join a team that values diversity. Viva Energy is a great place to be yourself. We believe in our people, trust in their positive intentions, and empower everyone to amplify their voice across the business. We value inclusion because that’s how we get the best outcomes.

Awarded the WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality for the past five years highlights that we are driven by our people and continuing our focus on making Viva Energy reflect the ever-changing face of Australia.

We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and encourage and support diversity in our traditional and non-traditional roles.

At Viva Energy Australia, we believe flexibility is the new normal. We are open to flexibility options including hybrid, part-time, job-share and flexibility in start and finish times. We are happy to explore what this could look like for you during the recruitment process.

description:
National Radio Astronomy Observatory


Title: Scientist (Open Rank)

Location: NRAO Array Operations Center, PO Box 0, SOCORRO, New Mexico, United States of America• NRAO Albuquerque Office, 800 Bradbury Dr SE Ste 235, ALBUQUERQUE, New Mexico, United States of America

Requisition Number: 103

Job Family: Astronomy

Pay Type: Salary

Required Education: SCI

Position Description:

Position Summary

The National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) is a prestigious research and development organization that plays a vital role in the study of the universe. Associated Universities, Inc. (AUI) is a nonprofit organization that manages and operates the NRAO under a cooperative agreement with the National Science Foundation. The Observatory is a hub for technological and scientific collaboration, operating state-of-the-art radio telescope facilities for use by the international scientific community. The Observatory has been instrumental in the study of black holes, galaxies, and the early universe.

The development of an X-Ka wideband receiver spanning 8-38 GHz has begun for the VLBA, enabling new scientific and astrometric capabilities for the instrument. This highly anticipated upgrade will add flexibility and enhance performance by significantly increasing the instantaneous bandwidth available for channelization, enabling access to previously unobservable frequencies, and enabling more efficient and comprehensive spectral studies.

The NRAO is seeking a Scientist, Open Rank (Assistant, Associate, or Scientist) to be the Project Scientist for the VLBA X-Ka Wideband Receiver Project. The appointee will be expected to spend 75% of their time on functional work as part of the VLBA Development Team, with the remaining 25% available for independent research. The primary responsibility of this position is to help oversee the development and integration of a novel X-Ka receiver system being developed for installation on the VLBA. The appointment will be on the NRAO Scientist track, with starting rank determined by the candidate’s experience.

  • This position will be a three-year appointment, with the possibility of renewal subject to observatory needs, budget and mutual agreement.
  • It will be based in New Mexico at either the Albuquerque or Socorro NRAO office with travel between the two sites as required.

What You Will be Doing

Technical Development and Integration:

  • Capture and maintain top level project requirements
  • Work with project leadership to develop and maintain project foundation documents
  • Organize testing and commissioning campaigns and preparation of test reports
  • Help coordinate installation while minimizing impacts to the VLBA observing program
  • Prepare material for and participate within project reviews
  • Establish standard observing bands
  • Participate in trade studies

Community and User Support:

  • Communicate with scientific users and external mission partners
  • Prepare user- and public-facing documentation such as user guides, news articles, press releases

Scientific Contribution:

  • Contribute to the broader VLBA development portfolio by consulting and collaborating with teams on parallel projects like the Next Generation Radar (ngRadar) and the Next Generation VLA (ngVLA).
  • Maintain awareness of developments at related astronomical facilities
  • Maintain an active independent research program which ideally makes significant use of Observatory facilities

Work Environment

The position is based in an office environment. The successful candidate must be able to work at a computer with detailed and complex textual and numerical information.

Who You Are:

Education

  • A PhD. In astronomy or related field

Experience

  • At least one year of related experience using radio interferometry for astronomical research

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong communication skills in written and oral English
  • Strong inter-personal skills
  • Familiarity with Linux / Unix operating systems
  • Ability to travel

Preferred:

  • High-level understanding of the functionality of radio telescopes
  • Experience scheduling VLBI experiments
  • Experience reducing VLBI data
  • Experience within a leadership team of medium to large projects
  • Proficiency in the Python computer language

Additional Requirement

Observatory employees must be authorized to work in the United States. The Observatory presently cannot sponsor H-1B Visas for this position.

Total Rewards:

Compensation

The starting salary rate of this position is between $85,000-$138,000 per year. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include; education, experience, skills, competencies, other qualifications of the successful candidate, as well as internal equity and labor market conditions.

Benefits:

Associated Universities, Inc (AUI) offers a comprehensive benefits package addressing the needs of employees and their families with most benefits beginning on the first day of employment, subject to eligibility requirements. AUI provides:

  • Excellent paid time off (13 holidays, annual accrual of up to 24 vacation days)
  • Medical, dental and vision plans are effective on the first day of employment.
  • AUI’s retirement benefit contributes an amount equal to 10 percent of a qualified participant’s base pay with no required employee contribution.
  • Click Total Rewards for more information.

Application Instructions:

For consideration, select the “Apply” button. Please prepare a single PDF document consisting of the following items:

  • Cover letter stating why you are interested in this position – the letter should describe how the you match the position and qualifications summarized above (no more than 2 pages)
  • Curriculum vitae including publications list
  • Summary of past research (1 page)
  • Future research plan describing specifically synergies with NRAO facilities (2 pages)
  • Summary of past technical, observational, and management experience relevant to this position (1 page)
  • The names and contact information for three individuals familiar with your technical, scientific, and management abilities. Candidates selected for an interview must be prepared to submit three letters of recommendation. Instructions for letter submission will be provided at the time of request.

The PDF file is to be uploaded with the “Additional Documents” feature at the applicant portal. The deadline for receipt of complete applications is October, 5, 2026. Please direct inquiries to careers@nrao.edu.

description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. What You Can Expect

Join Zimmer Biomet's Development Co-Op Program!

Our co-op program is a multi-rotational commitment aligned to your school's cooperative program curriculum. While at ZB, students will act as engineers managing daily research and development tasks in a global MedTech organization. title: Predoctoral Research Associate (Summer 2027)
description:
Harvard Business School (HBS) is seeking multiple Predoctoral Research Associates starting in Summer 2027 to support an assigned faculty member in one of the following academic units.

  • Accounting & Management
  • Business, Government and the International Economy
  • Entrepreneurial Management
  • Finance
  • General Management
  • Marketing
  • Negotiation Organizations & Markets
  • Organizational Behavior
  • Strategy
  • Technology and Operations Management

Research subjects can include but are not limited to: labor economics, marketing economics, private equity / venture capital disclosures and taxation, decision making and gender stereotypes in shaping beliefs, industrial organization and the market design of digital platforms, media economics and economics of digital platforms, emerging financial technologies and alternative data, political economy and empirical corporate finance, R&D strategy and the economics of innovation, entrepreneurial management, corporate social responsibilities focused on climate change and gender diversity, asset pricing shaping politics and markets, specialized knowledge commercialization and micro-geographic environments shaping innovation, behavioral economics, intergroup inequity, and tech strategy.

Please note the faculty currently hiring include:

  • Ray Kluender: Professor Kluender researches analyzes the determinants of financial well-being and the nature of financial distress, traces the frontier of how entrepreneurship and technology can solve social problems, and identifies market failures and the implications for appropriate corrective policies. Current projects involve partnerships with large-scale financial technology companies and employ a wide range of empirical approaches. His predoc researcher will get hands-on experience with every stage of the research project from conception through publication and will develop a wide range of empirical skills to prepare them for PhD programs. A two-year commitment is expected. Professor Kluender's three prior predocs are currently pursuing PhDs at Princeton, Berkeley, and Harvard.

Overview: The Predoctoral Research Associate position reports directly to faculty supervisors and administrative manager in the Research Staff Services office. Ideal candidates will be comfortable in an environment that requires a high level of independence, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to use discretionary judgment.

Primary duties:

  • Work under the general direction of HBS faculty on topics central to HBS research agenda. Provide subject-area knowledge, analysis and interpretation to faculty member. Identify and explore a wide-range of questions related to faculty’s research agenda.
  • Write cases, case supplements, project reports, and policy memos from start to finish creating original writing based on subject-area expertise, research, and interviews, and write articles for applicable business audiences such as Harvard Business Review.
  • Develop, design, conduct, analyze, and implement research using data science knowledge and prior knowledge of requested statistical packages. Perform statistical programming. Experience with NLP.
  • Manage and manipulate data using requested packages, such as STATA, Python, R, or MATLAB.
  • Ensure compliance with department, University, and federal regulations. Complete work with only general direction. Be aware of department, School, University policies and potential outside research policies.
  • Under general direction of faculty member, must be able to take complex research ideas, concepts, and methodologies and apply them to new projects and situations. Must be able to structure assignments and keep faculty member informed as necessary, using own judgment.
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • Responsible for other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with a GPA above 3.5 is required.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

Proven evidence of independent research in specific advanced field of study. Evidence of prior high-quality, original academic writing, and background in analysis and interpretation of relevant data, research, news, and literature is helpful. Ability to read academic, subject-specific information and write a reasoned and thoughtful analysis, as well as produce a creative interpretation, is a must.

The candidate must have extremely high standards in terms of quality of work, attention to detail, strong organization skills, and absolute commitment to task completion. Must be able to balance multiple tasks and shifting priorities under tight deadlines at an accelerated pace when necessary. It is helpful if the candidate is familiar with navigating a complex organization, such as Harvard Business School.

  • Appointment End Date: This position is approved for a 1-year term (with possibility of renewal/extension). These are term appointments starting summer 2027 through June 30, 2028, with an expectation of reappointment until June 30, 2028, based on funding and performance. All Predoctoral Research Associate roles at HBS are structured as one-year term appointments, but faculty strongly prefer candidates willing to commit for two years.

  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education
  • Other Information:

      The recruiting process starts now and continues into 2027 with offers typically finalized in the late spring. The recruiting process is rolling. Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Candidates with external deadlines should notify the recruiter as soon as possible.

      This is a hybrid position which we consider to be a combination of remote and onsite work at our Boston, MA based campus. HBS expects all staff to be onsite a minimum of 3 days per week and departments provide onsite coverage Monday – Friday. Specific hours and days onsite will be determined by business needs and are subject to change with appropriate advanced notice.

      We may conduct candidate interviews virtually (phone and/or via Zoom) and/or in-person for this role.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

Senior Data Engineer – Airside 4.0, ADB SAFEGATE Labs India

Company: ADB SAFEGATE Labs India

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 5-7 years in Data Engineering role or equivalent

Who Are We?

ADB SAFEGATE is the global leader in airside solutions, supporting operations at more than 3,000 airports through a network of 40 offices worldwide.

We are establishing ADB SAFEGATE LABS in Hyderabad, our newest extension of global engineering capabilities. The Labs focus on building and evolving digital platforms, data-driven services, and AI-enabled solutions that support airport operations across Airfield, Apron, Tower, and Weather domains.

As part of a globally distributed engineering organisation, the Hyderabad Labs work closely with teams across Europe, the Americas, and Asia, contributing directly to solutions deployed at airports worldwide.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Build the data foundation for the future of airport operations.

We're seeking a Senior Data Engineer to architect and implement advanced data solutions that power our Airside 4.0 vision—the next generation of intelligent, automated, and connected airport operations.

What is Airside 4.0?

It's the digital transformation of airport ground operations, combining IoT sensors, real-time data streams, predictive analytics, and AI to make airports safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Think: thousands of IoT devices generating real-time data on aircraft movements, lighting systems, weather conditions, gate operations, and ground equipment—all requiring sophisticated data pipelines and analytics platforms.

This role combines technical depth, architectural thinking, and the opportunity to shape how airports worldwide leverage data.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Data Platform & Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks and Azure
  • Architect solutions processing large-scale structured and unstructured data from IoT devices, airport sensors, and operational systems
  • Integrate real-time and batch data streams ensuring high performance, reliability, and data quality
  • Design optimized data models for analytics of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data
  • Make architectural decisions on storage strategies, processing frameworks, and integration patterns

Technical Leadership & Best Practices

  • Mentor junior data engineers; establish coding standards, testing practices, and operational excellence
  • Champion data governance, security, and compliance standards; drive CI/CD automation
  • Lead technical design reviews and influence architectural decisions
  • Proactively monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipeline performance and reliability

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Collaborate with Data Science, ML Engineering, Product, and Business teams to translate requirements into robust solutions
  • Partner with Software Engineers and DevOps teams for seamless integration and deployment
  • Document architectural decisions, data models, and processes for knowledge sharing
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

We're Looking for Someone With:

  • 5+ years in data engineering, with strong track record of delivering scalable solutions in cloud environments
  • Expert-level experience with Databricks and Azure Data Services
  • Proven experience building production-grade data pipelines processing large-scale datasets
  • Experience with microservices architecture using Docker, Kubernetes
  • Experience with real-time data processing (streaming architectures, event-driven systems)
  • Deep understanding of data modeling techniques: dimensional modeling, data vault, star/snowflake schemas
  • Expert knowledge of ETL/ELT best practices and modern data integration patterns

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in aviation, transportation, or mission-critical systems
  • Advanced proficiency in Python or Scala for data processing and pipeline development
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and query optimization techniques
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated testing in data engineering workflows
  • Knowledge of data pipeline orchestration tools (Azure Data Factory, Airflow, Databricks Workflows)

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Relevant certifications (Azure, Databricks) are highly valued
  • Equivalent experience with strong technical foundation considered

Why Join ADB SAFEGATE Labs India?

  • Build from the ground up: Be part of the founding team at our ADB Safegate Labs India —shape processes, culture, and service excellence standards
  • Global impact & exposure: Join a 1,500+ employee organization with presence in 40 countries; work on solutions deployed at 3,000+ airports worldwide
  • Collaborative culture: Work in a flexible, innovation-driven environment that values technical excellence and continuous improvement
  • Complex challenges: Support sophisticated airside systems combining IoT, real-time control, cloud platforms, and critical infrastructure
  • Competitive package: Industry-leading compensation

title: Research Assistant I
description:
We are seeking a dedicated, highly organized Laboratory Technician to help advance our research on aging and associated disorders as well as methods to mitigate them. This role involves characterizing the aging dynamics of cells and animals in both healthy and diseased states and assisting in the development of age-reversal interventions as potential therapeutics. The successful candidate will employ both in vitro and in vivo (mouse model) experimental approaches under the guidance of senior researchers and must be enthusiastic about learning new techniques across a wide range of experimental settings.

A major component of this position will be support of our mouse research program. This includes routine colony management (breeding, weaning, and basic health monitoring), experimental procedures such as oral gavage and injections, blood and tissue collection (e.g., cheek bleeds, perfusions, dissections), and participation in physiological (frailty, metabolic, behavioral, etc.) assessments. Prior experience with all of these techniques is not required; however, comfort working with mice, a strong interest in animal-based research, and a commitment to following detailed protocols with technical precision are essential.

In addition to animal work, the technician will be trained in and expected to execute tissue and molecular analyses such as immunohistochemistry (IHC), microscopy, tissue sectioning, and standard bench techniques (e.g., RNA/DNA extraction, PCR, Western blotting, and basic bioinformatics/data processing). Prior experience with these skills is useful but not required. The ideal candidate will be meticulous and reliable, with excellent organizational skills, careful record-keeping, and strong communication with the PI and other lab members.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain mouse colonies, including breeding, weaning, health monitoring, and experimental scheduling.
  • Perform experimental procedures in mice (e.g., handling, gavage, injections, blood and tissue collection, behavioral testing) under supervision and in accordance with approved protocols.
  • Tissue processing and staining (e.g., IHC).
  • Perform standard experimental tests and procedures (e.g., basic molecular biology and biochemistry assays) with high technical precision.
  • Accurately record, organize, and document experimental procedures, observations, and results using established laboratory techniques and data management systems.
  • Communicate progress, issues, and results clearly to supervising researchers.
  • Help maintain an orderly, well-organized laboratory environment and adhere to all safety and animal welfare regulations
  • Conduct related job duties as required.

Basic Qualifications:

  • College background or equivalent work experience, in molecular/cell biology, biochemistry, or a related field.
  • At least one year of work experience in a research laboratory with relevant skills and techniques, (relevant course work may count towards experience).


Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience handling rodents strongly preferred.
  • College degree (BS/BA) preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills, including careful labeling, sample tracking, and documentation.
  • High attention to detail and technical accuracy; ability to follow written and verbal protocols precisely.
  • Demonstrated willingness and ability to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving experimental needs.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Term: This is a one-year term position from the date of hire, with the possibility of extension, contingent upon work performance and continued funding to support the position.
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hrs. per week | Monday - Friday | 9:00 am - 5:00 pm
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Criminal, Pre-Placement Medical Evaluation

Your work will help maximize reimbursement, maintain compliance with Ford Motor Company policies, and support excellent customer service.

• Process claims by the next business day (or within required timelines) following RO close.
• Track claim status, follow up on pending, rejected, or charged-back claims, and assist with corrections and resubmissions.

• Support weekly audits, status reports for the Service Manager, and preparation for manufacturer warranty audits.
• Communicate with Service Advisors, Technicians, and management to resolve documentation issues or questions about warranty coverage.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Basic Requirements
• High school diploma or GED required.
• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and accuracy in data entry and documentation.
• Solid computer skills and ability to learn dealership systems quickly.
• Knowledge of CDK Global (CDK DMS) software preferred (or willingness and ability to become proficient quickly). Experience with other dealer management systems (e.g., Reynolds & Reynolds) is a plus.
• Basic understanding of automotive service operations, repair orders, and warranty processes preferred.
• Good written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively with technicians, advisors, and management.
• Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced dealership environment.
• Strong math and basic accounting skills for reconciling claims and receivables.
• Reliable, professional, and customer-service oriented.

Preferred Qualifications
• Previous experience as a Warranty Clerk, Warranty Administrator Assistant, or in an automotive dealership service/parts/administrative role (Ford experience highly desirable).
• Familiarity with Ford systems (e.g., OASIS, FMC Dealer, or similar) and warranty policies.

What We Offer

• [Benefits package: health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, employee vehicle discounts, etc. – customize as needed]

title: Director Development
description:
Director, Development

Location: Remote – U.S.

Altera TouchWorks is seeking a high-impact Director, Development to lead multiple engineering teams responsible for building, modernizing, and sustaining software solutions for our ambulatory healthcare EHR business. Reporting directly to the Vice President, R&D, this role will be part of and leading our engineering organization focused on AI-directed development practices while sustaining delivery excellence across an active product portfolio.

The successful candidate will bring strong Healthcare IT product engineering experience with a proven ability to scale teams, improve velocity, elevate quality, and operationalize AI-directed software development as a core engineering discipline - not merely a productivity add-on. This means governing the quality and correctness of AI-generated code output, enforcing architecture as the authoritative source of truth for all engineering decisions, and building the organizational capability to develop and deploy specialized clinical AI agents.

This leader will partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, QA, Cloud Operations, Support, Client Services, and executive leadership to align roadmap priorities, deliver customer value, improve operational efficiency, and position TouchWorks for long-term growth.

The ideal candidate combines deep Healthcare IT domain expertise, strong people leadership, operational discipline, and technical credibility. They must be comfortable leading geographically distributed teams - managing multi-timezone delivery cadences and multiple consulting vendor relationships - while building a high-performance culture centered on accountability, urgency, innovation, collaboration, and customer value.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. The right candidate leads teams and drives results, while also rolling up their sleeves when the work demands it. If you are energized by transformation, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and motivated by building something new, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead multiple software engineering teams delivering healthcare product enhancements, cloud-native modernization programs, regulatory initiatives, and client commitments across two parallel delivery tracks.

  • Own end-to-end software delivery across planning, execution, quality, release readiness, production stability, and continuous improvement.

  • Drive predictable execution through Agile delivery models, effective planning, clear priorities, and disciplined operating cadences.

  • Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of roadmap commitments, compliance requirements, customer escalations, and strategic business priorities.

AI-Directed Software Development

  • Champion and operationalize AI-directed engineering practices as a core organizational capability - not a supplemental tool. This includes governing AI-generated code quality and correctness, enforcing architecture as the authoritative source of truth for all implementations, and building the team's ability to direct rather than simply write code.

  • Operationalize AI engineering tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and related platforms to improve engineering throughput, quality, and delivery speed.

  • Establish metrics to track AI adoption, developer productivity, cycle time reduction, code quality, and ROI - including AI-specific measures such as AI contribution rate, architecture conformance rate, and agent output velocity.

  • Build governance models to ensure secure, compliant, and responsible use of AI in software engineering, with specific attention to HIPAA obligations around AI-generated code in clinical contexts and the handling of protected health information in AI workflows.

  • Build and govern an emerging clinical AI agents capability - including ambient documentation, clinical decision support, and intelligent ordering agents - establishing safety controls, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop review standards for AI agents operating in clinical workflows.

  • We are looking for someone who has lived inside AI-directed development, not observed it from a distance. The expectation is practical command: the ability to guide, evaluate, and drive AI-generated code and workflows at scale across the teams you lead.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architectural and technical guidance for modern healthcare platforms including cloud-native services, APIs, interoperability, and data platforms.

  • Enforce architecture-as-source-of-truth discipline across all engineering teams: every implementation must trace to a documented architecture artifact.

  • Drive modernization of legacy systems toward scalable cloud-native architectures and modern engineering patterns.

  • Partner with Architecture, Product Management, Security, DevOps, and Support leaders on strategic priorities.

  • Act as executive escalation point for critical technical risks, delivery issues, and customer-impacting events.

People Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing engineering managers, architects, and senior engineers.

  • Establish clear goals, accountability models, career development plans, and succession planning.

  • Foster a high-performance culture centered on ownership, collaboration, urgency, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead a geographically distributed organization across U.S., Costa Rica, and India, managing multiple consulting vendor relationships and multi-timezone delivery cadences effectively.

  • The Director leads through people and stays close to the work. We expect this leader to understand what the teams are building at every level and to step in when the moment calls for it. The standard here is ownership, not delegation.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage budgets, headcount planning, vendor utilization, and cost optimization across a mixed workforce of direct employees and consulting resources.

  • Improve engineering goals including sprint predictability, defect escape rate, employee engagement, and release quality - alongside AI-specific metrics including AI contribution rate, architecture conformance, and agent output quality.

  • Standardize engineering processes, tooling, scorecards, and governance mechanisms across both sustaining and greenfield delivery tracks.

Job Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required.

  • Master's degree preferred.

Salary Range:

$150,000 - $165,000

title: CX / Service Designer
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Service Designer / CX Designer to join our team and help shape better end-to-end customer and service experiences.

In this role, you’ll analyze how services work today across people, processes, systems, and touchpoints, identify opportunities for improvement, and design how they should work in the future.

You’ll work closely with clients, users, and cross-functional teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, operational realities, and pain points. You’ll map current experiences, facilitate workshops, uncover opportunities, and design future-state journeys and service models across both digital and physical channels.

This is a relatively senior, hands-on role for someone who can move confidently between customer experience, service design, research, workshop facilitation, and business process thinking, turning complex challenges into clear and actionable solutions.

What You'll Do

❏ Conduct research and stakeholder interviews to understand customer needs, behaviours, business objectives, and operational challenges

❏ Analyze existing services and business processes to identify friction, inefficiencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement

❏ Map end-to-end customer journeys across digital and physical channels

❏ Identify customer needs, pain points, moments that matter, and opportunities to improve the overall experience

❏ Create customer journey maps, empathy maps, experience maps, and service blueprints to visualize and communicate findings

❏ Map current-state (as-is) experiences, services, and processes to understand how they operate today

❏ Design future-state (to-be) journeys and service experiences that address customer and business needs

❏ Develop service blueprints connecting frontstage customer interactions with backstage processes, people, systems, and dependencies

❏ Plan, structure, and facilitate client and stakeholder workshops, including discovery, journey mapping, co-creation, ideation, prioritization, and future-state design sessions

❏ Lead workshop discussions, manage different stakeholder perspectives, and turn workshop outputs into clear insights, decisions, and next steps

❏ Translate complex business and operational workflows into clear visual process maps and service models

❏ Collaborate with UX designers, researchers, business analysts, product teams, and other specialists to translate service concepts into deliverable experiences

title: IT Security Risk Management Analyst (Policy Reviewer & Policy Writer)- SOC or ISO or NIST + Audit
description:
THE POSITION:

The IT Security Risk Management Analyst is a key contributor to EVERSANA’s IT Risk & Compliance team, placed within EVERSANA’s Information Security service line. This person will be responsible for performing security focused evaluations of governance, risk, and compliance of EVERSANA’s Information Assets.

This rewarding position will also help with the continued development and operations of several IT governance and compliance activities. These are oriented towards objectively evaluating security control performance across the enterprise, and alignment of security controls with business objectives. Further, this role will assist other team members on the IT Risk & Compliance team, and EVERSANA’s Security Operations team to evaluate risks, threats, and opportunities for mitigation strategies in support of sound security practices.

Critical RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business Partner Support – 40%

  • Support internal business partners with information and responses in requests from EVERSANA clients exploring security and general IT capabilities.
  • Perform security focused assessments on EVERSANA’s third party suppliers and vendors to assess potential risks and communicate impacts to IT and business leaders.
  • Perform security focused assessments on EVERSANA’s clients to assess potential risks and communicate impacts to IT and business leaders.

Policy Governance and Review- 10%

  • Review, analyze, and maintain Information Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines to ensure alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of existing security policies and recommend updates based on changes in regulations, emerging threats, technology implementations, and organizational requirements.
  • Coordinate policy review cycles with stakeholders, control owners, and business leaders to ensure timely approval and implementation of policy updates.
  • Evaluate policy exceptions and deviations, assess associated risks, and provide recommendations for risk treatment and management approval.

Policy Development and Writing- 10%

  • Draft, develop, and maintain Information Security policies, standards, procedures, and supporting documentation in accordance with frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, HIPAA, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to translate security, compliance, and operational requirements into clear and actionable policy documentation.
  • Ensure policy documentation is written in a consistent format, understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences, and supports organizational compliance objectives.
  • Monitor changes in regulatory, legal, and industry requirements and update policy documentation to address evolving compliance obligations.
  • Risk Management Operations – 10%
  • Support and perform various risk assessment processes to develop threat models for various EVERSANA business lines, as well as improving awareness of financial and operational impacts identified risks posed to EVERSANA.
  • Develop, review, and maintain Information Security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure alignment with organizational risk management objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, while facilitating stakeholder review, approval, and compliance monitoring.

Security Control Audit Support – 30%

  • Monitor and facilitate audit activities for SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA risk assessments, and follow up activities of remediation for issues / findings identified during client or vendor assessments to ensure deficiencies are mitigated and proper controls are put in place.
  • Monitor and facilitate audit remediation activities identified during client or vendor assessments to ensure deficiencies are mitigated and proper controls are put in place.
  • Work with IT Risk & Compliance team members to identify security controls applicable to various service lines.
    • Support the draft and creation of reporting to senior leadership.
  • Conduct periodic internal testing and auditing to support security control compliance.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing policy documentation, evidence of policy reviews, approval records, and demonstrating compliance with applicable security frameworks and regulatory requirements.
  • Four or more years of experience in an auditing role (Information Technology OR Compliance) OR two or more years of experience with risk management practices.
  • Two or more years of experience with third party risk assessments.
  • Experience in creating summary reports for a broad range of audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Competent understanding of auditing practices (ex. SOC1 or SOC2, ISO27000)
  • Understanding of Security Standards like ISO27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, NIST 800-53
  • Experience with risk management methodology’s (quantitative assessments, FAIR, HIPAA security assessment) and their utilization.
  • Excellent analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in drafting, reviewing, and maintaining Information Security policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation.
  • Strong understanding of policy lifecycle management, document governance, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Excellent technical writing, documentation management, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred qualifications:

  • B.Tech/BE
  • Experience required- 2-5

Industry Certification such as CISA, CIA, CRISC, TPCRA, ISO 27000 Internal Auditor, or Open FAIR

title: Research Portfolio Administrator
description:
The Research Portfolio Administrator is responsible for lifecycle sponsored award management, and for enforcing and complying with all sponsor and University research- related policies and procedures. The portfolio will include contracts, grants, and cooperative agreements from federal agencies, industry sponsors, foundations, and foreign and international entities. The Research Administrator is expected to work closely with faculty and other Principal Investigators (PIs) and researchers. Although the role is expected to function with a great deal of autonomy, the individual will collaborate with colleagues in the department, the HMS Office of Research Administration (ORA), the Harvard University Office for Sponsored Programs (OSP), and other Harvard and external colleagues as needed. This position requires a high level of collaboration, attention to detail, accuracy, and independent judgement.

Pre-Award responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Managing the application process with researchers, subrecipient institutions, and other administrators to meet internal and external deadlines.
  • Working with PIs to prepare and submit grant applications for basic research, ensuring that all sponsor guidelines are met.
  • Advising researchers on funding opportunity requirements, as well as fiscal, administrative, and compliance policies and procedures.
  • Preparation of project-specific budgets, including proper application of F&A costs.
  • Entering proposals into Harvard’s system of record (GMAS) and sponsor portals (e.g., ASSIST, Grants.gov, eRA Commons, ProposalCentral) and routing to ORA for institutional review, authorization, and submission.
  • Drafting timely responses to Just-In-Time requests, including revised budgets, current and pending support, and compliance approvals (e.g., IRB, IACUC) information.

Post-Award responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Daily monitoring of grants and contracts for PIs assigned to a department portfolio.
  • Serves as principal source of information on complex fiscal policies and procedures including federal funding regulations and advises faculty and staff on existing options or alternatives.

title: Mid-Level System Test Engineer - DoW
description:
Join our Space Systems Test & Integration team supporting the Missile Defense Space Enterprise Architecture (MDSEA) on the Integrated Research and Development for Enterprise Solutions (IRES) contract. As a Mid-Level System Test Engineer, you will provide technical guidance for verification, validation, integration, and mission readiness activities across complex satellite ground system environments.

This position requires hands-on experience with space-ground enterprise systems, mission system integration, IT infrastructure, test automation, and DevSecOps-aligned development pipelines. You will guide multidisciplinary engineering teams, support DT/OT test events, and ensure mission-critical systems meet stringent operational requirements.

We’re Looking For: Mission-focused test engineer with strong technical experience in system-level testing with satellite ground systems, and the ability to
coordinate across multiple vendors, engineering teams, and government stakeholders in secure DoD environments.

Location: Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado Springs, CO
Relocation Assistance: None available at this time
Remote/Telework: NO - Not available for this position
Clearance Type: DoW Secret
Shift: Day Shift

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute system level test strategies, plans, procedures, and verification artifacts.
  • Provide technical guidance that will be used by MDSEA System Engineers to ensure test standardization and performance targets are met
  • Coordinate test activities across multiple vendors, engineering teams, Agile groups, and government stakeholders.
  • Manage the Integrated Master Test Schedule (IMTS) for DT/OT events, integration milestones, and readiness reviews.
  • Conduct functional, integration, regression, performance, cybersecurity, and end to end mission system testing.
  • Validate software builds, configuration changes, and modifications to enterprise satellite ground system components.
  • Test IT infrastructure which includes servers, networks, storage systems, virtualized environments, and mission critical enterprise services.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for seamless integration into a modern DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline to increase test coverage and efficiency.
  • Apply familiarity with DevSecOps/DevOps pipelines to support Infrastructure as Code through automated builds, deployments, and integration workflows.
  • Identify, document, and track system anomalies, lead defect triage and root cause analyses for complex system issues, and coordinate resolution across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Produce test reports, readiness assessments, risk summaries, and technical briefings for leadership and government stakeholders.
  • Support strict configuration management, cybersecurity compliance, and test documentation quality.

Basic Requirements:

title: Director, Technical Program Management
description:
As a Technical Project Manager, you will serve as the strategic connective tissue between product strategy and cross-functional execution. This is a principal-level, hands-on leadership role. You are accountable for the delivery of the organization’s most complex, high-revenue initiatives - not for reporting on them - and you carry the dates yourself.

You will guide a team responsible for architecting the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) framework and providing the operational infrastructure required to scale. You will be responsible for the integrity of the delivery process - managing the interdependencies between Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You ensure that the company’s most significant investments are delivered with transparency, alignment, and high impact.

Greenfield initiatives are where this role earns its keep. New programs receive dedicated senior ownership rather than shared program management capacity borrowed across unrelated engineering projects. On these builds you set the plan, hold the commitments, remove blockers directly where you can, and escalate with a recommendation and a recovery path where you cannot.

Your success in this role will be measured by the increased velocity, predictability, and transparency of our most critical product investments.

  • Significant increase in the percentage of top initiatives delivered on time and within scope.

  • Reduction in the "administrative tax" on Product Managers, as measured by time reclaimed from manual reporting and tool maintenance.

  • Improved internal satisfaction scores from Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial leaders regarding the clarity and reliability of the delivery pipeline.

  • Greenfield initiatives hitting their committed launch dates, with this role personally accountable for those commitments.

Level, Location, and Scope

  • Level. Principal-level. This is a senior individual leadership role, comparable in scope to an L7 Principal Technical Program Manager at a large technology company.

  • Location. Bangalore-based, most of the engineering, product and data science team are also based in India.

  • Dedication. Fully dedicated to Product Operations and the greenfield portfolio. This is not a shared resource split across multiple engineering projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Update and maintain a scalable Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) that bridges the gap between high-level roadmaps and delivery.

  • Establish standardized stage-gates and "Definition of Ready/Done" criteria to ensure Engineering and Data Science receive high-quality, actionable requirements.

  • Conduct quarterly audits of the delivery pipeline to identify friction points, automate manual handoffs, and reduce lead time without over-engineering the process.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of the "Top 20" initiatives - those involving 3+ functional teams or multi-million revenue impact - from post-PRD alignment through launch. You hold the timeline and are answerable when it moves.

  • Actively unblock the work. Identify and resolve cross-team resource conflicts and technical dependencies between Product, Tech, Data Science, and Operations, driving each issue to a decision rather than routing it onward.

  • Stand up greenfield programs from zero: scope, sequencing, staffing needs, operating cadence, and launch criteria, with no existing process to inherit.

  • Engage directly with Engineering and Data Science on architecture, data pipeline, and integration tradeoffs at enough depth to pressure-test estimates and challenge plans credibly.

  • Escalate to executive leadership with a recommendation and a recovery plan attached, not a status color.

  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for high-value client steering committees and strategic data vendors (e.g., Netflix, Amazon) to ensure technical integrations stay on schedule.

  • Design and own the executive dashboarding strategy, providing a "single source of truth" for product health (adoption, retention) and delivery health (predictability, throughput).

  • Ensure Jira and Confluence are configured to provide clean, automated reporting, eliminating the need for Product Managers to manually aggregate status updates.

  • Provide quarterly insights to the C-suite on execution trends, highlighting areas where resource reallocation may be necessary to meet Op Plan goals.

  • Oversee the administration and configuration of Jira, Confluence, and associated add-ons to support a unified workflow across the department.

  • Evaluate and implement emerging tools (AI-assisted productivity, roadmap visualization) that enhance the productivity of the Product and Tech teams.

  • Maintain the centralized repository of best practices, templates, and guidelines that standardize how the organization builds and launches products.

  • Lead quarterly training sessions to ensure new hires and existing team members are proficient in the PDLC and operational tools, ensuring a consistent culture of execution.


  • 15+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management, with at least 5 years operating at a principal or director level. For calibration: comparable in scope and seniority to an L7 Principal TPM at a company such as Amazon.

  • Proven track record of managing "Top-Tier" strategic initiatives that require the synchronization of cross-functional areas (e.g., Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales).

  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing a Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) in a growth-stage or enterprise technology environment.

  • Demonstrated ownership of greenfield, 0-to-1 programs where the plan, process, and cadence did not yet exist and had to be built.

  • A track record of unblocking rather than tracking. Be ready to describe specific technical and organizational blockers you personally cleared, and launch dates you were held to.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to hold a credible conversation with Engineering and Data Science leaders about architecture, data pipelines, and integration risk.

  • Strong ability to translate raw delivery data into executive-level insights. Experience building automated dashboards that track both business health (KPIs) and delivery health (velocity, lead time).

  • Exceptional ability to build consensus and maintain high-trust partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success and Commercial leadership.

  • A passion for process as an enabler, not a hurdle. You should have a reputation for making the teams around you faster and more effective.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

  • Professional certifications in Program Management (PMP, PgMP) are welcomed but secondary to proven real-world results.

title: Director of Software Engineering, Acceleration & Modern Engineering Practices (Asset Management)
description:

As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Asset & Wealth Management, Asset Management Acceleration Pod Team, you, you provide expertise and engineering excellence as an integral part of an agile team to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You will combine deep hands-on engineering expertise with senior leadership to drive modern software delivery (CI/CD, testing modernization, cloud-native architecture, APIs/integration, data modeling) and establish an operating model that emphasizes small, focused scopes; reuse of standardized components; short sprint cycles and fast experimentation.

  • Run pod governance (council + standups) to prioritize work, clear blockers, and drive Go/No-Go decisions, partnering with senior sponsors to align outcomes, resourcing, and decision rights.

  • Architecture (distributed systems, resiliency, performance, maintainability)
  • Integration & APIs (REST/event-driven patterns, governance, versioning, security)
  • AWS services (practical, production experience; networking, compute, storage, security/IAM, monitoring)
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment (product, business, risk/control, architecture, platform teams) and operate effectively in a governance model with senior stakeholders


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience running a "working backwards" or outcome-first delivery model, including crisp problem framing, acceptance criteria, and success metrics
  • Demonstrated success scaling delivery velocity without sacrificing quality (e.g., redesigning CI/CD and testing philosophy to match higher throughput)
  • Experience building durable adoption mechanisms (early adopter/champion strategies, measurable adoption metrics, and feedback loops)
  • Familiarity with enterprise-approved AI-assisted development tools and patterns (e.g., code assistants, agentic workflows, test generation/triage automation) and how to operationalize them with appropriate guardrails in day-to-day engineering.
  • Experience partnering with UX/design to translate user journeys into intuitive experiences, applying UX best practices (research, prototyping, usability testing), and incorporating UX designers into agile delivery to close user-engagement gaps.
  • Prior experience in Asset Management technology domains (portfolio, client, research, trading, operations, data/analytics platforms)

title: Research Ethics (Studies) Coordinator
description:
Union: Non-Union
Number of vacancies: 3
New or Replacement: New

Department: Research Ethics Operations
Reports to: Senior Manager, Research Ethics Operations
Salary: $40.49 to $60.73 per hour
Shifts: Monday to Friday
Hours: 37.5 per week
Status: Permanent Full-Time
Closing Date: September 30, 2026

Position Summary

The Research Ethics Coordinator for the Research Ethics Board (REB) is a key administrative position within the research structure of the University Health Network. The position has both scientific and ethics review functions as well as a liaison function. The Coordinator is responsible for the coordinating and managing of all aspects of the submission, review, revision, and approval of research protocols within the University Health Network. The Coordinator must be familiar with experimental design as it applies to biomedical research and be familiar with the most recent ethical standards as captured in the Tri-Council Policy Statement. The Coordinator must be able to communicate and liaise effectively with the REB Co-chairs, investigators, research coordinators and administrative staff throughout UHN as well as with outside groups such as pharmaceutical companies and government agencies. The Coordinator coordinates and supports the REB and its' members. The Coordinator must have effective organizational skills and is responsible for supervising the daily maintenance of electronic files. The Coordinator must be able to work independently, but under the supervision of the Senior Manager and Team Lead.

Duties

  • Coordination and review of all REB submissions and its corresponding study documents (e.g. research protocols, Investigator Brochures, consent forms, etc.) received by the REB office, for initial REB submissions, amendments, protocol deviations, unanticipated problems, adverse events, renewals, closures, researchers’ responses to REB queries and make recommendations for decision or need for revision;
  • Acting as a Research Ethics liaison, you will work with the REB Co-Chairs, Vice-Chairs, Panel members and other members of the Ethics Review Services team throughout the ethics review process to ensure REB submissions are in compliance with relevant regulations, guidelines and policies;
  • Providing accurate and complete documentation of REB discussions and decisions;
  • Coordination and the maintenance of electronic documents to ensure timely and accurate record keeping; responsible for appropriate archiving of electronic files (as required);
  • Communication and education;
  • Attending REB Meetings.
  • At minimum, a Bachelor’s degree in a health-related or life sciences field or equivalent combination of education/experience related to clinical trials; Master’s preferred
  • Minimum five (5) years’ experience in clinical research conducting trials or acting as a research coordinator or monitor
  • Strong knowledge of research administration and ethics regulatory frameworks (e.g. most recent Tri-Council Policy and Ethical Conduct for Research involving Human Participants, ICH-Good Clinical Practice Guidelines, Health Canada Division 5, FDA regulations, PHIPA, etc.)
  • Possess a working knowledge of health and social sciences research methodology
  • Excellent analytical, organizational and time management skills required
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
  • Must be resourceful and have consultative skills
  • Demonstrated ability to use tact and discretion in a high-workload, highly demanding academic research environment where breadth of research and ethical issues can be diverse, novel and/or complex
  • Computer proficiency (e.g. Microsoft Office, Teams, Adobe Reader, etc.)
  • Experience with an electronic REB application system (e.g. CAPCR, Romeo, Infonetica, etc.) an asset
  • Certification as a Clinical Research Professional (e.g. SOCRA, ACRP, etc.) an asset
  • Demonstrated knowledge in bioethics an asset
  • Experience as a volunteer REB committee member an asset

Why join UHN?

In addition to working alongside some of the most talented and inspiring healthcare professionals in the world, UHN offers a wide range of benefits, programs and perks. It is the comprehensiveness of these offerings that makes it a differentiating factor, allowing you to find value where it matters most to you, now and throughout your career at UHN.

  • Government organization and a member of the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP )

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Infra
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The AI Infrastructure team’s mission is to provide a robust, agile, and centralized AI platform — empowering teams across Robinhood. We partner deeply across Data, Platform, and Product Engineering to define how AI gets built and run at Robinhood — and we hold a high bar for reliability, scalability, and craft. If you’re energized by platform work that multiplies the output of an entire organization, this team is for you!

As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Infrastructure team, you’ll be a technical anchor on our ML platform — owning the architecture and end-to-end delivery of foundational systems that power model development, deployment, and observability across the company. You’ll lead the design of complex platform capabilities including our feature store, model serving layer, and training infrastructure, while partnering closely with ML practitioners to ensure these systems accelerate their work rather than slow it down. You’ll bring senior-level judgment to ambiguous technical problems, contribute to the team’s technical strategy, and help mentor engineers earlier in their careers. Your work will directly shape how every AI product at Robinhood gets built, scaled, and maintained in production.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and Bellevue, WA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the architecture and end-to-end delivery of scalable systems for deploying, monitoring, and managing ML models in production
  • Own the technical direction for key platform areas — including model serving, the feature store, and ML observability infrastructure — from design through long-term reliability
  • Drive cross-functional partnerships with ML practitioners, data engineers, and applied AI teams to streamline workflows, reduce friction, and accelerate experimentation
  • Evolve and scale our feature store to support efficient, low-latency feature retrieval across real-time and batch use cases
  • Define and implement robust observability standards for model performance, data pipelines, and feature freshness across the ML platform
  • Manage and optimize cloud compute resources (CPU/GPU) on AWS to support cost-effective, high-throughput training and inference at scale
  • Contribute to technical strategy and roadmap discussions, and help mentor engineers on the team through design reviews and hands-on guidance

What you bring

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful depth in ML infrastructure, data engineering, or model operations
  • Demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex platform systems end-to-end, from architecture to production
  • Deep expertise in model serving, distributed systems, and production ML workflows at scale
  • Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or similar languages, and hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch
  • Solid knowledge of modern ML infrastructure tooling (e.g., Ray, Kubeflow, SageMaker, TensorFlow Serving, Triton)
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale search systems, including embedding models, vector databases, and distributed retrieval engines using platforms such as Qdrant, ChromaDB, or Elasticsearch with dense vector search capabilities
  • Experience influencing technical direction across teams and mentoring engineers at varying levels
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree a plus

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

title: Tech Risk and Controls Lead - Data Technology
description:
Join our team to play a pivotal role in mitigating tech risks and upholding operational excellence, driving innovation in risk management.

As a Tech Risk & Controls Lead in Employee Platforms and Data Platforms and AI, you will be responsible for identifying, and mitigating compliance and operational risks in line with the firm's standards. You will also provide subject matter expertise and technical guidance to technology-aligned process owners, ensuring that implemented controls are operating effectively and in compliance with regulatory, legal, and industry standards. By partnering with various stakeholders, including Product Owners, Auditors, and Regulators, you will contribute to the reporting of a comprehensive view of technology risk posture and its impact on the business. Your advanced knowledge of risk management principles, practices, and theories will enable you to drive innovative solutions and effectively manage a diverse team in a dynamic and evolving risk landscape.

Job responsibilities
