  • Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate synthesis of risk/control evidence and draft executive-ready reporting, validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
  • Develop and maintain robust relationships, becoming a trusted partner with LOB technologists, assessments teams, and data officers to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and progress toward shared goals.
  • Execute reporting and governance of controls, policies, issue management, and measurements, offering senior management insights into control effectiveness and inform governance work.
  • Proactively monitor and evaluate control effectiveness, identify gaps, and recommend enhancements to strengthen risk posture and regulatory compliance.
  • Partners effectively with stakeholders to translate goals into plans, drive accountability, and execute to completion.
  • Experienced in assessing operational, technology and compliance risks and recommending appropriate control enhancements.
  • Define and maintain a control inventory mapped to common data risks.
  • Promotes reuse-first, AI-assisted approaches to streamline recurring control testing and issue/action-plan management routines, ensuring human review and alignment to auditability and regulatory expectations.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technology risk management, cybersecurity, or a related field, with a focus on regulatory compliance and risk mitigation.
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support technology risk and controls workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted risk summaries and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to security, auditability, and regulatory expectations.
  • Familiarity with risk management frameworks, industry standards, and financial industry regulatory requirements.
  • Proficient knowledge and expertise in data security, risk assessment & reporting, control evaluation, design, and governance, with a proven record of implementing effective risk mitigation strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level strategic decision-making and translating technology insights into business strategies for senior executives

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • CISM, CRISC, CISSP or similar industry-recognized risk and risk certifications are preferred.

title: Ford Certified Transmission Technician
description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Ford Certified Transmission Technician to join our Service Department. This specialized role focuses on the expert diagnosis, repair, rebuild, and replacement of automatic and manual transmissions in Ford (and Lincoln) vehicles. You will work with the latest diagnostic tools, Ford factory procedures, and specialized equipment to deliver high-quality, warranty-compliant repairs while supporting outstanding customer service.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
• Diagnose transmission-related concerns using Ford diagnostic equipment, scan tools, and specialized service tools (including electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems).
• Perform complete transmission inspections, fluid services, filter replacements, flushes, and scheduled maintenance.
• Remove, disassemble, rebuild/overhaul, and reinstall automatic and manual transmissions, transaxles, torque converters, valve bodies, clutches, seals, solenoids, and related components.
• Repair or replace transmission control modules (TCMs), sensors, and electronic controls.
• Test-drive vehicles to verify repairs and ensure proper shifting, drivability, and performance to manufacturer specifications.
• Execute warranty repairs strictly according to Ford Motor Company guidelines and workshop manuals.
• Communicate findings, additional recommended repairs, and time estimates clearly to Service Advisors.
• Maintain accurate documentation of all work performed, parts used, and diagnostic results on repair orders.
• Keep a clean, organized, and safe work area, especially during transmission teardown and rebuild processes.
• Properly tag, handle, and return warranty parts; follow all environmental and fluid disposal regulations.
• Stay current with Ford Technical Service Bulletins (TSBs), recalls, and new transmission technologies.
• Collaborate with other technicians, parts staff, and management to ensure efficient workflow.
• Perform related automotive repairs as needed (engine, electrical, driveline, etc.) while specializing in transmissions.
• Maintain personal tools and properly care for dealership specialty equipment.

Required Certifications & Qualifications
• Ford Certification required — specifically Ford Service Technician Specialty Training (STST) or equivalent Ford Transmission Certification (Automatic Transmission/Transaxle preferred). Candidates with current Ford STARS credits leading to full certification will also be considered.

description:
About Miebach

Miebach Consulting is a global leader in supply chain advisory and engineering. For more than 50 years, we have partnered with organizations worldwide to design, optimize, and transform their supply chains into strategic competitive advantages. Our consulting approach integrates deep operational expertise, advanced analytics, and innovative thinking to deliver measurable business impact.



About the role

Miebach Consulting is seeking an ambitious and client-oriented Supply Chain Consultant to join our growing North American team.

This role is designed for someone with approximately 5–10 years of experience in supply chain, consulting, operations, planning, logistics, or a related field. You will bring your existing supply chain knowledge to client conversations while expanding your skills in strategic problem solving, relationship building, consulting, and business development.

You do not need to be an established sales leader or a recognized industry expert. We are looking for someone with strong potential—someone who is driven, curious, comfortable speaking with clients, and eager to grow into broader client and commercial responsibilities.

You will work closely with experienced consultants and leaders to support client engagements, participate in workshops and presentations, contribute to proposals, identify opportunities, and help develop long-term client relationships. This is a hands-on role for someone who is willing to roll up their sleeves, learn quickly, and take ownership.

The role will involve approximately 40–60% travel, depending on client and project requirements, and will provide significant exposure to clients, industries, and supply chain challenges across North America.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement

  • Participate in client meetings, workshops, interviews, and presentations.
  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Understand client challenges and connect them to relevant supply chain solutions.
  • Communicate confidently with clients while continuing to develop executive presence.
  • Support strong client experiences throughout an engagement.

Supply Chain Consulting

  • Apply your knowledge of one or more supply chain areas—such as planning, logistics, operations, procurement, or network design—to client challenges.
  • Contribute to analyses, recommendations, workshops, and presentations.
  • Support project teams in developing practical and strategic solutions.
  • Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliver high-quality results.
  • Broaden your exposure to different industries, supply chain topics, and consulting approaches.

Business Development and Growth

  • Support proposals, RFP responses, client presentations, and opportunity discussions.
  • Help identify potential opportunities with existing and prospective clients.
  • Participate in industry networking and client development activities.
  • Learn how to connect client needs with Miebach’s capabilities.
  • Develop commercial and account-development skills through coaching and hands-on experience.


Qualifications

  • Approximately 5–10 years of professional experience in supply chain, consulting, operations, logistics, planning, procurement, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of one or more supply chain domains and the ability to discuss them strategically.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable speaking with clients and presenting ideas.
  • Strong business curiosity and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Willingness to learn and expand beyond your current area of expertise.
  • Ambition to grow into broader consulting, client leadership, and business development responsibilities.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on client and project requirements.

title: Product Manager - Global Security
description:
You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with the operators who protect our people, assets, and reputation.

As a Product Manager Vice President in Global Security, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing products that create tangible value for the security professionals who use them. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of new capabilities, gather crucial feedback from front-line users, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to usability, scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality experiences that exceed operator expectations.

In this role, you will be empowered to shape and influence the strategic vision and execution for an experience product that unifies the day-to-day workflows of our SOCs, Executive Protection, Aviation, Intelligence, and Workforce Screening teams. This is not a horizontal platform - it is the interface, workflow, and decision-support layer these teams rely on to detect threats, protect principals, secure flights, produce intelligence, and vet the workforce. Partnering with Engineering, Data & Analytics, User and Employee Experience (UX/EX), Security Operations, and Product Delivery Managers, you will translate deep operator insight into cohesive, role-based experiences - embedding auditable workflows, contextual data, and capability enhancements that drive operational efficiency and faster, better decisions. You will help position Global Security at the forefront of user-centered, data-driven innovation, ensuring every persona has the right information, at the right moment, in the right form to act.

Job Responsibilities
  • Develop a product strategy and product vision for an integrated Global Security experience that delivers measurable value to SOCs, Executive Protection, Aviation, Intelligence, and Workforce Screening users.
  • Manage discovery efforts and market research to uncover unmet operator needs and integrate them into the product roadmap.
  • Own, maintain, and evolve a product backlog that enables engineering to support the overall strategic roadmap, user-experience vision, and value proposition.
  • Build the framework and track the product's key success metrics - including user adoption, task time, workflow completion, decision quality, feature performance, risk posture, and reliability.
  • Conduct deep analyses of end-to-end operator journeys, tools, and data touchpoints - supplemented by stakeholder interviews, shadowing sessions, and usability research - to validate problems, uncover friction, and define high-impact experience opportunities across all five customer teams.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops and design sessions with UX/EX, Engineering, Security Operations, Intelligence analysts, and functional data owners to capture requirements, drive consensus, and align on user-journey and interaction designs.
  • Refine and prioritize the product backlog: author epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira/Confluence; manage dependencies with Product Delivery Managers; and maintain release plans anchored to user outcomes.
  • Embed data governance, security controls, and compliance requirements into every feature through cross-functional partnerships to deliver audit-ready, enterprise-grade experiences appropriate for sensitive security use cases.
  • Lead Agile delivery - running sprint planning, coordinating QA/UAT with operator representatives from each team, managing release deployments, and driving swift defect and production-issue resolution to ensure on-time, high-quality releases.
  • Partner with upstream data, integration, and analytics platform teams (including Automation, Reporting & Intelligent Analytics - ARIA) to surface predictive insights, automated workflows, and role-based dashboards inside the experience where operators actually work.
  • Define, track, and report on key success metrics (adoption, task efficiency, incident response times, user satisfaction/NPS, reliability, risk posture), using interactive dashboards and retrospectives to drive continuous experience improvement.


Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
  • 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area.
  • Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, user-centered design, and data analytics.
  • Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management.
  • Hands-on Product Management experience delivering user-facing/experience products in enterprise security, operations, or incident-management domains, with a proven track record launching large-scale products that consolidate multiple workflows for professional operator personas.
  • Deep expertise in Agile methodologies and tools (Jira/Confluence), including backlog prioritization, epic/user-story definition, release planning, and full product lifecycle management.
  • Strong understanding of user experience principles, journey mapping, and workflow design - combined with working knowledge of the underlying data, APIs, and event-driven services (e.g., Kafka, REST/GraphQL) that power modern experience products.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operator research and complex datasets into actionable experience enhancements.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and executive-presence skills - adept at driving consensus in highly matrixed environments, distilling diverse stakeholder feedback, and delivering compelling executive presentations.
  • Proven ability to lead end-to-end product discovery, ideation, and user research, and to translate business and operator requirements into strategic roadmap priorities.
  • Demonstrated success managing competing priorities and building cross-functional partnerships across engineering, UX/EX, operations, and delivery teams.


Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
  • Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Direct experience building products for one or more of the following operator communities: Security Operations Centers (SOCs), Executive Protection, Intelligence/all-source analysis, Aviation or Workforce Screening.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, unified command-and-control systems, GSOC tooling, case-management systems, or intelligence production workflows.
  • Experience partnering with AI/ML and analytics teams to embed predictive models, automated workflows, and advanced dashboards into user-facing experiences, accelerating operator decision-making.
  • Experience leveraging process-mining, task-mining, and journey-analytics tools to optimize operator workflows.
  • Familiarity with data-sharing frameworks, entitlement services, and data-governance best practices as they apply to sensitive security data surfaced in user experiences.

Under the direction of the core Director, the Research Assistant will perform routine LC-MS assays. This position will also contribute to projects that expand the lab’s analytical capabilities. Other general duties include reagent preparation, instrument maintenance, and assistance of core users.

title: Data & Systems Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering
description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

Summary of the Role: As a

Data Management & Systems Engineer,

you will be responsible for automating inspection data collection and reporting to improve visibility, accuracy, and efficiency within manufacturing operations. You will analyze data to identify yield-impacting trends, develop real-time dashboards, and drive data-informed decision-making. Collaboration with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, automation, and vendors. The role also leads digital transformation initiatives, manages inspection algorithm updates and validations, and promotes a data-driven culture.

Job Responsibilities and Role Accountabilities: Automate inspection data collection and reporting to enhance visibility and accuracy. Analyze data to identify yield-impacting patterns and develop dashboards for real-time decision-making. Collaborate with manufacturing and automation teams to integrate data from various systems. Lead digital initiatives to simplify processes and improve factory efficiency. Ensure data integrity and promote a data-driven culture within engineering teams. Maintain and troubleshoot tools, collaborating with vendors for system upgrades and repairs. Use data analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, Power BI) to analyze trends and create visualizations. Focal person for inspection algorithm updates and validation to ensure consistent and accurate defect classification Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Work Experience: Bachelor's Degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field of study. Industry exposure in the Electronics or Semiconductor Manufacturing setup is highly preferred. Atleast 2 years of work experience related to statistical data analysis tools, AI-based inspection, Machine Learning, Python, SQL, Database Management or IoT platforms.

Skills and Competency Requirements: Proficient in software analysis and statistical tools. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Knowledge of image processing, AI-based inspection, or IoT platforms is a plus. Knowledge of Python, SQL, or JavaScript for data processing is an advantage. Strong troubleshooting and critical thinking skills. Willingness to learn new tools and systems. Strong interpersonal, oral, and written English communication skills required to conduct daily activities. Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Highly motivated, participative team player with the ability to perform in a results-oriented and time-sensitive environment. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and multitask, with flexibility to adapt quickly to change.

Other Requirements: Open to employment opportunities in Binan City, Laguna, CALABARZON, Philippines. Open to an on-site reporting work arrangement. Open to a dayshift work schedule.

description:

Ervaringsverhaal van een collega "Wat ik het leukste vind aan deze functie is de afwisseling. De ene dag bespreek ik cloudbeveiliging met technische teams, de volgende dag adviseer ik senior stakeholders over risicovraagstukken. Je hebt echt invloed op hoe informatiebeveiliging binnen de organisatie wordt ingericht, terwijl je jezelf elke dag verder ontwikkelt." Herman, Senior Manager,

Als Informatiebeveiligingsadviseur maak je deel uit van het IT Security Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)-team van KPMG. Samen met collega’s binnen Technology, Risk, Privacy en Procurement zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging een integraal onderdeel is van alles wat we doen. Hierdoor krijg je een breed inzicht in het technologische landschap van KPMG en heb je directe invloed op de manier waarop beveiliging wordt geïntegreerd in moderne cloud-, AI- en digitale diensten. title: Gametech Innovation Developer
description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

The Gametech Innovation team is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.
As a Mid-Level Developer within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

What it means on a daily basis

  • Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
  • Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
  • Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
  • Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
  • Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What success will look like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who you would be working with

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

  • First interview: An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
  • Test: You will be given a case study to complete.​
  • Second interview: A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
  • Final interview: A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

Where this role can take you

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Solid proficiency with Unreal Engine or Unity; and in C++ and C#
  • Practical use of AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development work
  • Good debugging and profiling skills across multiple systems, together with the ability to write clean, maintainable and self-explanatory code
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines

WHO YOU ARE

  • Naturally curious: you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches
  • Solution-driven: you turn ambiguous, poorly defined requests into workable technical paths, treat constraints as problems to solve, and propose improvements beyond your assigned scope to keep the team moving forward

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Benefits

  • Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
  • 25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
  • Private medical health insurance.
  • Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
  • Free language courses.
  • Work-from-home hybrid model.
  • Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.


Life at Gameloft

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.

title: HGV Shunter/Fleet & Yard Operative
description:
Keep Our Fleet Moving

EMS Healthcare is seeking a reliable, practical and hands-on HGV Shunter / Fleet & Yard Operative to support the day-to-day operation of our specialist transport fleet based in Saltney, Chester.

Working closely with our Transport Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our trucks, trailers and vans are safe, compliant, prepared and ready for deployment across the UK. This is a varied role combining HGV shunting, vehicle preparation, fleet maintenance support and general yard operations.

If you enjoy working outdoors, take pride in maintaining high standards, and are looking for a role where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

This role is based Monday to Friday, with occasional overnight stays away from home depending on operational requirements.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Shunt HGVs and trailers between yards and storage facilities.
  • Take and collect vehicles from garages for servicing, testing and repairs.
  • Transport trucks and trailers for brake testing and inspections.
  • Clean, prepare and maintain trucks, trailers and vans for daily operations.
  • Ensure vehicles are loaded with the correct daily materials and equipment.
  • Build and collapse specialist medical trailers.
  • Carry out vehicle checks, including tyre pressures, fluid levels and general condition inspections.
  • Undertake minor vehicle and trailer repairs where competent to do so.
  • Identify and report defects, damage and maintenance requirements.
  • Liaise with third-party garages regarding servicing schedules, repairs and bookings.
  • Support general fleet, yard and vehicle preparation activities.
  • Maintain a safe, organised and professional working environment.

Essential Requirements

  • HGV Class 1 (C+E) Licence.
  • Valid Driver CPC.
  • Previous experience driving and manoeuvring HGVs and trailers.
  • Experience working with commercial vehicles.
  • Good understanding of vehicle safety checks and compliance requirements.
  • Strong commitment to health and safety standards.

Desirable Experience

  • Previous HGV shunting or yard-based experience.
  • Experience working within a transport, logistics or fleet environment.
  • Basic mechanical knowledge and vehicle maintenance experience.
  • Experience assembling, dismantling or preparing trailers.
  • Experience liaising with garages and vehicle maintenance providers.
  • Experience working with specialist, event or medical trailers.

Skills & Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

  • Mechanically minded and practical.
  • Confident manoeuvring large vehicles and trailers.
  • Organised with excellent attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • A strong communicator who can build positive working relationships.
  • Safety conscious with a proactive approach to maintaining standards.
  • Reliable, punctual and professional.
  • Physically capable of carrying out hands-on yard and vehicle duties.
  • Proud of maintaining vehicles, trailers and facilities to a high standard.

Benefits

At EMS Healthcare, we deliver innovative mobile healthcare solutions that make a real difference to patients and communities across the UK. We recognise that our people are at the heart of our success and offer a range of benefits to support your wellbeing, work-life balance and future aspirations.

Benefits Include:

  • Buy & Sell Holiday Scheme
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • One Occasion Day each year to celebrate a moment that matters to you, whether that's your birthday, your child's first day at school, a nativity performance or another special occasion
  • Health Shield Healthcare Cash Plan
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Electric Car Scheme
  • Technology Scheme
  • Access to trained Mental Health First Aiders and wellbeing support across the business

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HGV driver who enjoys a varied, hands-on role and takes pride in keeping vehicles, trailers and operational facilities maintained to the highest standards.

title: Sr Enterprise Information Architect
description:
JOB SUMMARY

This position is responsible for the leadership, analysis, and design of the Enterprise Information Architecture for PODS supporting our extraordinary company growth projections and digital experiences vision. Plays an integral role in building a holistic view and roadmap of the Company’s technology strategy, processes, and information technology roadmap. Partners with both business and technology groups to ensure that the proposed technical solutions not only align with the Company’s overall objectives but also ensure that both groups enable and drive each other to meet the needs of the Company’s mission and vision. This position will require you to deliver IA blueprints and designs, in line with functional IA roadmaps. A core part of the role will also be to evangelize Information Architecture and the value and impact of good Information Architecture design and governance to both IT and business teams.

The candidate must be recognized as an expert in Enterprise Information Architecture, with a demonstrated track record of delivering the optimal design of data and information architectures to support business objectives. The candidate will possess the background, skills, and experience to independently initiate and coordinate teams in complex technology evaluations, proofs of concept, and prototyping exercises. The candidate will also show demonstrated success in designing and documenting data flows across the estate, designing data models for analytics/reporting, assessing the feasibility of data models, working with business data governance groups in establishing data standards (master, reference, structure), and working with solution architects on data integration and service architectures.

The candidate will have at least 12 years of experience working for a company or governmental agency with at least 300 employees (if private sector) or 500 employees (if governmental agency).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Understand business drivers and business capabilities (future and current state), and determine corresponding architectural designs and change requirements to drive the organization's targeted business outcomes.
  • Establish and thoroughly document strategic standards for enterprise application architecture across diverse platforms and internal engineering and development teams.
  • Ability to partner and collaborate across both IT and business teams to inform on the best Information Architecture
  • Oversee mapping of enterprise information architecture models to package application models, to determine impact or assess suitability of vendor solutions to enterprise information architecture requirements.
  • Ensures the data and the information needs of the business are realized through an intentional information architecture.
  • Document the infrastructure architecture environment and procedures to ensure the infrastructure remains cost effective, efficient, and of high quality.
  • Blueprint Data Architecture, including multi-year transitions and recommendations to drive transformation and modernization
  • Re-Engineers and maintains an enterprise-wide view of the data across all business systems. Analyzes information requirements specified by the user community and designs the required data structures to support those requirements.
  • Champions efforts to improve business performance through enterprise information solutions and capabilities, such as master data management (MDM), metadata management, analytics, content management, data integration, and related information management or information infrastructure components.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS: Education & Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study.

· Minimum of 12+ years of enterprise level in one or more of the following IT disciplines: data architecture, database design, business intelligence.

· 7+ years’ experience as a Data Architect

· An Enterprise Architecture framework qualification such as TOGAF or ZF is plus.

· Expert knowledge and hands-on experience with MDM, BI, data warehouse design and implementation techniques

· Knowledge of industry standard middleware, ETL, master data hub, and service oriented architecture, design and delivery solutions

· Eexperience of working with a range of BI & analytics architectures: including traditional warehousing, Distributed computing, NoSQL, virtualization or data streaming,

· Experience of defining Information Architectures for cloud-based solutions and technologies such as Azure Data Factory for ETL, Databricks, Azure Data Lake, Snowflake, Azure SQL, Cassandra & Cosmos.

· An understanding of the use and hands-on experience with ERWin for application (OLTP) and data warehouse (OLAP) data models and implementation, or industry standard modelling tool

· An understanding of domain modelling, business process data flows, business information modelling, entity flows diagrams, common information models, Master Data Management

· Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Stack

· Experience with Tableau, Power BI and Snowflake

· Knowledge of, and hands-on experience of implementing data management capabilities – including Master and Reference Data Management, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management and Data Governance.

title: Senior Product Manager II
description:
Nielsen Outcomes empowers advertisers, publishers, and agencies with the intelligence they need to drive revenue, optimize investments, and measure real-world advertising impact, from brand lift to sales conversion.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead our core data processing and analytics platform within the Outcomes product team. This is a high-autonomy role that requires a balance of technical depth and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for the Data Processing Pillar, with a focus on our brand lift measurement suite. You will serve as the strategic link between client and business needs and technical delivery. You will own the backend pipelines and methodologies that power our measurement products, writing clear specifications for engineering and data science teams while taking hands-on ownership of backlog refinement, sprint planning, ticket triage, and user acceptance testing.

This position also requires close collaboration with a broad set of stakeholders, including operations and sales teams for project execution, third-party vendors for data partnerships and integrations, and external clients to onboard their datasets, explain methodologies, and interpret results.

What You’ll Do:

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for our Outcomes Data Processing Pillar, focusing on data ingestion, transformation, and third-party integrations across our outcomes measurement solutions.

  • Independently manage trade-offs, balancing short-term client delivery needs with long-term infrastructure scalability, data governance, and technical debt reduction.

  • Monitor industry trends and evolving client needs to keep the product roadmap current, innovative, and competitive.

Technical Execution

  • Partner with engineering and data science teams to design processes, databases, and pipelines that support campaign advertising performance datasets.

  • Translate complex business needs and client requirements into clear technical specifications, detailed user stories, and actionable acceptance criteria.

  • Drive day-to-day product delivery: manage the product backlog, refine user stories, plan sprints, and perform user acceptance testing (UAT).

  • Regularly collaborate with cross-functional development teams and product owners to design and deliver platform enhancements and new capabilities.

Stakeholder Alignment & Client Enablement

  • Communicate the product strategy, technical tradeoffs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership and external clients.

  • Work directly with clients to onboard their datasets, explain measurement methodologies, and help interpret project results.

  • Lead the roll-out of new data capabilities and platform features, including user training, documentation, and support, to ensure successful internal and external adoption.

  • Build strong, ongoing relationships with internal sales, operations, and customer success teams to understand needs, champion feedback loops, and evolve solutions.

  • Product & Industry Experience: 5+ years in product management, with a significant focus on data platforms, ad tech, or media analytics solutions (and 8+ years of total relevant experience in the advertising or media industry).

  • Ad Tech Ecosystem Expertise: A strong understanding of the digital and TV advertising ecosystem, including ad tagging, audience identity data, and ROI measurement, along with awareness of data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA).

  • Measurement Methodologies: Direct experience with broader advertising measurement methodologies, including marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, or incrementality measurement.

  • Analytical & Technical Fluency: Strong analytical fluency with hands-on experience querying data warehouses using SQL, and able to understand data architecture, APIs, and platform scalability challenges.

  • Data Infrastructure & Release: Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and data orchestration tools and concepts (e.g. AWS, Azure, Airflow) along with familiarity with technical release patterns and versioning.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and manage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, data science, sales, and operations teams.

  • Agile Practices: Working knowledge of Agile or similar iterative development methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban) and experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Autonomy & Ownership: A natural problem-solver with a knack for turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable plans.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Brand Lift Expertise: Direct experience with panel-based research, survey methodologies, or brand lift outcome measurement.

  • Data Partnerships & Integrations: Proven background managing third-party data providers end-to-end, from initial discovery through full data onboarding and integration.

  • Data Governance: Familiarity with data governance frameworks, privacy-enhancing technologies, or identity/data clean room solutions.

  • Data Science Collaboration: Background in collaborating with data science teams on methodology design and data validation.

title: Proposal Writer, Senior
location: Salt Lake City, Salt Lake County
description:
This posting is for SirsiDynix, Harris company. It is a full-time fully remote position in the US or Canada.

The Senior Proposal Writer is responsible for leading the development of compelling, compliant, and strategic proposals for integrated library systems (ILS), library services platforms (LSP), discovery tools, and related technology and services. This role bridges technical, functional, and library-domain expertise to clearly articulate how solutions support libraries in improving access, operations, and patron experience.

This individual partners closely with Sales, Research & Development, Professional Services, Support, Security, and other teams to produce high-quality responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs from academic, public, and special libraries.

Key Responsibilities

1. Proposal Leadership & Execution
  • Lead end-to-end proposal development for library system procurements (ILS/LSP, discovery, digital resource management, analytics).
  • Analyze RFP requirements from libraries, consortia, and government entities to ensure complete compliance.
  • Develop proposal strategies aligned to procurement criteria such as functionality, interoperability, accessibility, and total cost of ownership.
  • Manage timelines, schedules, and deliverables across cross-functional teams.

2. Library & Technical Content Development
  • Write clear and persuasive responses describing:
    • Circulation, cataloging, acquisitions, and ERM functionality
    • Discovery layers and user experience
    • Interoperability (e.g., MARC, BIBFRAME, APIs, SIP2, NCIP, Z39.50)
    • Cloud architecture, hosting, security, and data privacy
  • Translate technical platform capabilities into outcomes for librarians, faculty, and patrons.
  • Collaborate with product managers, solution consultants, and library SMEs.

3. Strategic Messaging & Value Positioning
  • Develop win themes focused on:
    • Improved patron access and engagement
    • Operational efficiency for library staff
    • Support for digital transformation and open access
    • Integration with campus or municipal systems
  • Tailor messaging by segment (academic, public, consortia, K–12).
  • Craft compelling executive summaries and value narratives.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with:
    • Sales and Account Teams to align on opportunity strategy
    • Product and Engineering to validate technical accuracy
    • Implementation and Support teams to describe service delivery
  • Lead proposal review cycles (e.g., content reviews, compliance checks).
  • Coordinate inputs from distributed stakeholders, including international teams when applicable.

5. Compliance & Quality Assurance
  • Ensure full compliance with library procurement requirements, including mandatory forms, technical matrices, and pricing structures.
  • Maintain consistency in terminology (library standards, metadata formats, accessibility requirements such as WCAG).
  • Edit and proofread for clarity, accuracy, and professionalism.

6. Knowledge & Content Management
  • Maintain and enhance a reusable content library specific to library technology:
    • Standard responses for ILS/LSP functionality
    • Case studies and library success stories
    • Implementation methodologies and training approaches
  • Develop templates for common library procurement formats.
  • Continuously improve proposal processes and efficiency.

7. Competitive Positioning & Insights
  • Integrate knowledge of competing library platforms (e.g., Alma, WorldShare, Sierra, Polaris, Koha).
  • Highlight differentiators such as:
    • Open architecture and APIs
    • User experience innovation
    • Analytics and reporting capabilities
  • Support win/loss reviews specific to library procurements.

Core Duties

  • Utilize our current Proposal Response software, Loopio, along with our suite of AI tools to write and edit detailed RFP responses for libraries and consortia.
  • Develop compliance matrices addressing hundreds to thousands of functional requirements.
  • Lead proposal kickoff meetings and define content strategy.
  • Align messaging with library priorities such as accessibility, equity, and digital access.
  • Customize proposals for each institution or consortium.
  • Support presentations, demos, and oral proposals to library stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior writers on library-specific content and standards.
  • Track proposal success metrics within the library market segment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, English, Library Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5–10+ years of proposal writing experience, preferably in:
    • Library technology
    • EdTech
    • SaaS platforms serving public sector or education
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Library operations and workflows
    • Metadata standards and interoperability
    • Cloud-based enterprise software solutions
  • Demonstrated experience responding to formal RFPs for public or academic institutions.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and project management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) or related field.
  • Detailed knowledge of Symphony ILS
  • Experience working directly with libraries (academic, public, or consortia).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and public procurement requirements.
  • Knowledge of trends such as open access, digital collections, and linked data.

Key Competencies

  • Ability to communicate complex library technologies in clear, customer-focused language
  • Strong understanding of librarian personas and institutional decision-making processes
  • Strategic thinking with a focus on winning competitive procurements
  • High attention to detail and compliance rigor
  • Ability to manage multiple large-scale proposals simultaneously

Typical Tools & Technologies

  • Proposal tools: Loopio, RFPIO, Qvidian
  • Collaboration: Microsoft Teams, SharePoint
  • Authoring: Microsoft Word, Excel (for compliance matrices), PowerPoint
  • CRM: Salesforce or equivalent
  • Knowledge of library systems and standards documentation
  • AI tools for searching, creating, editing of content

Key Success Factors

  • Delivering high-quality, compliant proposals that resonate with library stakeholders
  • Effectively translating technical capabilities into library-specific outcomes
  • Increasing win rates in competitive library procurements
  • Building a strong, reusable library-focused content base

Establishing credibility with internal teams and external library audiences

Salary range: $70,000 - $80,000 USD per year.

title: Product Owner
description:

Must be able to anticipate potential issues, resolve problems, and adjust schedules and resources as project needs change.

• Staff Management & Scheduling: Must have experience directly managing staff, with individual employees reporting to you. Responsible for managing the individual needs, concerns, performance, and schedules of team members, including PTO, project assignments, workload, and other scheduling needs.

Must be able to balance competing deadlines, staffing availability, project requirements, and company priorities to maintain an efficient and realistic production schedule.

• Production Schedule Authority: Own and maintain the master production schedule and have the authority to determine when projects can realistically begin. Work closely with the sales team to establish accurate client expectations and communicate start dates based on staffing, workload, project requirements, and profitability. Must be comfortable leading conversations about competing sales priorities, and existing commitments. title: Early Career Computer Scientist - Software Development Testing, Onsite
description:
Apply for Job

699009

Albuquerque, NM

Add to Favorite Jobs

About Sandia




Sandia National Laboratories is the nation's premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at:


*These benefits vary by job classification.


What Your Job Will Be Like




We are seeking Software Engineering professionals to join a high-performing team focusing on system integration and testing for space missions. In this role, you will have opportunities to collaborate on the design, development, testing, and deployment of advanced real-time decision support ground systems. Work will include both manual testing using formal test procedures and automated testing using in-house developed automation test tools. You will work with experienced engineers and testers, receive mentoring, and progressively take on increasing responsibility while growing your skills in test automation, formal verification, and system integration.

On any given day, you may be called to:

  • Collaborate with software architects, system engineers, developers, technical leads, customers, and end users to collect and analyze requirements
  • Contribute to the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions that improve software quality
  • Generate automated tests to verify system functionality
  • Participate in testing to assess accuracy and performance of the systems
  • Support formal test activities at multiple levels, from components to the enterprise system
  • Contribute to research and development activities, including proposing improvements and new ideas
  • Work within a team of system testers to perform requirements verification on a large, multi-node, Linux-based satellite ground system
  • Contribute to the development of new testing strategies as the ground system is migrated to newer technologies, such as cloud computing and containerization
  • Contribute to evaluating and adopting automated test strategies and tools
  • Work with developers, systems engineers and other testers to write formal test procedures for requirements verification
  • Perform manual testing using formal test procedures and run automated tests on a regular basis
  • For both manual and automated testing, analyze results and report status; follow up on failed tests; write release notes for successful tests; and improve and extend test procedures as necessary
  • Contribute to the extension of in-house Python-based automation test tools
  • Contribute to the evaluation of new automated testing methods and tools as the system evolves to a new architecture
  • Develop and apply testing skills to support user requirements for highly complex software/hardware applications
  • Support customer-facing formal test activities (e.g., test execution support, reporting, and follow-up)

Due to the nature of this work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.


Salary Range




$102,400 - $199,700

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.


Qualifications We Require




  • A bachelors degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform technical work.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q and SCI clearance.

Qualifications We Desire




The ideal R&D S&E Computer Science candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

  • Graduate degree in Computer Science or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
  • Demonstrated software development skills and familiarity with modern software development practices and tools (e.g., Agile).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams, and a passion to improve and expand technical skills.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements
  • Experience with design, development, and execution of software testing (automated and manual)
  • Python, Java, or C++ programming experience
  • Experience developing automated tests
  • Experience using Confluence, Jira and Zephyr
  • Experience using Agile Testing methodology
  • Experience with Linux operating systems, associated shells such as BASH, TCSH, etc., common command-line tools such as GREP, and file structure navigation
  • Cloud technologies, containerization (OCI/Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes)
  • Experience working with large, established codebases (3.5M+ lines of code)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and associated tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab/GitHub, Maven/Gradle, Docker)

About Our Team




Organization 06333 is responsible for system integration and testing of a large, complex satellite ground system which is being developed to support high consequence national security missions. Our development supports a range of applications and complexities, including remote sensing systems, satellite communications and control, distributed computing and analysis, and real-time data collection, processing, exploitation and dissemination. Our teams deep domain and technical experience, coupled with an operational mindset builds distinct and extraordinary capabilities for our nation and the people who put their lives on the line to protect it. We have expertise in R&D across many disciplines including large-scale software engineering, computer science, and system engineering. We build this mission together in a culture of collaboration, open dialogue, and respectrecognizing that strong outcomes come from strong teams.


Posting Duration




This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.


Security Clearance




Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance and SCI access, both of which require US citizenship. SCI access may also require a polygraph examination. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain these levels of access may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by the DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.


EEO




All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.


NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs




If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Senior Experience Designer – Web/IVA
description:
WHAT DOES A SENIOR EXPERIENCE DESIGNER - WEB/IVA DO?

The Senior Experience Designer – Web/IVA is a seasoned, hands-on individual contributor operating at the intersection of design, technology, and brand across web and interactive visual aid (IVA) experiences. This role exists to translate creative vision into high-quality, production-ready digital experiences that balance brand expression, user experience, system integrity, and technical feasibility.

Senior Experience Designers are trusted practitioners who operate with a high degree of autonomy, applying sound judgment and deep expertise to navigate complexity, solve execution challenges, and consistently deliver work that meets both creative intent and production requirements. They contribute strategically to execution while remaining deeply engaged in the craft—leading through expertise, influencing design direction, and ensuring quality from concept through implementation.

Success in this role requires strong proficiency in Figma, including a working understanding of variables and design tokens, as well as demonstrated experience designing within code-aligned design systems. Senior Experience Designers collaborate closely with Art, Copy, Experience Architecture (UX), Development, and fellow Experience Designers to create scalable, brand-aware solutions that are creatively compelling, system-aligned, and technically sound.

Our employees deliver exceptional business results through the strength of their expertise, execution, and cross-functional partnerships. For Senior Experience Designers, these results are achieved by:

  • Executing Work Independently: Owning projects from concept through delivery as a trusted individual contributor—working independently or alongside other practitioners based on project scope and complexity.
  • Operating with Minimal Oversight: Exercising sound judgment, maintaining momentum, and ensuring alignment to creative, technical, and production standards with minimal direction.
  • Designing Within Systems: Applying established design systems, components, patterns, tokens, variables, and responsive behaviors to create cohesive, scalable, production-ready Web and IVA experiences.
  • Bridging Craft and Production: Translating creative intent into solutions that respect both the integrity of the brand experience and the realities of development—advocating for strong design while working responsibly within technical, accessibility, regulatory, system, and business requirements.
  • Collaborating Cross-Functionally: Partnering with Art, Copy, Development, and fellow Experience Designers to ensure solutions are creatively aligned, technically feasible, and ready for implementation.
  • Applying Design Judgment: Evaluating tradeoffs, resolving design challenges, incorporating feedback, and making informed execution decisions that balance creative intent, technical feasibility, and production quality.
  • Mentoring Through Practice: Elevating fellow Experience Designers through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and leading by example.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Experience & Training

  • 6–8 years of experience in digital, motion, animation, or interactive design.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Digital Media, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • Experience contributing to or working within design systems.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Art, Copy, Development, and other designers.
  • Experience optimizing creative for performance marketing objectives.
  • Experience contributing to or governing design systems.

      • Systems thinker with strong attention to detail.

title: Director of Quality
description:
REPORTS TO: Chief Executive Officer

SUMMARY:

The Director of Quality at MSR-FSR is responsible for driving improvements in quality structure and performance to enhance the company’s competitive position. This role involves overseeing the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) to meet ISO9001 standards and exceed customer expectations. The Director will lead quality-related initiatives, including audits, training, and compliance efforts, while also serving as a primary point of contact for customer-facing quality reviews and ensuring effective communication across the organization. Additionally, this position ensures alignment with internal quality systems, manages quality investigations, and promotes a company-wide commitment to quality standards and continuous improvement.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Promote opportunities to improve MSR-FSR’s competitive position through improvements in

quality structure and performance.

· Provide guidance to ensure MSR-FSR workplaces are constructed, maintained, and operated to deliver the highest quality.

· Champion continuing compliance and conformance with MSR-FSR internal quality systems and rules in all MSR-FSR endeavors.

· Aid MSR-FSR managers in promoting understanding of the company’s, management’s, and employees’ quality responsibilities through communication and training.

· Attend and lead customer facing quality review meetings. Present SPC data and updates on quality initiatives. Serve as high level customer contact for quality discussions.

· Monitor and drive to completion quality related investigations.

· Provide leadership to develop, maintain and continually improve an effective and efficient Quality Management System (QMS) that exceeds the ISO9001 requirements and Customers’ expectations.

· Promote awareness of the quality system procedures and requirements throughout the organization. Provide operations with monthly feedback on key quality system metrics.

· Respond to facilities’ requests for quality assistance (e.g., answers to questions, technical and regulatory clarifications, creation of plans and forms, evaluation of workplace designs, and product evaluations).

· Oversee and manage the centralized document control system that provides access to pertinent documents, reports, and records for all departments and functions.

· Develop and oversee company-wide training programs for quality, and key general awareness onboarding programs.

· Coordinate communication with external parties on matters relating to the quality system, data reporting, and ISO 9001 certification.

· Lead the planning and execution of internal quality system audits to determine compliance with regulatory and procedural requirements, and to seek out opportunities to improve quality performance. Help coordinate and support customer and third-party audits of the quality system.

· Lead and coordinate the implementation, review, and reporting of Statistical Process Control (SPC) applications for general and product-specific critical parameters.

· Report to management on the performance of the quality system, including trends in product non-conformances, corrective action requests, internal audits, customer feedback, SPC, supplier

Job Requirements:

· Minimum of a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Quality Management, manufacturing, engineering, or related field, and/or 5 - 10 years’ progressive leadership experience in Quality positions.

· Broad knowledge and experience in quality management systems, from both customer and supplier perspectives.

· Above average oral and written communication skills.

· Excellent interpersonal and coaching skills.

· Demonstrated ability to interact effectively with the company Board of Directors.

· Evidence of the practice of a high level of confidentiality.

· Excellent organizational skills.

· Demonstrated ability to lead and develop staff members in relation to Quality Management.

· Demonstrated ability to serve as a successful participant on the executive management team, which provides company leadership and direction.

· Excellent computer skills in a Microsoft Windows environment. Must include Excel and skills in database management and record keeping.

· Demonstrated knowledge and experience with quality tools, including statistical process control and gage R&R

· Expertise in technical writing, providing direction to quality compliance and improvement efforts (e.g., policies, manuals, plans and programs, procedures and guidelines, forms, and training programs).

COMPETENCIES:

· Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.

· Attendance/Punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.

· Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.

· Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.

· Initiative - Volunteers readily; Undertakes self-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed.

· Innovation - Displays original thinking and creativity; Meets challenges with resourcefulness; Generates suggestions for improving work; Develops innovative approaches and ideas; Presents ideas and information in a manner that gets others' attention.

· Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.

· Motivation - Sets and achieves challenging goals; Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles; Measures self against standard of excellence; Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

· Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings/situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

· Professionalism - Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.

· Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.

· Quantity - Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly.

· Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and materials properly. Promotes a cooperative Safety Team environment culture of mutual support.

· Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

· Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others.

· Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

· Frequently (1/3 to 2/3 of the job)

· Continually (more than 2/3 of the job)

· Occasionally required to stand.

and ability to adjust focus.

title: UI/UX Engineer
description:
UI/UX Engineer - Shape the Future of AI in Financial Services at Ani Tech


Ready to design and build the interfaces that bring the AI agents of the future to life? Join our growing team at Ani Tech where you'll craft the experiences that let financial professionals work seamlessly alongside autonomous AI systems.


About Ani Tech

We're pioneering agentic AI for financial services. Our flagship product, Ani, orchestrates teams of specialised AI workers that execute sophisticated workflows across portfolio analytics, financial planning, and operations. Unlike traditional automation, our AI workers think and act autonomously, making intelligent decisions while navigating complex financial processes.


The Opportunity

You'll help define how financial services firms understand, trust, and direct our AI agents - starting from research and concept, through to a working, production-quality interface. This is a rare chance to shape the end-to-end design process for an entirely new category of software - AI-native tools for a highly regulated industry - while working on meaningful projects with direct impact.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the design process end-to-end: research, wireframes, prototypes, and production UI for our AI agent platform
  • Design dashboards, agent interaction views, and workflows for complex, data- and document-heavy financial processes
  • Run lightweight user research and usability testing with real users to validate and refine designs
  • Build and evolve our design system and component library, and the interaction patterns that sit on top of it
  • Build out your own prototypes and designs in React, and work closely with engineers to get them into production
  • Design responsive, accessible experiences across React and mobile
  • Work closely with senior engineers and the founding team to shape product direction


What We're Looking For:

  • A strong design portfolio showing process as well as polished outcomes
  • Experience spanning both UI/UX design and frontend engineering, whether from work, internships, or significant personal projects
  • A sharp eye for typography, layout, and visual hierarchy, and a habit of sweating the details
  • Skill in designing for mobile as well as desktop, with an understanding of responsive and platform-specific patterns
  • Fluency in design tools (e.g. Figma), and comfort translating your own design files into clean code
  • Solid skills in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and consuming backend services
  • Comfortable presenting and defending design decisions directly to founders and engineers
  • Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn


Bonus Points:

  • Advanced degree or formal training in Design, HCI, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience designing for data/document-dense or dashboard-style products
  • Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practice
  • Exposure to design systems, component libraries, or design tokens at scale
  • Experience running user research, interviews, or usability testing
  • Experience designing for AI/copilot/conversational interfaces
  • Interest in financial technology, fintech UX, or regulated-industry product design
  • Contributions to personal or open-source projects, or a public design portfolio
  • Familiarity with agentic coding/working, such as Cursor/Antigravity/Claude
  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, the available models and the nuances with them


Why Join Ani Tech?

  • Join our tight-knit team at an exciting point in our company's mission
  • Work at the forefront of AI innovation in financial services
  • Work directly with our CTO and Founder in our Brick Lane Office
  • Enjoy equity ownership and help shape the company's technical and visual direction
  • Own critical design decisions with significant autonomy
  • Flexible hybrid working - we value collaboration in-person but work flexibly
  • Build technology that's transforming how financial institutions operate


If you're excited about defining what AI-native software looks and feels like in finance - and want to grow your career at a fast-moving startup where your contributions matter - we want to hear from you.

UHN's Reactivation Care Centre (RCC) provides a supportive space, for specialized care, focused on reactivation, for patients who no longer need acute care and are focused on the goal of safely returning to the community – whether that be home, long-term-care, or an alternative home setting.

As part of the Ministry of Health and Ontario Health's commitment to alleviating hospital pressures across the Greater Toronto Area, the RCC, which UHN operates in partnership with Sinai Health and Trillium Health Partners, connects patients with the right care, in the right place, at the right time.

title: ODR Fellow
description:
The Office for Dispute Resolution (ODR) operates under the Office of the Provost, working in partnership with the University’s Office for Community Support, Non-Discrimination, Rights and Responsibilities (CSNDR), Title IX Resource Coordinators, Local Designated Resources, and other School or unit leadership. ODR is a neutral body that impartially investigates formal complaints of sexual harassment, sexual misconduct, discrimination, bullying, and other rights and responsibilities involving students, staff, faculty, and third parties.

Under the supervision of the ODR Associate Director and Investigator, the ODR Fellow assists with the overall operations of ODR. The ODR Fellow will work on cases with experienced professional Investigators, gaining knowledge and developing skills in the area of civil rights and other rules of conduct in both the education and employment arenas, with a primary focus on Title IX, Title VI, and related state and federal civil rights laws. The ODR Fellow will have the opportunity for hands-on investigative experience and further develop their legal analytical and writing skills. Additionally, ODR has a proven track record of advancement to a second term for successful incumbents in this role.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Assist the Investigators with case evaluation, investigative planning, preparing for and conducting interviews, processing administrative closures and dismissals, fact-finding (such as review, identification, and analysis of evidence), timely communication with parties, conducting legally sufficient investigations, meeting established timelines, and drafting and issuing written letters and reports.
  • Conduct documentation activities for investigations, including notetaking during interviews, redaction, quote and grammar checking letters and reports, assembly of exhibits, and casefile maintenance.
  • Conduct legal research and prepare internal memoranda on questions relevant to the analysis required in the course of investigations.
  • Assist with ensuring that investigative documents are properly processed, consistent with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) and community expectations for the handling of sensitive information.
  • Assist with ODR, the CSNDR, and other trainings and outreach as assigned.
  • Conduct informational meetings with community members regarding the policies and procedures under ODR’s purview as assigned.

Candidates MUST meet the following basic qualifications to be considered for this role:

  • J.D. required.
  • At least three years of related professional work experience (need not be legal experience). Clinical and/or other relevant legal work completed in law school may count toward this requirement.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and writing skills. Strong organizational skills and superb attention to detail. Ability to communicate effectively both in writing and orally, e.g., with complainants, respondents, witnesses, and others within the University community. Consistent use of the utmost discretion while working with confidential and sensitive information. Ability to manage diverse and changing priorities, and ability to work effectively on a team within a hybrid work environment.
  • Familiarity with federal statutes important to postsecondary education (e.g., Title IX, VAWA, Title VI, Clery Act, FERPA), experience in the higher education environment, and/or fluency in different languages a plus.

Operations:

None required.

Bachelor’s Degree (preferred majors: construction management, logistics, industrial distribution business, marketing, communications).

None required.


SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • High energy, confident, self-motivated.

  • Team player with leadership potential.
