PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands of this position will vary depending on the area of the training program.


  • Operations:

While performing the duties of this portion of the training program, participants are regularly required to stand, walk, use their hands for handling or feeling, and reach with their arms. Frequent tasks include climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and communicating. Sitting is occasionally required. Participants must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move over 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities necessary for this role include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.


  • Sales:

Work in this portion of the training program involves standing and walking for brief periods, but most tasks are performed from a seated position. There is potential for eye strain from reading detailed materials and viewing a computer screen. The role requires finger dexterity and eye-hand coordination to operate a computer keyboard at a moderate skill level. Participants are frequently required to talk or listen. Occasionally, they may lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.


WORK ENVIRONMENT


  • Operations:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts and fumes of airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The warehouse space is not climate controlled.


  • Sales:

The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

    equipment will be relocated and reused.

    Management team.

In lieu of a four-year college degree, 11 – 14 years of relevant experience is required.

title: Inventory Control
description:
Be Part of Something Brand New!

LV Petroleum is opening a new truck service shop in Cordele, GA — and we’re building the team now!

Our new shop is scheduled to open at the end of October, and we’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented team member to help manage the inventory, financial, and administrative functions of the operation.

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a brand-new shop from the beginning. We’re hiring now, and selected team members will have the opportunity to train at one of our established locations before opening day, giving you the experience and preparation needed to hit the ground running.

If you’re organized, comfortable working with numbers and systems, and enjoy keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do

Inventory Control

  • Manage day-to-day inventory activities for the Truck Service department.
  • Receive, check, organize, label, and store parts and merchandise.
  • Perform regular inventory counts and cycle counts to maintain accurate inventory levels.
  • Research inventory discrepancies, including negative on-hand balances, and process necessary inventory adjustments.
  • Process inventory transfers, including warranty-related inventory.
  • Assist with ordering parts and supplies based on shop needs.
  • Maintain an organized and accurate parts room.
  • Process purchase orders and documentation requests.
  • Review previous-shift work orders for accuracy and completeness.
  • Reconcile invoices and research discrepancies or chargebacks.

Bookkeeping & Financial Administration

  • Maintain accurate financial and administrative records for the shop.
  • Process invoices, payments, and other financial transactions accurately and timely.
  • Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
  • Complete reconciliations and research discrepancies as needed.
  • Assist with payroll processing and related documentation.
  • Monitor daily financial activity and assist leadership with maintaining accurate financial records.
  • Prepare and maintain financial reports and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with cash management and tracking.
  • Work closely with the Shop Manager and leadership team to support the financial health of the operation.
  • Assist with tax documentation and coordination with corporate accounting or external accounting partners as needed.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy when handling financial information.

Shop & Administrative Support

  • Understand and properly operate the computer systems used within the Shop Profit Center.
  • Operate POS systems accurately and efficiently.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and records.
  • Provide administrative support to the Shop Manager and service team.
  • Help ensure the shop has the parts, documentation, and administrative support needed to keep operations moving efficiently.
  • Maintain a professional, organized, and customer-focused work environment.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in inventory control, bookkeeping, accounting, automotive/truck service administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Comfortable working with numbers, financial records, inventory, and computer systems.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies and research issues through to resolution.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and computer-based business systems.
  • Previous automotive, diesel, truck service, or parts experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while also supporting a larger team.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, and move throughout the shop and parts areas.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work around a truck service environment, including exposure to noise, dirt, dust, grease, oil, and other shop-related conditions.
  • Ability to work with computers and perform repetitive keyboard and administrative tasks.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be available for qualified individuals.

Benefits

  • Weekly Pay

title: Principal Platform Engineer || Identity Platform (AuthN/AuthZ)
description:
At IFS, we’re building the next generation of AI-native enterprise software. We’re looking for a Principal Platform Engineer to build the shared authentication and authorisation capabilities that our product engineering teams depend on.

You should be a hands-on platform engineer who builds through code and automates by default. Your experience might centre on infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, automation, platform tooling or service integrations. What matters is that you have built reliable, repeatable capabilities that engineering teams use to deliver and operate software.

Your background may be in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, identity engineering or systems integration. What matters is substantial hands-on experience building or extending platform capabilities through code and automation, supporting the delivery and operation of software.

A software development background is particularly valuable, but it is not a prerequisite. We welcome engineers whose coding experience has developed through platform engineering, infrastructure or SRE work.

Architecture, administration and product configuration alone are not sufficient. We want to understand what you personally implemented, tested, automated and supported in production.

We’re interested in what you have personally built and automated: how you provisioned it, tested changes, delivered it safely and enabled other teams to use it without depending on manual intervention. Identity and access is the domain you will work in; specialist experience in that domain is particularly welcome.

This is an opportunity to shape a critical platform capability, with substantial technical ownership and impact across our engineering organisation.

The job

We are hiring two Principal Platform Engineers to help unify authentication and authorisation across our next-generation enterprise software platform.

We are consolidating a fragmented authorisation landscape into one model across three hosting environments: our cloud-native platform, our legacy hosting platform and our lifecycle cloud. It must be correct, fast and reliable in distributed, multi-tenant environments.

Our current stack includes SpiceDB backed by PostgreSQL for authorisation, and Curity for authentication, with Keycloak estates migrating onto it. These describe the systems you will work on; prior experience with every product is not required.

You will design and build platform services, APIs and automation, own them in production, and establish patterns that product engineering teams can adopt confidently. A central part of the role is making secure authentication and authorisation available through documented, automated, self-service workflows.

This is a hands-on role. You will write and review infrastructure and automation code, build platform integrations, and contribute to tooling and services, including those written in Go.

What we need to see

Platform engineering and automation

  • Software platforms or shared services you have built and operated for application engineering teams.
  • Infrastructure code, automation, delivery pipelines, integrations or platform tooling you have personally built and maintained.
  • Automation covering provisioning, configuration, deployment, upgrades and recovery, managed through version control and repeatable delivery pipelines.
  • Self-service capabilities that reduce manual intervention and enable developers to work independently.
  • Experience deploying and operating containerised application services on Kubernetes in a software delivery environment.

Authorisation

  • Practical understanding of access control within applications and APIs, including role-based, attribute-based and relationship-based models.
  • Experience implementing permission checks or designing permission models, with an understanding of tenant isolation and security boundaries.
  • The ability to reason about correctness, latency, consistency and the traceability of authorisation decisions.
  • Familiarity with fine-grained authorisation engines or policy-as-code approaches is valuable.

Authentication

  • Practical understanding of authentication for software applications and services, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and token lifecycle management.
  • Experience implementing or extending authentication flows in software, with an understanding of validation, trust boundaries and failure modes.
  • Understanding of enterprise federation, SSO and external identity-provider integration in a customer-facing platform.
  • Deeper experience engineering and operating authentication infrastructure at scale is particularly welcome.

Production ownership

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, GitOps and Infrastructure as Code.
  • An approach to reliability that includes observability, performance testing, safe rollouts, rollback, backup and recovery.
  • Examples of diagnosing production failures and using code or automation to prevent recurrence.
  • Sound engineering judgement across distributed systems, relational data and event-driven services.

How we work

You will remain close to the code while helping other engineers make good architectural decisions. We value clear technical reasoning, constructive challenge and ownership from design through production.

We are interested in how AI-assisted engineering fits into your work: what you delegate, how you review and test the results, and how you remain accountable for the software you ship.

Must have — platform engineering

  • Substantial hands-on experience building and operating platforms or shared infrastructure that support software engineering teams.
  • Strong coding and scripting skills applied to infrastructure, automation, deployment tooling or integrations. You should be comfortable maintaining code, reviewing changes and using automated tests.
  • Experience automating provisioning, configuration, deployment and operational tasks through version-controlled, repeatable workflows.
  • Production experience with Kubernetes and containers in an environment delivering and operating software applications.
  • Practical experience with a major public cloud platform, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and GitOps.
  • Experience building reusable platform capabilities or self-service workflows that reduce manual work for engineering teams.
  • Sound understanding of APIs, networking, data stores and distributed-system behaviour, with the ability to troubleshoot production issues.
  • Evidence of technical leadership through design decisions, code reviews, engineering standards and support for other engineers.

Experience developing application or backend services is a strong advantage, but is not required. Your coding experience may come primarily from infrastructure and platform engineering. You should be willing to work with our Go-based tooling and services and develop your capabilities where needed.

Must have — authentication and authorisation foundations

  • Practical experience implementing authentication and access control within software applications, APIs or shared platform services.
  • Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and token-based authentication, including secure validation and common failure modes.
  • Understanding of permission models, least privilege and tenant isolation, and the ability to explain where access decisions are enforced.
  • The ability to translate security requirements into working software, automated tests and maintainable platform capabilities.

We would particularly like to talk to you if…

  • You have production experience with Curity, especially extending it, automating its configuration and lifecycle, or operating it as part of a software platform.
  • You have engineered and operated Keycloak in a software product environment, including customisation, automated delivery or migrations.
  • You have built fine-grained authorisation using SpiceDB or a comparable relationship-based authorisation engine.
  • You have deeper experience with enterprise federation, SAML, policy-as-code or authentication and authorisation in distributed, multi-tenant systems.
  • You have built self-service identity capabilities, APIs or SDKs that other engineering teams use.
  • You have worked with Go, PostgreSQL and Kafka or RedPanda in production.

These are advantages, not substitutes for strong platform engineering, coding and automation skills. Strong platform engineers with relevant authentication and authorisation foundations are encouraged to apply even if they have not used our specific products.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Job Description:

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Job Overview

The Sr. Director, IT Portfolio Management is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and governing the global IT investment portfolio to ensure alignment with DePuy Synthes' business strategy, value realization objectives, and transformation priorities. This role partners closely with executive business and technology leaders to drive disciplined demand management, investment prioritization, and delivery transparency across the IT portfolio. The position plays a critical role in enabling strategic growth, operational efficiency, and scalable technology outcomes across the organization. Reports into the DePuy Synthes Technology organization. This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Define and lead the enterprise IT portfolio strategy, ensuring alignment of technology investments with business objectives, financial targets, and transformation priorities.
  • Establish and evolve the Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) operating model, including governance structures, decision rights, and standardized process for demand intake, prioritization funding, and value realization.
  • Own portfolio financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, cost transparency, and investment discipline through business case rigor and ROI/value tracking.
  • Govern AI initiatives across the IT portfolio by establishing a structured intake, evaluation, and prioritization process for AI use cases, ensuring alignment with business value, risk, regulatory requirements, and enterprise AI strategy
  • Oversee portfolio performance by driving transparency into delivery status, financial health, risks, dependencies, and benefits realization through standardized executive reporting and metrics.
  • Provide enterprise-level oversight of programs and projects, enforcing consistent delivery standards and ensuring discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk management.
  • Align portfolio priorities with enterprise capacity by driving resource planning, utilization, and trade-off decisions across competing initiatives.
  • Lead IT portfolio governance for separation and transition activities, ensuring alignment to Day 1/Day 2 objectives, managing cross-functional dependencies, and governing TSA execution and exit milestones.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise risk, cybersecurity, compliance, and financial governance standards by embedding controls into portfolio management processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement of portfolio management capabilities, including processes, tools, analytics, and reporting to enhance decision-making and execution discipline.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing portfolio management function, fostering a culture of accountability, transparency, and collaboration across IT and business stakeholders.


Qualifications

Education:
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline (required).
  • Master's degree or MBA (preferred).


Experience and Skills

Required:
  • 12-15+ years of experience in IT portfolio, program, and project management leadership within complex, global organizations
  • Proven ability to lead enterprise PMO / EPMO functions at scale
  • Deep expertise in portfolio and program management frameworks, governance models, and delivery methodologies
  • Strong experience managing large, complex, cross-functional programs and transformation initiatives
  • Solid understanding of technology delivery models (Agile, hybrid, and traditional)
  • Experience with enterprise IT financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and value realization tracking
  • Demonstrated ability to align technology investments with business strategy and measurable outcomes
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to support executive-level investment decisions
  • Excellent executive communication skills, including presenting complex portfolio insights to senior leadership
  • Proven track record of building, leading, and developing high-performing global teams
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills, with the ability to partner across business and IT leadership
  • Experience driving change, governance discipline, and continuous improvement at enterprise scale.


Preferred:
  • Experience supporting large-scale transformation, divestiture, or operating model change
  • Background in regulated or highly matrixed environments
  • Experience working across global regions and time zones
  • Familiarity with life sciences, medical devices, or healthcare environments
  • Experience with enterprise portfolio and delivery tools (e.g., Planview, ServiceNow, Clarity, Azure DevOps).


Other:
  • Languages: Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Travel: Up to 10-15% travel domestically and internationally as required.

title: Inventory Coordinator
description:
Join Our Team

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Inventory Coordinator to support the effective management of inventory across our operation.

Working closely with the Inventory Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring stock accuracy, coordinating stock movements and maintaining efficient inventory processes that support operational and project delivery. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in stock control, warehousing or logistics who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and organisation are critical.

What You'll Be Doing

As Inventory Coordinator, you will:

  • Coordinate daily inventory activities in line with operational priorities.
  • Maintain accurate stock records across inventory systems and tracking processes.
  • Monitor stock levels, locations, batch information and inventory data.
  • Coordinate picking, packing, staging and issuing of stock for delivery, transfer and operational requirements.
  • Support goods-in activities, ensuring deliveries are checked, recorded and stored correctly.
  • Investigate stock discrepancies, shortages and damages and work with the Inventory Manager to resolve issues.
  • Assist with stock takes, cycle counts and inventory audits.
  • Liaise with internal departments to ensure stock availability and support project requirements.
  • Help maintain a safe, organised and efficient warehouse environment.
  • Support reporting, administration and continuous improvement initiatives within inventory control.
  • Work in line with company procedures, quality standards and health and safety requirements.

Requirements

Essential Experience

  • Previous experience within inventory, stores, warehouse, stock control, logistics or a similar environment.
  • Experience maintaining accurate stock records using systems, spreadsheets or stock-control processes.
  • Good understanding of goods-in, goods-out, stock counting and inventory accuracy principles.
  • Ability to prioritise workload and coordinate multiple activities effectively.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across departments.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience using inventory management systems, ERP systems or barcode scanning technology.
  • Experience supporting stock audits and cycle counting activities.
  • Fork Lift Truck licence or warehouse equipment experience.
  • Experience within healthcare, technical services, field operations or project-based environments.

Key Skills

You will be:

  • Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
  • Accurate and methodical in your approach to work.
  • Confident using systems, spreadsheets and digital stock-control tools.
  • A proactive problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
  • Numerate with strong record-keeping abilities.
  • Committed to maintaining high standards of safety and housekeeping.

Additional Requirements

  • Full UK residency.
  • Full UK driving licence and access to reliable transport (public transport is not recommended due to office location).
  • Flexibility to travel throughout the UK and overseas when required.

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data Engineering, AWS Professional Services
description:
Description

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Advise customer's technologists and business leads; help them to explore the art of the possible with machine learning, and to develop scalable Data Analytics and ML solutions on AWS to deliver business value in the most effective way
  • Discuss complex industry-specific business concepts with customer technologists and business leads especially in public sector
  • Drive large, complex customer engagements across pre-sales and delivery from ideation, through architecture design and scoping, all the way to closure and into delivery
  • Conduct workshop sessions to identify opportunities with our customers to scope how they could deliver business value through the use of Data Analytics and machine learning
  • Provide technical leadership and excellence on customer engagements to ensure alignment on scope, deliverables, timeline and customer expected outcomes

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
  • 5+ years of database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis) experience
  • 3+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
  • 7+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience, especially in public sector cloud environments
  • Ability to obtain Singapore government security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
  • AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation).
  • AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred.
  • Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
  • Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR)
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Join our Data Platform Engineering team to build and operate the enterprise data transformation layer powered by Starburst Trino and DBT. You will be part of the platform team that enables analytics teams across the organization to access trusted, well-modeled data at scale. Beyond maintaining infrastructure, you will develop internal tooling in Python, Java or TypeScript to automate workflows, improve developer experience, and expand self-service capabilities, directly shaping how consumers interact with data and driving measurable improvements to platform reliability, performance, and adoption.

What will you do?

  • Operate and evolve Starburst Trino cluster configurations, including query optimization, cost governance, catalog management, and security policy enforcement.

  • Build internal tooling and platform capabilities in Java and/or Python and/or TypeScript to automate operational workflows, enhance self-service data access, and improve the overall consumer experience.

  • Manage CI/CD pipelines and container-based deployments using GitHub Actions, and Kustomize/OCP to ensure reliable, repeatable releases across environments.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into data architecture decisions - including materialization strategies, access controls, and pipeline orchestration design.

  • Monitor production data pipelines and orchestration schedules within Dagster, troubleshoot failures, and maintain adherence to operational SLAs and service standards.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and platform capability enhancements that reduce manual effort and accelerate time-to-insight for consumers.

  • Foster relationships with analytics consumers, infrastructure partners, and leadership to drive platform adoption and champion data engineering best practices.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

  • SQL proficiency with hands-on experience writing and optimizing queries in distributed query engines (Trino, Presto, or similar).

  • Proficiency in Python or Typescript with experience building scripts, CLI tools, or automation for data platform operations.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and GitOps workflows (GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift).

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data quality practices.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Exposure to data lakehouse architectures, object storage (S3), and catalog technologies (Hive Metastore, Iceberg).

Nice to Have

  • Experience building and maintaining data transformation pipelines using DBT (model design, testing, macros, documentation).

  • Experience with TypeScript and building internal web-based tooling or developer-facing UIs.

  • Familiarity with pipeline orchestration frameworks such as Dagster.

  • Experience with Starburst Enterprise or Starburst Galaxy specifically, including role-based access control and cluster tuning.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

  • A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable

  • Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

  • Ability to make a difference and lasting impact

  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team

  • A world-class training program in financial services

  • Opportunities to do challenging work

  • Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities

  • Opportunities to building close relationships with clients

  • Access to a variety of job opportunities across business and geographies.

Job Skills

Big Data Management, Cloud Computing, Database Development, Data Mining, Data Warehousing (DW), ETL Processing, Group Problem Solving, Quality Management, Requirements Analysis

  • Analyze data, trends, and reporting to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Complete a summer capstone project focused on identifying an enablement opportunity, developing recommendations, and presenting solutions.
Skills You'll Build
This internship is a great fit for students who are curious about the intersection of business, technology, data, and strategy. Throughout the summer, you'll build skills that can help you stand out in the classroom, during future internships, and in your career after graduation. You'll gain experience in areas like:
  • Digital product support and implementation
  • Retail technology and digital trade programs
  • Data analysis, reporting, and insights
  • SQL, Power BI, Excel, and digital tools
  • Automation and process improvement
  • Technical documentation
  • Project planning and execution
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Presenting recommendations and influencing action

Throughout the summer, you'll gain exposure to technical products, retail technology solutions, analytics, automation, strategic planning, communication, and collaboration with business and technology partners.
The Experience
This is a remote internship with virtual meetings, cross-functional collaboration, and opportunities to participate in in-person meetings, events, and field experiences. You'll work alongside professionals from a variety of teams including digital specialists, technology partners, account teams, field sales, and HQ leaders. You'll also gain exposure to different groups within Trade Program & Enablement through deep-dive workshops, networking opportunities, and a summer capstone project.
What You'll Gain Along the Way
We believe internships should give you more than experience. They should help you build confidence, connections, and skills you can carry into your future career. As a Trade Program & Enablement Intern, you'll gain:
  • Hands-on experience implementing digital products with leading retail technology providers.
  • Exposure to AGDC leadership, field sales teams, HQ teams, and top retail accounts.
  • A summer capstone project that allows you to analyze a real business opportunity and recommend solutions.
  • Deep-dive workshops across the Trade Program & Enablement organization.
  • Opportunities to strengthen your communication, analytical thinking, technical problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Competitive hourly pay and holiday pay per program guidelines.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for students who are curious, collaborative, and excited to learn how technology can help solve business challenges. You might be a great fit if you:
  • Like solving problems and finding better ways to do things
  • Are interested in business, technology, data, digital tools, or retail innovation
  • Enjoy working with different types of people and teams
  • Can take technical information and make it easier for others to understand
  • Are comfortable learning new systems and tools
  • Take initiative and enjoy turning ideas into action
  • Are organized, self-motivated, and eager to learn
Qualifications
  • Currently enrolled in a four-year accredited college or university pursuing a bachelor's degree.
  • Rising junior or senior preferred at the start of the internship.
  • Preferred majors include Business, Marketing, Management, Information Technology/MIS, Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
  • Foundational analytical skills; exposure to SQL, Power BI, or Excel is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including proficiency with PowerPoint.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Where You'll Work
This internship is remote within the United States, giving you the flexibility to work from where you're most productive while collaborating with teams across the business. Throughout the summer, you'll participate in virtual meetings, cross-functional projects, and opportunities to engage with technology partners, field teams, and business leaders. In-person meetings, events, and field experiences may also be available as part of the program.
Your Future Starts Here
If you're excited by the idea of combining technology, data, business strategy, and problem-solving, this internship is an opportunity to learn by doing. You'll work on real projects, build meaningful relationships, and gain skills that can help shape your future career. Along the way, you'll see how technology enables business success, supports innovation, and creates value for customers and partners. Apply today and spend your summer building skills that move business forward. Together We Innovate. Together We Change.

title: AFSIM Mission-Level Modeling & Simulation Analyst
description:
Join Us in Making a Difference in the Lives of Those Defending Our Nation!

Why SURVICE?

Come join the SURVICE Engineering mission to protect, enhance, and enable those who defend the United States. Since 1981, we have supported the DoD community, as well as Homeland Security, advanced technologies, environmental, and commercial markets. Our employees have backgrounds in engineering, physics, mathematics, chemistry, computer science, acquisition, technical writing, training, and other technical and administrative fields. And many of our personnel have DoD and/or operational military experience. If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career with a leading organization, come see what we can offer you!

Position

AFSIM Mission-Level Modeling & Simulation Analyst

  • Location: Dayton, Ohio
  • Security Clearance: Active Clearance Required - U.S. citizenship required
  • Salary: $100,000 - $150,000 Depending on Experience and Education
  • Travel: 10%
  • Benefits: SURVICE Engineering offers a total rewards package to include competitive salaries, comprehensive insurance options, paid time off, 401k, flexible spending, tuition reimbursement.

Position Summary

Join SURVICE Engineering in delivering advanced modeling and simulation analyses that directly support military platforms and safeguard U.S. warfighters. We are seeking an experienced AFSIM Mission-Level Modeling & Simulation Analyst to build, run, and evaluate high‑fidelity mission-level simulations using the Advanced Framework for Simulation, Integration, and Modeling (AFSIM). In this role, you'll accelerate your career while contributing as a key member of a multidisciplinary team providing essential modeling and simulation support to DoD programs, including platform assessments, operational scenario development, and mission effectiveness analysis. Become part of a collaborative, mission-focused engineering team located near Wright-Patterson AFB.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities of AFSIM Analyst

  • 2-5+ years of professional experience in modeling & simulation or operations analysis, with 1–3 years of direct AFSIM experience focused on mission-level modeling and scenario analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience conducting mission-level modeling, simulation, and analysis using AFSIM, including scenario development, execution, kill-chain dynamics, and evaluation of results in operational contexts.

  • Strong understanding of military platforms, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), CONOPS, and mission-level concepts (air combat, ISR, electronic warfare, or electromagnetic spectrum operations highly desirable).

  • Experience developing simulation-based study plans, run matrices, and analytical reports to support DoD program decision-making.

  • Proficiency in AFSIM scenario scripting and data post-processing/analysis (Python or MATLAB experience strongly preferred for automation and visualization) and associated toolsets (e.g. HAL)

  • Familiarity with DoD Modeling & Simulation (M&S) processes, including Verification, Validation, and Accreditation (VV&A)

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and in dynamic, small-team environments with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Minimum Qualifications of AFSIM Analyst
Bachelor's Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Operations Research, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field; Master's degree preferred - 2+ years of relevant experience. Candidates are not required to possess all qualifications; is you possess some of the desired qualifications, please apply.

Desired Experience

  • 2-5+ years of professional experience in modeling & simulation or operations analysis, with 1–3 years of direct AFSIM experience focused on mission-level modeling and scenario analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting mission-level modeling, simulation, and analysis using AFSIM, including scenario development, execution, kill-chain dynamics, and evaluation of results in operational contexts.
  • Strong understanding of military platforms, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), CONOPS, and mission-level concepts (air combat, ISR, electronic warfare, or electromagnetic spectrum operations highly desirable).
  • Experience developing simulation-based study plans, run matrices, and analytical reports to support DoD program decision-making.
  • Proficiency in AFSIM scenario scripting and data post-processing/analysis (Python or MATLAB experience strongly preferred for automation and visualization) and associated toolsets (e.g. HAL)
  • Familiarity with DoD Modeling & Simulation (M&S) processes, including Verification, Validation, and Accreditation (VV&A)
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and in dynamic, small-team environments with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

About Us

SURVICE Engineering is a nationally recognized, single-source engineering service provider for Government and Industry organizations involved in all phases of the systems engineering process. Our employees are our most valuable asset, and they are proud to have supported the development, testing, analysis, and modeling and simulation (M&S) of many of the major U.S. air, land, and sea combat systems in the field today. They have also contributed their expertise to other vital national defense programs and technologies that involve survivability, cybersecurity, information technology/management, software engineering, unmanned aerial systems (UASs), and metrology/reverse engineering.

title: Recruiting Coordinator (On-Site)
description:
SportsMed Physical Therapy is looking for a driven, highly organized Recruiting Coordinator to join our growing Recruiting team.

This role is focused on finding the best candidates within a high volume of applicants and moving qualified candidates efficiently into the interview pipeline.

You will review applications across a wide range of clinical and non-clinical positions, identify candidates who meet our requirements, conduct initial screening conversations, and work closely with our Recruiters and hiring managers to move strong candidates forward.

This is a fast-paced role that requires someone who can work through large applicant volumes without sacrificing judgment or candidate quality. You should be comfortable making decisions, prioritizing your workload, following up with candidates, and keeping multiple positions moving at the same time.

While the primary focus will be applicant screening and candidate qualification, you will also have many opportunities to proactively source candidates for hard-to-fill positions where additional outreach is needed.

What You'll Do

High-Volume Applicant Screening

  • Review a high volume of applications across clinical and non-clinical positions.
  • Quickly assess resumes and applications against the requirements of each position.
  • Identify qualified candidates and prioritize applicants for further consideration.
  • Conduct initial phone and/or virtual screening interviews with qualified applicants.
  • Evaluate candidates' experience, qualifications, communication skills, availability, compensation expectations, and interest in the position.
  • Identify potential concerns or disqualifying factors early in the process.
  • Maintain a high level of efficiency while ensuring qualified candidates receive appropriate consideration.
  • Move qualified candidates into the appropriate next stage of the recruiting process.
  • Communicate professionally and promptly with candidates throughout the screening process.

    • Keep the Recruiting Pipeline Moving

    • Work closely with Recruiters to understand hiring priorities and candidate requirements.
    • Consistently deliver qualified candidates to Recruiters and hiring managers.
    • Coordinate interviews and assist with scheduling when appropriate.
    • Follow up with candidates to prevent delays and keep the process moving.
    • Monitor candidates throughout the early stages of the process and identify when additional follow-up is needed.
    • Help ensure strong candidates are not lost because of slow response times or gaps in communication.
    • Maintain accurate and timely candidate information within the Applicant Tracking System.

      • Clinical & Non-Clinical Recruiting Support

      • Support recruiting efforts for Physical Therapists and other clinical professionals as well as administrative, operational, and corporate positions by engaging in passive outreach and creative sourcing.
      • Develop an understanding of the qualifications and characteristics that make a successful candidate for different types of positions.
      • Work with Recruiters and hiring managers to refine candidate requirements when needed.
      • Become familiar with SportsMed's clinical services, culture, career opportunities, and hiring needs in order to effectively evaluate and communicate with candidates.

        • Candidate Sourcing & Outreach

        • Conduct proactive sourcing when applicant volume is insufficient for a particular position.
        • Utilize LinkedIn, job boards, professional networks, referrals, and other recruiting resources to identify potential candidates.
        • Reach out to qualified candidates who may not have applied directly to the position.
        • Build relationships with potential candidates for current and future opportunities.
        • Assist Recruiters with sourcing efforts for difficult-to-fill positions.

          • Take Ownership

          • Manage multiple open positions and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
          • Take ownership of assigned candidate pools and searches.
          • Recognize when applicant flow is insufficient and take action to generate additional candidates.
          • Identify opportunities to improve screening efficiency and candidate conversion.
          • Bring ideas and solutions to the Recruiting team rather than waiting for direction.
          • Consistently look for ways to increase the number of qualified candidates entering the interview pipeline.

What You'll Bring

  • 2–4 years of recruiting, recruiting coordination, or candidate screening experience.
  • Experience working with high volumes of applicants and/or candidates.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly review resumes and identify qualified candidates.
  • Experience conducting phone screens or initial candidate interviews.
  • Strong judgment and ability to distinguish between qualified and unqualified candidates.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work efficiently while managing multiple open positions simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working with Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technology.
  • Experience with LinkedIn, Indeed, or other recruiting platforms.
  • Strong follow-up skills and a sense of urgency.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and comfortable working independently.
  • Results-oriented and motivated by moving candidates through the recruiting process.
  • Healthcare recruiting experience is a plus but not required.

The Person We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can move quickly, make good decisions, and keep the candidate pipeline moving forward.

You know how to recognize a strong candidate on paper, but you also know that a resume doesn't tell the whole story.

You're comfortable picking up the phone, conducting an initial screen, asking the right questions, and determining whether a candidate should move forward.

You don't let candidates sit in your inbox for days. You follow up. You communicate. You keep your Recruiters informed. And when a position isn't generating enough qualified applicants, you assist with passive outreach to build candidate pipelines in more creative ways.

The ideal candidate is organized, efficient, proactive, and comfortable working at a high pace.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Qualified candidates are identified quickly from large applicant pools.
  • Recruiters and/or hiring managers consistently receive a strong flow of qualified candidates.
  • Candidates move efficiently through the initial stages of the recruiting process.
  • Applicant volume is effectively managed without sacrificing candidate quality.
  • Open positions remain active and moving forward.
  • Candidates receive timely and professional communication.
  • Additional candidates are sourced when applicant volume is low

Why Join SportsMed

  • Join a growing healthcare organization with the opportunity to grow and advance your recruiting career.
  • Work alongside an experienced Recruiting and Operations team.
  • Play a direct role in expanding SportsMed's clinical and non-clinical workforce.
  • Have a measurable impact on the growth of the organization.

    • Full Benefits

    • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (Day 1)
    • Life & Disability Insurance
    • Paid vacation time
    • Paid sick time
    • Paid holidays
    • 401(k) match
    • Access to Rain – flexible earned wage advance benefit

title: Digital Process Owner: Recruiting & Onboarding (F/M/X)
description:
You are the single accountable owner for the digital recruiting and onboarding process layer at Accor, across a portfolio of platforms spanning the full candidate and new hire journey, including SmartRecruiter, AssessFirst, and the Onboarding module in SAP SuccessFactors, covering both corporate and hotel populations.

This means going directly to hotels, regions, and CoE stakeholders to conduct needs analysis, understanding what is actually required before translating it into structured, precise requirements that can move. You own the domain backlog and roadmap, you decide what proceeds and what does not, and you are accountable for the results. Autonomy here is real, and so is the ownership.

You manage the full change request lifecycle: from needs analysis through to testing, release readiness, and sign-off. Nothing goes live without your validation. You also extract and produce platform reports on request, supporting the business while the broader data infrastructure continues to mature.

You are also the face of the Recruiting & Onboarding digital experience. You produce adoption materials, appear in video explainers, contribute on community calls, and show up for TA teams and hiring managers in a way that makes the technology feel like a tool, not a barrier. You are building trust in the platforms, not just administering them.

We are actively developing AI-driven projects in the preboarding and onboarding space, exploring how agentic automation can remove friction and personalise the new hire experience at scale. You will help shape what that looks like in practice. Clean data integrity from offer acceptance through to Core HR is also in scope and non-negotiable.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the end-to-end digital process layer across the recruiting and onboarding platform portfolio
  • Conduct needs analysis directly with hotels, regions, and TA CoE stakeholders, structuring requirements with precision
  • Manage the full change request lifecycle: triage, assessment, testing, and release sign-off
  • Maintain a live, prioritised backlog and domain roadmap, reviewed at governance forums
  • Produce differentiated adoption materials for every significant release, tailored by audience
  • Be the face of Recruiting & Onboarding technology: video explainers, community calls, plain-language communications
  • Extract and produce platform reports on request, supporting business decision-making
  • Contribute to AI-driven projects in the preboarding and onboarding space
  • Confirm recruiting and onboarding data feeds cleanly into Core HR at the point of hire
  • Keep process documentation and SOPs current after every release

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Curious. You ask better questions than most and go looking for answers rather than waiting for them.
  • Customer-centric. Hotels and TA CoE teams are your customers. You show up for them proactively, not reactively.
  • Solutions-oriented. You bring options when you hit a wall, not just a description of the problem.
  • A natural bridge-builder. You move fluently between functional HR needs and IT language without either side having to repeat themselves.
  • Comfortable on camera. Explaining a platform change in a short video and making it land clearly is a meaningful part of this role.
  • Autonomous and accountable. You manage your domain, you own your outcomes, and you do not wait to be told what to do next.
  • Biased toward simplification. You challenge stakeholders to reduce complexity, and you hold that position.

EXPERIENCE & BACKGROUND

  • 5+ years in HR operations, talent acquisition, or HRIS, ideally across multiple countries or brands
  • Hands-on experience owning or managing a recruiting platform portfolio. SmartRecruiter or equivalent ATS strongly preferred
  • Proven business analyst capability: structured needs analysis, precise documentation, strong stakeholder management
  • Comfortable extracting and interpreting platform data and producing reports for business stakeholders
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging HR technology, with the ability to contribute practically to AI-driven projects
  • Experience managing change requests and coordinating UAT in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment
  • Exposure to hospitality or a similarly distributed, frontline workforce is a genuine advantage
  • Fluent English required. French a strong advantage

💡 Why join us?

And what are our commitments?

To the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the environmental impact of digital across all our projects.

To your career

  • We enable all our employees to maintain a healthy work-life balance and give them the means to shape their working environment in their own image.
  • Dedicated Talent Management, continuous improvement, and training and development paths are defined both individually and collectively so that we can grow together, every day.

Concretely, at Accor:

And also,

  • ALL - Heartist® program: preferential rates and flash offers for unforgettable stays and experiences across all our Accor locations and with our partners worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good volunteering program: 1 day offered during your working time to get involved with a non-profit organization.
  • A Social and Economic Committee (CSE) that supports you in financing your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for using an eco-friendly means of transportation or a “company bike” program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the French Finance Law scale.
  • Meal vouchers with a face value of €11.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor, at no additional cost in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Not to mention attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, game areas, as well as well-being and sports spaces on site or through Gymlib.

title: Silicon Design Engineer
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

The Advance Formal Verification team is dedicated to formal verification. It provides formal functional and security verification for a broad range of IPs including input-output virtualization, PCIe Root-Complex/End-Point, inter-chiplet highspeed connections, etc. We are currently looking for formal verification engineers with expertise in IP verification, formal verification techniques, highspeed IO bus protocols and team leadership to take on the challenges. In these highly visible roles, the qualified candidates will use cutting edge formal verification technologies to verify the newest IPs resulting in a level of design quality not paralleled by classical verification.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborating with architects and designers to understand the design intents
  • Creating and executing formal verification plans for design blocks
  • Writing and debugging properties to verify the design, analyzing counter-examples and pushing for the resolution
  • Optimizing runtime using formal techniques
  • Collecting and reporting status and progress
  • Improving formal setups based on feedbacks from reviews, metrics, etc
  • Leading and coordinating verification activities for a small team
  • Training and couching junior engineers
  • Developing working procedures, flows and infra
  • Handling complicated formal problems
  • Developing AI skill to assistant formal verification, and leverage AI to make FV can be widely used in multiple IP blocks and IP team members for different purpose.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Design or verification experience in ASIC or FPGA
  • Strong background in formal property verification (FPV), sequential equivalence checking (SEC/SEQ/SLEC), and/or academic formal methods
  • Expertise in a formal property language (SVA preferred), abstraction techniques, formal sign-off and commercial formal tools (VC-Formal, JasperGold, Questa Formal, etc.)
  • Extensive experience verifying complex, packet or control based designs
  • Familiarity with industry standard high-speed protocols such as PCIe, AXI, etc
  • Experience with verification of Hardware-Firmware interaction
  • AI capability is a plus:
    • Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve formal verification productivity, including property development, proof analysis, coverage assessment, and debug.
    • Ability to apply Generative AI technologies to automate engineering workflows, accelerate root-cause analysis, and improve verification efficiency.
    • Experience creating, customizing, or optimizing AI prompts, skills, agents, or workflows to support engineering tasks and team productivity.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • BS (or higher) degree in Electronics/Electrical or Computer Engineering desired

LOCATION: Shanghai, Beijing

You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.

At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.


What You Can Expect

Responsible for overseeing the shipping and delivery of materials and warehouse personnel. Mainly work in Warehouse settings and is involved in managing the loading of trucks, setting up delivery routes and unloading of material. Also responsible for managing inventory and maintaining communications with carriers, suppliers, warehouse and others involved in the shipping and delivery of merchandise. Provide leadership to all Team Members within assigned Department(s) on an assigned shift. Collaborate with Inventory Control, Customer Service, Planning, Quality Control, Sourcing, and Operations to ensure timely and efficient completion of all activities. Ensure safe, effective, and compliant practices of Team Members performing a variety of tasks. Areas of responsibility include, but may not be limited to, receipt and stocking of inventory, processing customer returns, picking and shipping outbound orders, supporting inventory control best-practices, and often participating in or leading continuous improvement activities.

How You'll Create Impact

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

• Provide leadership for all Team Members within assigned department(s) on an assigned shift.
• Responsible for day-to-day supervision of Team Members and maintaining all time, attendance, and disciplinary action records for each direct report in a timely manner.
• Responsible for recruitment, development, promotion and disciplinary actions of Team Members on assigned shift.
• Responsible for overall performance management of Team Members including preparing and delivering annual performance reviews.
• Ensure timely and appropriate training of employees in the areas of GMP/GDP, EHS, and Quality Systems.
• Ensure team members are up-to-date and trained to perform assigned functions.
• Contact/resolve/counsel Team Members in error remediation.
• Prepare/present routine reports as instructed by Manager regarding performance in assigned Department(s).
• Manage all inbound, outbound, and reverse logistics activities including receiving, stocking, inspection, and shipping.
• Assist with daily departmental functions as necessary including, but not limited to processing inbound and outbound orders, processing of customer returns, and aiding in inventory control activities.

What Makes You Stand Out

Expected Areas of Competence (i.e., knowledge, skills and abilities)

• Strong leadership and cross-functional skills; leadership/management background; preferably in logistics areas including shipping/receiving/distribution, and shipment/inventory management within a medical device regulated environment
• Effective problem solving skills, including problem identification, data gathering, solution development, and implementation follow up
• Leadership and motivational skills to expedite completion of critical project tasks with other functional groups
• Must be able to work within a team environment not only within the organization unit, but also across departments and shifts
• Experience using Lean methodologies and practices is strongly preferred
• Basic understanding of quality systems is a plus
• Ability to prioritize personal workload to maintain company efficiencies – time management skills
• Ability to communicate clearly, both orally and in writing, with production team members and management in a professional manner

Your Background

Education/Experience Requirements

• High school diploma required, Bachelor’s degree a plus.
• Senior experience in combined industry (biomedical, medical device) and/or military experience; or 8 years of combined industry, military and/or related (general manufacturing, quality or logistics) experience.
• A combination of education and experience will be considered.
• supervisory or leadership experience required but senior experience preferred; may include military leadership experience.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Developer who loves building seamless, high-quality user experiences and has an eye for detail. You’ll play a key role in creating the next generation of our digital products, shaping how thousands of customers interact with our services every day.

You’ll have the freedom to lead on technical decisions, the support to grow, and the chance to mentor others. We believe learning and sharing knowledge is what makes a team truly exceptional.

We work together in our Liverpool HQ three days a week because collaboration, creativity and quick feedback make for better products and a stronger team.

Role: Senior Frontend Developer

Location: Liverpool City Centre HQ / Hybrid (3 days in office)**

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and develop modern, responsive web applications using React, Next.js and TypeScript
  • Build scalable, reusable frontend components with clean, maintainable code
  • Work closely with designers who are part of your squad to bring ideas from concept to polished experiences
  • Optimise for performance, accessibility and security
  • Use Sentry and PostHog to monitor, measure and improve frontend performance
  • Collaborate with backend engineers and product owners in an agile environment
  • Mentor other developers and help shape our frontend standards and practices
  • Share feedback, suggest improvements and help the team continuously level up

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript

Monitoring and Analytics: Sentry, PostHog

Experience with React Native is a bonus as we continue expanding our digital products into mobile.

We take craftsmanship seriously and believe great products start with great engineering.

  • Testing, code reviews and maintainable architecture are part of our everyday practice
  • Focus on performance, accessibility and clean design patterns
  • Monitoring and observability with Sentry, PostHog and Grafana for insight into user experience and system health
  • A culture of experimentation, learning and continuous improvement

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven experience building production-ready frontend applications
  • Strong expertise in React, Next.js and TypeScript
  • A solid understanding of frontend architecture, performance and security best practices
  • Experience with Docker and Azure deployments
  • A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills
  • A passion for creating user-focused, beautifully crafted digital experiences
  • Experience mentoring others and helping teams improve their craft

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of modern state management such as Redux or Zustand
  • Understanding of accessibility standards and WCAG guidelines
  • Familiarity with web performance optimisation and web vitals

Why Join Us

  • Modern tech stack and a strong culture of engineering excellence
  • Work closely with designers and product owners to shape the user experience
  • Career progression into technical leadership or architecture
  • Supportive environment with clear standards and room to innovate
  • Top-tier tools and a workspace designed for creativity and collaboration

Team and Culture

You’ll join a squad that genuinely enjoys working together. Designers, engineers and product thinkers sit side by side, sharing ideas and solving problems as a team.

We believe in ownership, curiosity and craftsmanship. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage ideas from across the squad. We share knowledge, celebrate success and support each other every step of the way.

If you care about building great products and growing as part of a collaborative, design-led team, you’ll fit right in.

Grow with Acorn

At Acorn Insurance, we’re proud of our Liverpool roots — and even prouder of how far we’ve come. As part of the Acorn Group, we bring over 40 years of specialist insurance expertise to the table. From humble beginnings, we’ve grown into a national leader, now employing 1,700+ people across the UK and reached a milestone £750 million in total value of insurance policies written in 2024.

We’re growing fast, with new opportunities emerging every week. That growth is largely due to the values we share:

  • We run through walls for our customers and each other
  • We challenge the status quo
  • We succeed when we help those around us succeed
  • We decide quickly when the smart thing to do is use our judgement
  • A maximum of 35 days’ holiday (depending on role and tenure) including bank holidays, with additional buy/sell options
  • 24/7 mental health support & free counselling available
  • Grow with us: Through career fairs, leadership programs, and learning on the go!
  • Flexible benefits, including early access to salary via our internal platform
  • Hybrid working optionsto support work-life balance and individual needs
  • Recognition awards, social events & more

Our Commitment to our colleague’s:

These aren’t just words — they’re the principles we live by. And we’re proud to back them up with real action, earning recognition and accreditation from leading organisations that share our commitment to people and growth:

  • Mindful Employer – championing mental health and wellbeing
  • Disability Confident Level 1 & 2 – creating accessible, inclusive opportunities
  • Menopause Friendly accredited – supporting every stage of life
  • Armed Forces Covenant signatory – honouring those who serve
  • Armed Forces Defence employer recognition scheme – Supporting those who serve
  • Great Places to Work 2024/25 – fostering an engaging and positive workplace culture
  • Best Place to Work for Development – proud to be investing in people’s future
  • Best Place to Work for Women – breaking down barriers to women’s career progression

If you’re looking for a company with a strong culture, real career progression, and a people-first approach — all rooted in the heart of Liverpool — Grow with Acorn.

We’re Here to Support You

We’re committed to creating an inclusive, supportive workplace where everyone can flourish. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process—or once you’re part of the team—just let us know. Whether it’s flexible hours, adapted equipment, or a bit of extra support, we’ll work with you to make sure you can do your best work.

A Few Things to Know Before You Apply

We’re really excited that you’re considering joining Acorn! To help everything go smoothly, here are a couple of things to keep in mind:

If your application is successful, we will commence relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include a standard criminal record check and an insolvency register check.

Because our training is quite comprehensive, we can only consider applicants who haveat least one year remainingon their Graduate or Post-Study Work visa. At the moment, we’re not able to offer visa sponsorship.

description:

Feel Free to be yourself at American:

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Build modern digital platforms at the intersection of engineering, cloud technology, and financial services.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Full-Stack Python Software Engineer to design and build high-quality digital solutions using Python web frameworks and modern front-end technologies.

You will bring strong foundations in computer science, including data structures, algorithms, SQL and NoSQL databases, distributed systems, and communication protocols. Working closely with Product Owners, architects, business analysts, Tech Leads, and fellow engineers, you will translate business needs into efficient, maintainable solutions.

You will have the opportunity to build advanced systems using modern technologies while gaining valuable experience with financial services digital marketing platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality full-stack solutions using Python, Django, and Angular, with potential future migration to ReactJS.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, architects, business analysts, Tech Leads, and engineers to understand requirements and deliver practical, well-designed solutions.
  • Develop and customize CMS capabilities using Wagtail, integrate PostgreSQL, and design robust task and messaging solutions.
  • Build and consume REST APIs and microservices, applying established API practices including OpenAPI and Swagger.
  • Contribute to cloud-based applications using AWS, modern CI/CD and code-quality tooling, Git, automated testing, and collaborative code reviews.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience, with significant experience using Python and Django or Flask/FastAPI, alongside front-end development using Angular.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, distributed systems, and communication protocols.
  • Experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL, alongside AWS cloud services, deployment strategies, Git, and modern CI/CD practices such as Jenkins.
  • Strong reasoning and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret evolving requirements, ask effective questions, and consider solutions in the context of the wider product.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience contributing within Agile, cross-functional engineering teams.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with Wagtail or another CMS framework.
  • Knowledge of ReactJS alongside Angular.
  • Experience with messaging or streaming technologies such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka.
  • Experience using AI-enabled coding tools such as GitHub Copilot to support software development.
  • Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic approaches, or other AI-enabled engineering practices.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.
  • Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
  • Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.
  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Benefits Coverage – 100% company-paid health, life, and disability insurance effective from Day 1 of employment.
  • Retirement Savings Program – Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with the option of receiving a matching employer contribution.
  • Virtual Health Care & Support – Company-paid virtual health care and Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP) available to employees and their dependents/partners.
  • Family & Wellness Support – Parental leave top-up from Day 1, a new parent gift, and fitness reimbursement to support health and well-being.
  • Career Development – A Business Coach from Day 1, providing personalized one-on-one coaching to support career growth, accelerate development, and help you achieve your professional goals at Capco.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition

At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination.

AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

Why This Role Is Open

We are currently hiring for this role due to an existing or newly created vacancy within our organization. This position is open as part of our ongoing business needs, and we are actively reviewing applications to fill this role with a qualified candidate who can make an immediate impact.

Pay Transparency

Capco is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation to our people. Our compensation policies and salary ranges are designed to allow our people to progress through the salary range as they demonstrate strong performance and develop in their role over time.
