title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description


About the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled Data Engineer with strong experience in building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, distributed data systems, and modern lakehouse architectures. The ideal candidate will work on large-scale telecom and CPaaS datasets, including Call Detail Records (CDR), enabling real-time analytics and business intelligence across the platform ecosystem.


What you’ll be Responsible for?

  • Design and implement scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale analytics, data processing, and migration workloads.
  • Build modern data lakehouse platforms using Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi with catalog services like Nessie, AWS Glue, or Hive Metastore.
  • Develop and optimize high-performance SQL queries and distributed data processing jobs using Spark (PySpark), Hadoop, and Kafka.
  • Design and manage data warehouses and analytical platforms using Snowflake, ClickHouse, Dremio, Redshift, Trino, or Presto.
  • Build ingestion and transformation pipelines using object storage systems such as Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS, or Nutanix Object Storage.
  • Process and transform telecom datasets and Call Detail Records (CDR) efficiently at scale.
  • Implement orchestration workflows using Airflow, Kestra, or similar workflow engines.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, lineage, observability, scalability, and cost optimization across distributed systems.
  • Build reusable frameworks for bulk data movement, ingestion acceleration, and transformation at scale.


What you’d have?

  • 7 –10 years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • Strong expertise in Advanced SQL including query optimization, partitioning, indexing, and performance tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (PySpark), Hadoop, Kafka, and distributed data processing systems.
  • Strong expertise in lakehouse technologies such as Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.
  • Experience with metadata/catalog systems including Nessie, Glue, or Hive Metastore.
  • Knowledge of analytical engines such as ClickHouse, Dremio, Trino, or Presto.
  • Strong understanding of Parquet, ORC, and Avro data formats.
  • Experience with object storage systems like S3, ADLS, GCS, or Nutanix Object Storage.
  • Strong programming skills in Python / PySpark / Scala.
  • Experience with Airflow, Kestra, or similar orchestration tools.
  • Hands-on exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms.
  • Experience in telecom data systems or CDR processing is highly preferred.


Why join us?

  • Impactful Work: Build large-scale data platforms and analytics systems that power real-time communication products used by millions globally.
  • Tremendous Growth Opportunities: Accelerate your career by solving complex engineering challenges in a fast-growing CPaaS and product-driven environment.
  • Innovative Environment: Work alongside world-class engineers building cutting-edge distributed data systems, lakehouse architectures, and cloud-native platforms.

Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We champion diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Circulation Assistant
description:
Handley Regional Library seeks a customer-service oriented individual with strong communications skills to assist the public at busy public service desk. Nights and weekends required.


Weekly hours: 22 hrs per week

Rate of Pay: $15.00/hr

Reports to: Circulation Services Coordinator

Fair Labor Standards Act: Non-exempt

Benefits: Includes vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays


Position Summary

Under the supervision of the Circulation Services Coordinator, performs responsible paraprofessional and technical work to provide circulation services for library patrons. Examines operations on a daily basis to ensure that all resources are managed as effectively as possible.


Major Duties

  • Completes assigned hours at Public Service Desk, providing circulation services to patrons, including checking library materials in and out, handling fines and fees, registering patrons for library cards, reserving requested materials for patrons and informing patrons when reserved materials are available, and updating the circulation data base to ensure it contains accurate information on patrons. Ensures the speedy return of materials to circulation.
  • Provides information to staff and patrons, including answering and directing incoming telephone calls, answering patron questions, helps patrons locate materials effectively and courteously. Provides accurate answers to basic inquiries using online resources, refer patrons to other sections of the library as needed.
  • Responsible for opening circulation desks each business day. At end of business day, is responsible for counting money received, obtaining door counts from public entrance, turning off copiers, and circulation desk terminals.
  • Shelves books, empties book drops, opens public entrances, keeps the circulation area neat and clean.
  • Maintains the order and appearance of books and library materials in the circulating collection by reading assigned shelves to assure accurate placement of materials, performs minor repairs and cleans library materials, and routes materials to the Technical Services department to have books relabeled and repaired when necessary.
  • Uses office and computer equipment efficiently and accurately (ex. scanner, copier, fax machine, self-checkout stations etc.) in conjunction with regular job functions. Performs routine maintenance, such as reloading paper trays and replacing toner or ink cartridges.
  • Assists in other departments as needed or assigned.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Controls

Library Assistant works under the supervision of the Information Service Coordinator, who establishes priorities, gives special assignments, and reviews specific tasks. Work is evaluated by direct observation, through results obtained, and through regular conferences and annual performance evaluations


Guidelines

Policies and procedures of the Handley Regional Library and the Five-Year Plan of the Handley Regional Library, Circulation Services procedures manual. State Library and ALA guidelines, and other professional and technical guidelines.


Complexity

Work is routine to complex in nature and requires attention to detail, accuracy, and the use of judgment in satisfying the needs of patrons in a timely manner.


Scope and Effect

When this position’s responsibilities are performed successfully, patrons will receive competent and courteous assistance in using the library and its resources. All patron requests will be given prompt attention and an equitable and reasonable allocation of time will be made to each request. The library collections and displays will be kept in good order. The Circulation Desk or other assigned public service desks will be neat and clean, with all equipment functioning and supplied.


Personal Contacts

Contacts are with patrons both in person, on the phone or via other electronic platforms, to provide direct assistance and to inform them of available services; and with co-workers and volunteers to coordinate activities and communicate information.


Physical Demands

The position requires standing and sitting at public service desks for the majority of the workday, working with the public, some repetitive motion and reading of computer screens. The position requires a significant amount of bending, reaching, and moving quickly to retrieve patron records or library materials shelved from six or more feet from the service desk. Shelf reading and shelving library materials requires standing on step stools or bending to reach low shelves and moving carts filled with books up and down ramps. Library Assistants must be able to empty exterior book drops, lift 25-pound boxes of books, move heavy book carts and shift furniture as necessary.


Work Environment

The work is performed primarily at a busy public information desk, during regular business hours, and includes some evening and weekends. Each Library Assistant will be assigned to work primarily in either the Handley or Bowman Library, but on occasion may be assigned to work as needed in another library in the system.

title: Node.js Backend Developer
description:
Job Description

Position: Node.js Backend Developer

Experience: 1–2 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

About AI Logic Neural Network Pvt. Ltd.

AI Logic Neural Network Pvt. Ltd. is a leading AI-driven technology company specializing in Language Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Enterprise SaaS solutions. About the Role

We are looking for a Node.js Backend Developer with 1–2 years of hands-on experience in backend application development. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Microservices, databases, caching, APIs, and message queues.

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving scalable backend services and APIs while working closely with frontend developers and other engineering team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop scalable and reusable backend services following clean coding and OOP principles.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs.
  • Build and maintain applications using a Microservices Architecture.
  • Work with relational databases including PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server (MS SQL).
  • Write efficient SQL queries and optimize database performance.
  • Use Redis for caching, session management, and application performance improvements.
  • Implement background jobs, queues, and asynchronous processing using BullMQ.
  • Work with message brokers and event-driven systems using RabbitMQ and/or Apache Kafka.
  • Develop reliable producer-consumer workflows and handle asynchronous communication between microservices.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
  • Implement proper error handling, logging, validation, authentication, and authorization.
  • Debug and troubleshoot application, database, queue, and API-related issues.
  • Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-documented code.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and other team members.

Required Technical Skills

  • Node.js
  • TypeScript
  • JavaScript
  • Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Microservices Architecture
  • PostgreSQL
  • Microsoft SQL Server (MS SQL)
  • Redis
  • RESTful API Development
  • GraphQL API Development
  • BullMQ
  • RabbitMQ and/or Apache Kafka
  • Understanding of message queues, producers, consumers, retries, and background job processing.
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, Promises, and async/await.
  • Good understanding of database design, relationships, joins, indexes, and SQL queries.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with Git and version-control workflows.
  • Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with frameworks such as Express.js, NestJS, or similar Node.js frameworks.
  • Experience building event-driven or queue-based systems.
  • Understanding of JWT or token-based authentication.
  • Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with API testing tools such as Postman.
  • Understanding of design patterns and clean architecture principles.
  • Knowledge of unit and integration testing is an advantage.
  • Basic understanding of message delivery concepts such as retries, acknowledgements, dead-letter queues, and idempotency.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of professional experience in backend or Node.js development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience developing backend APIs and working with databases.
  • Exposure to message queues or event-driven architecture is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is passionate about backend development and enjoys building scalable, high-performance systems. They have a strong foundation in backend engineering, understand microservices, caching strategies, background job processing, and asynchronous messaging, and are committed to writing clean, maintainable, and production-ready code. The candidate should be eager to learn, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to the development of innovative AI-powered products.

title: Back-Office Insurance & Prior Authorization
description:
Back-Office Insurance & Prior Authorization

Remote | Behavioral Health | 30 hours/week | $5-$6/hour
Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Central Time

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Back-Office Insurance & Prior Authorization Virtual Medical Assistant to support a nonprofit behavioral health organization in the United States.

This position will focus primarily on the administrative and insurance-related work required to move patients successfully through enrollment and prepare them for care.

The clinic serves patients using multiple payer arrangements, including commercial insurance, Medicaid, self-pay, and nonprofit programs that may reduce or eliminate the patient's cost of care. Because each patient may require a different process, the successful candidate must be highly organized and capable of determining what documentation, eligibility verification, authorization, or follow-up is needed for each case.

You will also help address existing administrative backlogs and build reliable back-office processes that the organization can continue using as it grows.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification & Benefits

  • Verify patient eligibility and applicable benefits with commercial insurance plans and Medicaid.

  • Review payer information and document verification results accurately in AdvancedMD and related clinic systems.

  • Identify insurance requirements, coverage issues, or missing information that could prevent a patient from progressing through enrollment.

Prior Authorizations

  • Initiate and process prior authorization requests according to payer and clinic requirements.

  • Communicate with insurance representatives and use payer portals to obtain requirements, authorization status, and supporting information.

  • Track pending authorization requests and follow them through approval, denial, or other appropriate resolution.

Financial Eligibility & Patient Follow-Up

  • Review patient information and required documentation to determine potential eligibility for nonprofit financial assistance or reduced-cost programs.

  • Conduct outbound follow-up with patients regarding missing forms, insurance information, signatures, or other incomplete enrollment or eligibility requirements.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of eligibility status and pending requirements, and coordinate with the front-desk VMA once the patient is ready to proceed toward scheduling.

Patient Intake & Enrollment

  • Support patient intake by setting up patient profiles and portals, collecting required forms, and ensuring demographic and insurance information is complete and accurately documented.

  • Review intake documentation for missing or incomplete information and conduct outbound follow-up with patients to obtain required forms, signatures, insurance details, or other enrollment requirements.

  • Track each patient through the intake and enrollment process, coordinate with the front-desk VMA, and confirm that all required administrative steps are completed before the patient proceeds to scheduling.

Provider Credentialing Support

  • Assist with provider insurance credentialing and payer enrollment as the clinic expands the scope of the position.

  • Organize required credentialing documents, payer correspondence, application statuses, and renewal information.

  • Follow up on pending credentialing items and communicate outstanding requirements to the appropriate clinic team member.

EHR & Chart Preparation

  • Update patient demographics, insurance information, authorization details, financial eligibility information, and related administrative records in AdvancedMD.

  • Prepare patient charts before appointments and confirm that required administrative documents are complete and available.

  • Identify incomplete or inconsistent information and resolve or escalate issues before the patient's scheduled visit.

Backlog & Case Management

  • Review outstanding patient and administrative cases and prioritize them based on urgency, status, and required next action.

  • Determine what is preventing each case from progressing and take appropriate follow-up action with the patient, payer, or internal team.

  • Maintain clear documentation of outreach attempts, completed work, pending items, and next steps until each case reaches resolution.

Cross-Functional Administrative Support

  • Provide additional healthcare administrative support during available capacity and as cross-training develops.

  • Coordinate closely with the bilingual front-desk VMA to ensure patients transition smoothly between inquiry, enrollment, insurance processing, and scheduling.

  • Provide coverage for related workflows when appropriately trained and within the defined scope of the position.

SOP & Process Development

  • Help document insurance verification, prior authorization, financial eligibility, and enrollment follow-up procedures.

  • Update Standard Operating Procedures as payer requirements and clinic workflows are clarified or improved.

  • Identify recurring back-office bottlenecks and recommend processes that improve consistency, accuracy, and turnaround time.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous healthcare experience with substantial responsibility for insurance verification and prior authorizations.

  • Experience working with US commercial insurance plans, Medicaid, or both.

  • Experience contacting insurance companies and using payer portals.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare eligibility and authorization workflows.

  • Experience using an EHR or practice-management system.

  • Strong administrative documentation and data-entry skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong follow-up, organization, and task-management skills.

  • Professional verbal and written English communication.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple pending cases.

  • Strong understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Behavioral health or mental health administrative experience.

  • Experience with AdvancedMD.

  • Experience evaluating patient financial eligibility.

  • Experience supporting Medicaid populations.

  • Provider credentialing or payer enrollment experience.

  • English and Spanish bilingual proficiency.

Systems & Tools

The clinic uses or expects the VMA to work with:

  • AdvancedMD

  • Microsoft Teams

  • Phone services

  • Insurance payer portals

  • Patient intake portals and online forms

  • VPN and secure remote-access systems

  • Time Doctor

Remote Work Requirements

Candidates must maintain:

  • Private and secure home workspace

  • Reliable computer capable of supporting healthcare applications and multiple browser-based systems

  • Stable primary internet connection, reliable backup internet

  • Verified backup power source

  • Professional headset

  • Secondary monitor

  • Quiet working environment appropriate for patient and insurance calls

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position requires strong ownership and follow-through.

The ideal candidate does not simply complete individual insurance tasks. You should be able to look at a pending patient case, determine what is preventing it from moving forward, identify the next action, complete the necessary follow-up, and continue managing the case until the appropriate resolution has been reached.

You will help ensure patients do not remain unnecessarily stuck in the enrollment process because of missing documentation, incomplete insurance requirements, pending authorizations, or administrative backlogs.

Shape the Future of Surgical Tech: Sr. Engineer – Advanced TechnologiesParagon 28 (Zimmer Biomet) | Englewood, CO

Ready to build the next generation of smart orthopedic solutions? As our Senior Engineer, you will drive the development of cutting-edge clinical tech—from surgical navigation and wearable sensors to intelligent implants and patient-specific planning.If you are a builder who thrives at the intersection of hardware, software, and medicine, this is your chance to own complex technical work and mentor a growing team.

What You’ll DoDrive

  • Innovation: Lead core phases of the development lifecycle for advanced surgical technologies.
  • Collaborate & Mentor: Guide junior engineers and sync with cross-functional teams to bring ideas to life.
  • Own the Tech: Take full ownership of complex software, hardware, and clinical engineering tasks.

What You Bring

  • Clinical Curiosity: A passion for solving real-world medical problems with data-driven methods.
  • Dev Expertise: Strong foundational skills in software or algorithm development.Cross-Domain Agility: The unique ability to bridge the gap between hardware, software, and clinical needs.
  • Technical Ownership: Sound engineering judgment and a track record of leading complex projects.

This is a hybrid position requiring weekly onsite presence at our Englewood, Colorado location.

How You'll Create Impact

  • Lead development efforts for key components or subsystems of Advanced Technologies programs, ensuring technical excellence and alignment with project objectives.
  • Define and refine system and subsystem requirements with emphasis on technical feasibility, data quality and availability, interfaces, and measurable performance criteria.
  • Independently develop and mature software, algorithms, computational models, and prototype systems from feasibility through increasingly product-relevant implementations.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Affairs, Product Development, Quality, Regulatory, Hardware, and other cross-functional teams in the design, testing, integration, and deployment of innovative technologies.
  • Develop and document test strategies and protocols, analyze results, identify root causes, and recommend design improvements.
  • Apply requirements-based development and appropriate design controls as technologies progress toward commercial medical products.
  • Mentor and support junior engineers through technical reviews, knowledge sharing, and day-to-day engineering guidance.
  • Support ongoing research and development initiatives by evaluating emerging technologies, identifying technical risks, and designing experiments to reduce uncertainty.
  • Manage multiple technical priorities with limited supervision and communicate risks, dependencies, and progress to project stakeholders.
  • Participate in surgical observations and clinical collaborations to translate workflow needs and clinical problems into meaningful technical solutions.

Your Background

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Advanced degree (MS/PhD) focused on Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Data Science, Robotics, Biomechanics, or related field preferred but not required.
Experience
• Minimum of 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of technical projects or subsystems; an advanced degree may offset a portion of industry experience where appropriate.
• Demonstrated ability to operate independently while contributing to a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
Core Capability Areas
Software & Algorithm Development
• Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar languages.
• Experience independently developing and debugging algorithms for data processing, computational modeling, navigation, sensing, or systems control.
Machine Learning & Computer Vision
• Experience applying ML/CV techniques to real-world problems.
• Ability to select appropriate approaches, establish evaluation methods, and understand limitations and failure modes.
Data & Statistical Analysis
• Experience with statistical modeling, data analysis, and performance evaluation.
• Ability to work effectively with noisy, incomplete, experimental, or clinical datasets and draw defensible conclusions.
Systems & Product Integration
• Experience developing within larger systems such as surgical navigation, sensors, wearables, robotics, imaging, or similar platforms.
• Understanding of software/hardware interfaces, system-level tradeoffs, and clinical workflow integration.
Medical Device Product Development
• Experience with requirements-based product development and technical documentation.
• Experience with CAD software (SolidWorks, 3-Matic, Fusion 360, or similar) is beneficial.
• Exposure to regulated medical-device development and design controls is preferred.
Additional Strengths
• Experience in medical devices, imaging, or regulated environments.
• Exposure to signal processing, biomechanics, sensor data, registration, or patient-specific modeling.
• Ability to lead portions of complex projects independently while contributing to broader program success.
• Experience mentoring or coaching less experienced engineers.
• Strong technical communication and ability to influence decisions within a multidisciplinary team.

Travel Expectations

Up to 10% overnight travel may be required.

Compensation Data

Salary Range: $100,000 - $130,000 depending on skills and experience

title: Director, Market Intelligence
description:
Director, Market Intelligence

Reporting To: VP, Global Ecosystem Strategy (Within CMSPI’s Consulting Solutions function)

Location: Atlanta, GA (Hybrid - 3 days a week onsite)

(Open to remote if located outside of the Atlanta area - with scope of visiting the office occasionally)

Payments is moving quickly, and it can be hard for even the largest merchants to know which changes really matter. CMSPI helps clients cut through the noise, understand what is happening in the market, and decide where to focus next.

We’re looking for a senior payments leader who enjoys making complex topics useful. In this role, you’ll shape CMSPI’s client-facing Market Intelligence agenda and turn our expertise, data, technology, and commercial judgment into practical guidance for some of the world’s largest merchants. This role is for someone who wants to do more than track industry news or produce reports. We are looking for a credible, commercially minded payments expert who can explain why developments matter, what choices they create for clients, and how CMSPI can help clients act with confidence. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to combine deep payments expertise with a visible internal and external role.

About CMSPI

CMSPI is a global payments consultancy that works with leading merchants to improve payment performance, reduce cost, and make better decisions in a complex payments market. Our work combines deep consulting expertise with proprietary data, analytics, and technology - giving clients the insight and support they need to move from knowing there is a problem to knowing what to do about it.

What you'll do

  • Shape CMSPI’s market agenda: Identify and prioritise the industry developments, risks, opportunities, and innovations that CMSPI should lead on. Turn early market signals into clear points of view, client education, and practical guidance on where merchants should pay attention, make decisions, or take action
  • Turn market developments, proprietary data, benchmarks, and platform insights into briefings, education materials, client-ready narratives, and clear points of view
  • Bring Market Intelligence into executive briefings, strategic reviews, merchant education, renewals, sales meetings, and growth conversations with priority clients
  • Represent CMSPI in senior client discussions, industry events, conferences, webinars, blogs, marketing activity, and external forums
  • Work closely with Product, Data, Partnerships, Sales, Delivery, Marketing, and leadership so Market Intelligence is connected to how CMSPI builds, sells, and delivers value
  • Work in close partnership with the Solutions team leadership, our go-to-market team, and our Chief Economist to align perspectives and ensure ownership over key initiatives
  • Guide a small, accountable team producing timely, useful, and repeatable intelligence that clients and account teams can actually use
  • Triage demand and focus effort: Prioritize requests from clients and account leads, deciding what should be escalated, what can be scaled through the team, and where Market Intelligence can create the most value

Why CMSPI

CMSPI exists to help make the payments ecosystem more innovative, competitive, and transparent. We’ve built a unique position as one of the premier trusted advisors to many of the world’s largest organizations, giving our teams the opportunity to work on questions that shape how major merchants understand and improve payments.

You’ll also have a strong foundation to build from, combining both expertise, partnerships, and technology. CMSPI’s technology, data, and analytics platform brings together scale and depth that can help turn market change into intelligence clients cannot get anywhere else, including:

  • Over 87 billion transactions (and growing), amounting to trillions of USD in consumer spend
  • Telemetry on 1 in 7 U.S. card transactions
  • Payments performance data from over 50% of Fortune 500 merchants
  • A Databricks-backed platform supporting scalable insight development and more advanced intelligence products

If you enjoy making sense of a fast-moving market and helping clients decide what to do next, we’d love to hear from you.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Senior-level experience in payments, fintech, merchant acquiring, card networks, issuing, payment operations, payments consulting, market intelligence, strategy, or a related field
  • A strong understanding of the payments ecosystem, with the ability to connect market, regulatory, technology, network, issuer, acquirer, and merchant trends to practical client implications
  • Experience setting priorities, guiding work, and helping a small team or cross-functional group produce strong, useful output
  • Credibility with senior client, industry, and internal stakeholders, including confidence in client meetings, sales conversations, events, and market forums
  • Strong communication, storytelling, and thought-leadership skills, with the ability to make complex market change clear, relevant, and actionable
  • Commercial judgment, curiosity, and a genuine interest in helping clients and colleagues understand what is changing and what to do next

Benefits

    • Comprehensive, payments industry training by in-house and industry expert
    • Personal and professional learning opportunities and growth experiences aligned with your career aspirations.
    • 100% healthcare coverage for employees and low-cost dental and vision options
    • Health Savings Account, Flexible Savings Account, and Commuter Benefit options
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match up to 5% after 90 days of employment
    • Annual company bonus plan based on company & individual performance
    • Quarterly values award for all employees - with a financial prize
    • Regular companywide socials and team building events
    • 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, 8 paid company holidays, and discretionary office closure during the holiday season

title: Director of Development Strategy
description:
Reporting to the Associate Vice President for University Development and Advancement Solutions (UDAS), the Director, Development Strategy, will manage and oversee the systems, processes, and internal communications that serve to support the pipeline of top solicitations University-wide and maximize the time and effectiveness of the Harvard University President and Provost. In a University campaign setting, this individual will manage activities related to internal planning, pipeline feasibility, and volunteer leadership.

The successful candidate will possess a strong understanding of principal gift fundraising strategy and donor relations, along with the strategic judgment and ability to navigate organizational, data, and operational complexity, influence across functions, and lead the successful execution of high-priority initiatives.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop familiarity with the backgrounds and strategies for each of the University’s top prospects and donors.

  • Manage the development and tracking of University top prospect lists, contributing to the creation of pipelines for senior leadership meetings and travel and liaising with fundraising partners across AA&D and the Schools.
  • Provide strategic oversight of University Development’s $10M+ solicitation portfolio, including the coordination and advancement of complex solicitations requiring Gift Policy Committee review; ensure the integrity and quality of materials and equip the AVP of UDAS with the analysis, recommendations, and preparation needed for effective decision-making and committee engagement.
  • Direct logistics for forums to develop and share plans for the University’s top prospects, including pipeline reviews and top prospect strategy discussions. Oversee communications and meeting materials and track on next steps and deliverables.
  • Provide strategic leadership and cross-functional integration for Presidential and Provostial development activity, partnering across Advancement Communications, Events and Donor Relations, University Development, Philanthropic Partnerships, and the VPAAD Office to align priorities and ensure seamless execution of leadership-level communications and announcements, travel and meeting pipelines, and internal strategy and planning meetings.
  • Manage the identification, recruitment, and management of membership of presidential committees, including soliciting input from Schools.
  • Oversee University Development’s annual event request process. Support the execution of select special events with the President’s and Provost’s involvement, partnering with University Development colleagues to develop event strategy, collaborate with schools, create seating plans, and contribute to briefing content.
  • With University Development and Prospect Management, have responsibility for driving the work described above in ways that ensure alignment with the broader policy systems, and data considerations and activities related to university-wide prospect coordination and management.
  • Manage and supervise the Assistant Director, Development Strategy, providing mentoring, training, and performance management reviews.
  • The above covers the most significant responsibilities of the position. It does not however, exclude other duties, the inclusion of which would be in conformity with the level of the position. May take on other direct reports or assignments, as needed.

Working Conditions:

  • Candidates must be willing to have a hybrid presence in the office and flexibility for in office as needed around manager needs and donor visits.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required and minimum of 10 years related experience required.

  • Ability to work occasional evenings or weekends and travel as necessary for donor and colleague meetings and events.

  • You will be expected to work certain events/campus activities, such as reunions each Spring, and participate in department retreats that are taking place on campus in Cambridge, MA.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience working with prospect strategy and in a fundraising environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work successfully under pressure, understand and follow policies and procedures, and accommodate change. Proven ability to work independently as well as collaboratively on a team. Must be able to complete assignments independently and with a minimum amount of supervision.
  • Must be able to collaborate with a range of diverse stakeholders and lead and manage key organizational processes and activities with confidence and good judgement.
  • Strong operational skills that demonstrate professionalism, organization, strong time management, managing and measuring work, managing work processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; must be detail oriented. Evidence of the analytic and research skills to gather and determine essential data from a variety of written and individual sources.
  • Good judgment and discretion to represent the Alumni Affairs and Development constituencies in a highly professional manner. Ability to handle confidential materials with discretion. Collaborative and diplomatic – able to advance projects and work outside of their direct authority by building and maintaining strong internal relationships.
  • Solid computer skills in a PC environment with the capability to master new software applications and technologies in database management.

Please include a cover letter as a part of your application to help us better understand your qualifications and background. This can provide valuable insight into your experience and interest in the role.

  • Orientation and Review Period: 6 months
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 40 hours per week
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks
